articles.title: Scale-based Approach for Active Wildfire Segmentation on Satellite Imagery
articles.content: Active wildfire mapping from satellite imagery is challenging due to the sparse and highly imbalanced nature of fire pixels, especially in early-stage or low-density fire observations. This work investigates the use of multispectral Landsat-8 imagery for active-fire segmentation under multi-scale wildfire size conditions. We propose a data-driven protocol to characterize fire-region size distributions through connected-component analysis and an interquartile range criterion, enabling the evaluation of model robustness across different local fire-region densities. Three segmentation architectures, U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer, are evaluated under different SWIR-based spectral configurations. Results show that U-Net achieves the strongest robustness across the evaluated conditions, SegFormer provides competitive performance, and DeepLabV3+ tends to produce conservative predictions with reduced recall. Across architectures, SWIR2 consistently achieves the strongest or near-best results, highlighting its importance for active-fire segmentation in Landsat-8 imagery. These findings suggest that both spectral band selection and architectural design are critical for robust satellite-based active wildfire mapping trained on low active fire-pixel density images.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于规模的卫星成像活生生的野火分片方法
articles.content_zh: 由于火像素的稀少和高度不平衡的性质,特别是早期或低密度的火灾观测,从卫星图像中绘制活生生的野火图具有挑战性. 这项工作调查了多光谱Landsat-8影像在多尺度野火大小条件下用于活火分化的情况. 我们提出了一个数据驱动的协议,通过连通组件分析和一个等距范围标准来描述火灾区域大小分布,从而能够评价不同地方火灾区域密度的模型稳健性。 在基于SWIR的不同光谱配置下评价了三个分块结构:U-Net,DeepLabV3+和SegFormer. 结果显示,U-Net在所评价的条件下实现了最强的稳健性,SegFormer提供了有竞争力的性能,而DeepLabV3+倾向于产生保守的预测并减少召回. 在整个建筑中,SWIR2始终取得最强或接近最优的成果,突出了其在Landsat-8图像中的活火分化的重要性. 这些研究结果表明,光谱波段选择和建筑设计对于在低活性火像素密度图像上训练出来的以卫星为基础的活性野火绘图至关重要。

articles.title: Multimodal RGB-Infrared Combination for UAV-Based Wildfire Segmentation: A Comparative Study on FLAME3
articles.content: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have emerged as a promising platform for firefighting operations due to their flexibility, low operational cost, and ability to acquire high-resolution imagery in locations that may be difficult or dangerous to access using conventional methods. Recent advances in deep learning have significantly improved the capabilities of UAV-based wildfire monitoring systems. The present work investigates RGB-infrared fusion for binary wildfire segmentation on the FLAME3 dataset. In this Study, RGB and Infrared baselines are compared with three representative fusion strategies across three segmentation architectures, including U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer. The key motivation of this work is to analyze the contribution of each modality, evaluate the impact of fusion timing, and examine how different network architectures exploit multimodal information for UAV wildfire delineation. The findings indicate that thermal information plays a dominant role in UAV segmentation and that feature-level multimodal fusion combined with transformer-based architectures offers the most promising direction for future research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以无人驾驶航空器为基础的野火分解的多式RGB-红外结合:关于FLAME3的比较研究
articles.content_zh: 由于无人驾驶飞行器具有灵活性、业务成本低以及在使用传统方法可能难以或危险的地点获得高分辨率图像的能力,因此它已成为消防作业的一个有希望的平台。 近期在深入学习上的进步大大提高了以无人机为基础的野火监测系统的能力. 本作调查了FLAME3数据集上RGB-红外聚变以进行二元野火分解. 本研究将RGB和红外线基线与三个分块结构的三个有代表性的聚变战略进行比较,包括U-Net、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer。 这项工作的关键动机是分析每种方式的贡献,评价聚变时间的影响,并审查不同的网络结构如何利用多模式信息来划定无人机野火. 研究结果表明,热能信息在无人驾驶飞行器分解中发挥着主导作用,地物级多式聚变与以变压器为基础的结构相结合,为今后的研究提供了最有希望的方向。

articles.title: InSight: A Benchmark for Agentic Claim Verification in Interactive Visualizations
articles.content: Vision Language Models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in interpreting static visual artifacts, but modern data analysis is inherently dynamic, requiring the active interrogation of interactive environments. Existing benchmarks are predominantly constrained to static imagery and one-shot question answering and fail to capture the epistemic demands of this domain, where evidence is frequently occluded, distributed across linked views, or conditionally revealed through user agency. In this paper, we introduce InSight, a benchmark for agentic claim verification over interactive visualizations. The dataset consists of 21,349 claims derived from human-authored analytical narratives and grounded in fully interactive web-based environments. Agents must navigate these environments to determine whether a natural language claim is supported, refuted or not verifiable given the available evidence. Unlike traditional evaluations, InSight treats interaction traces as intrinsic proxies for reasoning, enabling a rigorous audit of how models seek and synthesize visual evidence. We evaluate state-of-the-art models, revealing that interactive verification remains a non-trivial challenge. We release InSight at https://github.com/maevehutch/insight.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: InSight:互动可视化中代理索赔核查基准
articles.content_zh: Vision Language Models在诠释静态视觉文物方面表现出了出众的熟练度,但现代数据分析本质上是动态的,需要积极询问交互环境. 现有基准主要限于静态图像和一弹一弹的问题回答,无法捕捉到该领域的感知性需求,因为在这个领域,证据经常被占用、在链接的观点中传播,或通过用户机构有条件地披露。 在本文中,我们引入了InSight,这是相对于交互式可视化的代理索赔核查的基准. 数据集由21,349个来自由人类授权的分析叙述,基于完全互动的网络环境的诉求组成. 代理人必须在这些环境中航行,以确定根据现有证据,自然语言主张是否得到支持、反驳或无法核实。 与传统评价不同,"InSight"将相互作用痕迹视为推理的内在代名词,使得能够对模型如何寻求并合成视觉证据进行严格的审计. 我们评价最新模式,揭示互动核查仍然是非三角挑战。 在https://github.com/maevehutch/insight上,

articles.title: IntroConformal: Conformal Factuality Guarantees for Large Vision-Language Models via Introspective Signals
articles.content: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved strong multimodal performance, yet ensuring the factual correctness of generated content remains challenging. Existing methods that provide statistical guarantees on factuality typically rely on external verifiers or generation-time confidence signals, which introduce auxiliary dependencies or often fail for confident but incorrect outputs. We argue that reliable factuality control can instead be achieved through introspective signals derived from the model itself. We introduce IntroConformal, a training-free Conformal Risk Control (CRC) framework that provides finite-sample, distribution-free factuality guarantees. We first instantiate it with layer-wise semantic stability, a conformity score derived from hidden-state representations, and then propose verification probability, a stronger score capturing the model's self-administered judgment on claim factuality. Across multiple LVLM architectures, IntroConformal satisfies the conformal risk guarantee while substantially reducing abstention and achieving competitive or superior claim-level discrimination relative to external verifier-based baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 非正式: 通过透视信号实现大视野-语言模型的正规实际保障
articles.content_zh: 大型Vision-Langage Models(LVLMs)已经取得了很强的多模式性能,然而,确保生成内容的事实正确性仍然是个挑战。 现有方法对事实性提供统计保障,一般依靠外部验证器或生成时间信心信号,这些信号引入了辅助依赖性,或者常常因自信但错误的产出而失败. 我们主张,通过模型本身产生的内向信号,可以实现可靠的事实质量控制。 我们引入了无培训的 " 非正式风险控制 " 框架,该框架提供有限样本、无分配的事实保障。 我们首先用分层的语义稳定性来即时化它,一个从隐藏状态表述中得出的符合性分数,然后提出验证概率,一个更强的分数来捕捉模型自己对声称事实性的判断. 在多个LVLM架构中,IntroConform满足了符合性风险的保证,同时大幅降低了弃权率,实现了与外部核查者基准相比的竞争性或优越的索赔层次歧视。

articles.title: Diffusion Based Unpaired Data Learning for Inverse Problems
articles.content: Data is important in many deep learning-based inverse problem solvers. However, obtaining sufficient paired data in many scenarios remains highly challenging, while unpaired data is cheap. To maximize data utilization, this paper proposes LUD-DIF, a diffusion-based approach for solving inverse problems with unpaired data. Starting from the evidence lower bound (ELBO) of the joint distribution, we decouple it into two independent diffusion processes under the weak-coupling assumption. The method provides theoretical support from a variational inference perspective, derives the loss function, quantitatively analyzes the error bound introduced by the assumption, and offers a theorem-motivated heuristic for hyperparameter selection. Experimental results demonstrate that LUD-DIF achieves outstanding performance on multiple image inverse problems, validating its effectiveness and generalization capability in unpaired inverse problem settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于逆向问题的无源数据学习
articles.content_zh: 在许多以学习为基础的深层反向问题解决方案中,数据很重要. 然而,在很多情况下获得足够的配对数据仍然极具挑战性,而未经认证的数据却很便宜。 为了最大限度地利用数据,本文提出了LUD-DIF,一种以扩散为基础的方法,以解决未发数据方面的反向问题. 从联合分布的下限证据(ELBO)开始,我们在弱相接假设下将它解为两个独立的扩散过程. 该方法从可变推论角度提供理论支持,得到损失函数,定量分析由假设所引入的误差,并为超参数选择提供定理动机的heuristic. 实验结果表明,LUD-DIF在多个图像反向问题上取得了出色的性能,验证了它在无假反向问题环境中的有效性和通缩能力.

articles.title: Accurate Reconstruction of Gas Turbine Blade Geometry Using 3D/2D Rigid Registration and CT View Optimization
articles.content: Non-destructive X-ray and computed tomography (CT) testing are essential for ensuring the dimensional accuracy of manufactured components with complex internal structures, such as the cooling channels in gas turbine blades, which directly affect thermal performance and service life. This study presents a multipart 3D-2D rigid registration approach for aligning CAD models with X-ray projections as an alternative to CT reconstruction for part inspection and measurement. A greedy registration algorithm sequentially aligns the blade's exterior before registering its internal components by maximizing the mutual information between simulated and acquired X-ray images. This stepwise approach reduces problem complexity and improves alignment accuracy. View angles are optimized using a greedy method that iteratively selects angles to minimize dimensional measurement errors. The results indicate that a small number of oblique views provides the best accuracy, although a broad range of angles yields acceptable results. The method achieves subpixel registration accuracy, with errors below one-fifth of the magnified detector-pixel pitch. Image noise and defects reduce registration precision, but direct registration in projection space mitigates these effects compared with CT reconstruction. Appropriate view selection can therefore preserve acceptable subpixel accuracy in the presence of image noise and defects.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用 3D/2D 硬化注册和 CT 视图优化,准确重建天然气涡轮刀几何
articles.content_zh: 无损X射线和计算成的照相仪(CT)测试对于确保具有复杂内部结构的制造部件的维度准确性至关重要,例如气体涡轮叶片的冷却通道,这直接影响到热性能和服务寿命. 这项研究提出了多部分的3D-2D刚性登记办法,使CAD模型与X射线预测一致,作为部分检查和测量的CT重建的替代办法。 一种贪婪的注册算法通过将模拟和获得的X射线图像之间的相互信息最大化,在注册其内部组件之前,相继地将刀片外出进行对接. 这种分步走的方法降低了问题的复杂性并提高了对齐的准确性. 取景角度是使用一种贪婪的方法进行优化,该方法会迭代地选择取景角度来将维度测量错误最小化. 结果表明,少数偏颇的观点提供了最佳的准确性,尽管各种角度得出可以接受的结果。 这种方法实现了子像素注册精度,误差低于放大探测器-像素投出物的五分之一. 图像噪音和缺陷降低了登记精度,但直接在投影空间登记与CT重建相比减轻了这些影响. 因此,在存在图像噪声和缺陷的情况下,适当的视图选择可以保持可接受的子像素精度.

articles.title: ExBind: A Controlled Diagnostic Benchmark for Visual-to-Executable Correspondence
articles.content: Multimodal coding and editing systems must map a visible or semantic referent to the exact executable object that can be edited. A wrong reference may select a valid but incorrect DOM node, SVG element, graph endpoint, hierarchy member, or table cell, while final execution success alone does not reveal the source of the failure. ExBind isolates this visual-to-executable correspondence layer as a controlled diagnostic benchmark between semantic localization and action execution. It samples representation-independent latent binding instances and compiles them into SVG, DOM, canvas, tree, graph, and table cases with deterministic mappings to executable references. Models output only a strict reference; the evaluator maps predictions back to latent structure and scores structural constraints without requiring reasoning traces. The release contains a 250-case broad suite, a disjoint 240-case targeted suite, and 50 paired latent groups. Qwen2.5-VL-3B achieves 98.4% candidate validity but 76.4% exact accuracy, while Qwen3-VL-4B achieves 100.0% validity and 98.8% exact accuracy. In the targeted table suite, all Qwen2.5-VL-3B residual errors are valid correct-row/wrong-column selections. Candidate-order perturbations change case-level outcomes while preserving this error pattern. ExBind is designed for controlled diagnosis rather than population-scale ranking or end-to-end editing evaluation. Code and benchmark records are available at https://github.com/Daerwang2020/Exbind and https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ziqianwwww/ExBind.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ExBind:可视对可执行信件的控制诊断基准
articles.content_zh: 多式联运编码和编辑系统必须绘制一个可见的或语义上的可执行对象的可被编辑。 错误的引用可能选择一个有效但不正确的DOM节点,SVG元素,图端点,层次成员,或表格单元格,而仅最终执行成功并不能显示失败的来源. ExBind将这个可视到可执行的通信层隔离出,作为语义定位与动作执行之间的可控诊断基准. 它对表现式独立的潜在绑定实例进行取样,并将其汇编到SVG、DOM、画布、树、图表和表格中,并附有确定性映射图,以便可执行引用。 模型只输出一个严格的参考;评价者将预测回溯到潜在结构,并评分结构制约因素而不需要推理痕迹. 发行中包含一个250个案例的宽套房,一个与240个案例脱节的有针对性套房,以及50对潜在组. Quen2.5-VL-3B实现候选人有效性为98.4%,而精确度为76.4%;而Quen3-VL-4B实现有效性为100.0%,精确度为98.8%. 在目标表格套件中,所有Quen2.5-VL-3B后遗症都是有效的正确行/错误列选择. 候选人顺序扰动在保留这种出错模式的同时会改变案例级别的结果. ExBind是为可控诊断而设计的,而不是人口规模排名或端到端编辑评价. 代码和基准记录见https://github.com/Daerwang2020/Exbind和https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ziqianwwww/ExBind。

articles.title: Reliability Challenges in Diffusion Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Diffusion-based Large Vision-Language Models (dLVLMs) have recently emerged as a compelling alternative to autoregressive (AR) LVLMs, offering advantages in parallel decoding, bidirectional context, and controllable generation. Despite rapid progress, their reliability properties remain largely uncharacterized. We present the first systematic reliability evaluation of hallucination and bias in dLVLMs, benchmarking six diffusion models against competitive AR baselines across four dimensions. Our key findings are: (1) dLVLMs reverse the yes-bias of AR models in binary visual queries; (2) they achieve competitive hallucination rates yet exhibit degraded linguistic quality; (3) they collapse to near-zero accuracy on underrepresented racial groups with opposite-polarity gender bias; and (4) they exhibit accuracy collapse in multiple-choice settings when the correct option is shorter than its distractors, associated with a length prior that emerges at the first denoising step. Tokens committed at late denoising steps with low confidence further correlate with hallucinated content, pointing to a mechanistic signal unique to diffusion generation. These patterns vary across model families, suggesting reliability is shaped by the generative paradigm together with training data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 传播视野-语言模型中的可靠性挑战
articles.content_zh: 以扩散为基础的大视野语言模型(dLVLMs)最近已成为自相递减(AR)LVLMs的令人信服的替代品,在平行解码、双向环境以及可控生成方面提供了优势。 尽管取得了迅速的进展,但它们的可靠性特性基本上仍未被定性。 我们提出了对dLVLMs的幻觉和偏差的第一次系统可靠性评估,将六个传播模型与具有竞争力的AR基线比对了四个层面。 我们的主要调查结果是:(1) dLVLMs在二进制视觉查询中倒转AR模型的"是"-比斯;(2)它们实现竞争性的幻觉率,但语言质量已退化;(3)它们在代表不足的种族群体上倒塌到接近零的准确度,具有相向极性性别偏差;和(4)在多选择环境中,当正确的选择比它的分心器短时,它们显示出精度倒塌,与第一个去诺步骤出现之前出现的长度有关. 在低信心的晚期解密步骤中承诺的托肯进一步与有幻觉的内容相联,指向扩散生成所特有的机械信号. 这些模式因模范家庭而异,表明可靠性与培训数据一起由基因模式所决定。

articles.title: MIDR: Enrichment-Augmented Indexing for Multimodal Document Retrieval
articles.content: Retrieval over visually rich documents has a representation problem: important content often lives in tables, charts, figures, and layout relations that plain OCR linearizes, corrupts, or omits. ColPali-family visual retrievers address this with patch-level multi-vector indexes and late-interaction scoring, keeping image-derived retrieval on the query-time serving path. We introduce MIDR (Multimodal Indexing for Document Retrieval), a training-free framework for enrichment-augmented indexing that shifts multimodal reasoning to index time. During ingestion, a multimodal LLM converts rendered pages into verified textual fields that are indexed with BM25F and optionally fused with dense retrieval, enabling text-centric serving over multimodally grounded evidence. On ViDoRe V3, MIDR Hybrid achieves 0.6219 average nDCG across five English domains, a 23.0% relative gain over BM25, remaining competitive with ColQwen2.5. On two French-document domains, enrichment bridges English queries and French page text, lifting BM25 from 0.1532 to 0.5448 nDCG and outperforming ColQwen2.5. Across all seven domains, MIDR leads ColQwen2.5 on four while using approximately 9x smaller index memory and approximately 2x lower query latency. These results establish index-time multimodal reasoning as a compelling accuracy-deployment alternative to serving-time visual late interaction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MIDR:多式联运文件检索强化索引
articles.content_zh: 对视觉丰富的文件进行检索存在代表性问题:重要内容往往生活在表格、图表、数字和布局关系之中,这些关系可以使OCR线性化、腐败或省略。 ColPali-family可视取回器用补丁级多向量索引和后互动分数处理,将取自图像取回器保存在查询时间服务路径上. 我们引入了MIDR(文件检索的多式索引),这是浓缩强化索引的无培训框架,将多式推理转换为索引时间。 在摄取过程中,一种多式LLM将页面转换成经核实的文本字段,这些字段以BM25F为索引,可选地与密集的检索相接,从而能够以文本为中心,在基于多式的证据之上服务。 在ViDoRe V3上,MIDR Hybrid在5个英语领域实现平均0.6219nDCG,比BM25相对增益23.0%,与ColQuen2.5保持竞争力. 在两个法文件域上,浓缩连接了英语查询和法语页面文本,将BM25从0.1532升至0.5448 nDCG并优于ColQwen2.5. 在所有7个域中,MIDR带领ColQuen2.5在4个域上,同时使用大约9x更小的索引内存和大约2x更低的查询间隔. 这些结果确立了指数-时间多模式推理,作为取代服务时间视觉晚期互动的令人信服的准确性部署。

articles.title: GazeRefine: Expert Gaze as a Test-Time Prompt for Training-Free Medical Image Segmentation
articles.content: Medical image segmentation remains difficult to scale because high-performing methods typically rely on dense expert annotations and task-specific training. We introduce GazeRefine, a training-free framework that uses gaze as an inference-time prompt for zero-shot medical image segmentation. Sparse, duration-weighted fixations are converted into foreground and background priors that initialize semantic prototypes in frozen DINOv3 feature space. These prototypes are iteratively refined through foreground-background discrimination, feature-space affinity propagation, and anchoring to the initial gaze guidance, allowing segmentation to extend beyond directly fixated regions while limiting semantic drift. GazeRefine requires no segmentation masks, fine-tuning, adapters, prompt encoders, or gradient updates. We evaluate the method on gaze-annotated polyp segmentation and prostate MRI segmentation. The results show strong performance on colonoscopy images and competitive performance on prostate MRI, supporting gaze-guided prototype refinement as a promising approach for segmentation-label-efficient, human-in-the-loop medical image segmentation. Our tools and code can be found in the following repository: https://github.com/MohammedOussamaBEN/GazeRefine.git
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GazeRefine:专家Gaze作为免费培训的试验时间提示
articles.content_zh: 医疗图像的分化仍然难以扩大,因为高性能的方法通常依赖于密集的专家说明和针对具体任务的培训。 我们引入了Gaze Refine,一个无训练的框架,它使用凝视作为零镜头医学图像分解的推断时间. Sparse,时间加权固定被转换为前地和背景前地,在被冻结的DINOv3特征空间中初始化语义原型. 这些原型通过前地-背景歧视、地物-空间亲和传播以及锚定在最初的视线取向而得到迭代地改进,使分化能够超越直接固定的区域,同时限制语义漂移。 GazeRefine 不需要分解口罩,微调,适配器,即时编码器,或梯度更新. 我们评估了凝视多肽分解和前列腺核磁共振分解的方法。 结果显示前列腺核磁共振的结肠镜镜片性能和竞争性性能,支持用目视指导改进原型,作为分片-标签-高效、人-在-在-在-在-在-在-医学图像分片的一种有希望的方法。 我们的工具和代码可在以下寄存器中找到:https://github.com/MohammedOussamaBEN/Gaze Refine.git。

articles.title: CMRVision: A Foundation Model for Cardiac MR Image Analysis
articles.content: Cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging provides complementary information on cardiac anatomy, function, and tissue characterization across multiple sequences and views. In this work, we investigate foundation model pretraining for 2D CMR and introduce CMRVision, a CMR-specific foundation model trained using DINOv3-style self-supervised learning on a multi-center, multi-sequence cohort of 36 million CMR images. We systematically evaluate architectural and training design choices for domain-specific pretraining. CMRVision is evaluated on two downstream tasks: multi-task segmentation across cine, late gadolinium enhancement (LGE), and mapping sequences, and cine view classification. Our experiments show that CMR-specific pretraining, smaller patch sizes, and patch-level objectives consistently improve downstream performance. Across a multi-task segmentation benchmark, CMRVision achieved the strongest overall performance, outperforming prior natural-image (NI), medical-image, supervised, and CMR foundation model baselines. Improvements were modest but consistent across structures and sequences, with Dice scores ranging from 0.940-0.967 for LV and 0.855-0.905 for myocardium, and reaching 0.929 for RV, 0.920 for LA, and 0.931 for RA. The largest gains were observed for myocardium segmentation in LGE and mapping images. In a zero-shot segmentation task on unseen LGE long-axis views, the model achieved an average Dice score of 0.692, demonstrating cross-view generalization. For cine view classification, CMRVision achieved the highest average accuracy (0.906), compared to prior methods reported in the literature. These results highlight the potential of CMRVision to support robust and generalizable cardiac MRI analysis across multiple sequences and views.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CMRVision:心脏MR图像分析的基础模型
articles.content_zh: 心磁共振成像(CMR)提供了跨越多序列和观点的心脏解剖学,功能和组织特征的互补信息. 在这项工作中,我们调查了2D CMR的基础模型预训,并引入了CMRVision,这是使用DINOv3风格的自我监督学习,在由3 600万个CMR图像组成的多中心、多序列组中培训的CMR特定的基础模型。 我们系统地评价特定领域预培训的建筑和培训设计选择。 CMRVision在两个下游任务上得到评价:跨焚化炉的多任务分解、后期加高法(LGE)和绘图序列和焚化取景分类。 我们的实验表明,针对遗留集束弹药的预训、较小的补丁尺寸和补丁水平的目标不断提高下游的性能。 在一个多任务划分基准中,CMRvision实现了最强的整体业绩,优于以前的自然形象(NI)、医疗形象、监督以及CMR基础模型基线。 改进幅度不大,但结构与顺序一致,Dice的得分从LV的0.940-0.967分和心肌的0.855-0.905分不等,RV的得分达到0.929分,LA的得分达到0.920分,RA的得分达到0.931分. 在LGE和绘图图像中,心肌分化的进展最大。 在无所见的LGE长轴视图上的零发分化任务中,该模型实现了平均得分0.692分,展现出跨视图通论. 就焚化视图分类而言,CMRVision与文献中报告的以往方法相比,实现了最高的平均准确度(0.906)。 这些结果突出表明了遗留集束弹药的愿景在支持对多个序列和观点进行有力而可概括的心脏核磁共振分析方面的潜力。

articles.title: MeshSplatBench: A Unified Benchmark for Triangle-Based Neural Rendering
articles.content: Triangle-based neural rendering bridges neural scene representations and conventional graphics pipelines by optimizing explicit geometric primitives compatible with standard rasterization hardware. However, existing approaches are evaluated almost exclusively within custom research renderers, obscuring their practical deployability in production engines. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{MeshSplatBench}, a unified benchmark that systematically investigates triangle-based neural rendering across the complete pipeline from native optimization to game-engine deployment. MeshSplatBench establishes a standardized evaluation protocol while preserving each method's native optimization semantics, reproducing published results within $0.8\%$ PSNR deviation. Furthermore, we introduce a hierarchical Unity deployment protocol spanning three rendering tiers: native CUDA renderers, method-specific dedicated engine shaders, and standard opaque mesh pipelines, isolating the exact fidelity losses caused by engine adaptation \textit{vs.} representation reduction. Finally, we conduct a topological audit of reconstructed surfaces, demonstrating that explicit connectivity and shared indexing alone are insufficient to guarantee production-ready assets due to prevalent non-manifold structures, fragmented components, and boundary artifacts. Overall, MeshSplatBench demonstrates that rasterizability is merely a primitive-level attribute, whereas graphics readiness requires jthe holistic alignment of representation, topology, and engine compatibility. Source code will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MeshSplate Bench:三角神经渲染的统一基准
articles.content_zh: 三角基神经渲染桥 神经场景表现和常规图形管道 通过优化与标准光栅化硬件相容的显式几何原始. 然而,对现行方法的评价几乎完全在定制研究渲染器内部进行,使其无法实际用于生产发动机。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了\textbf{MeshSplate Bench},这个统一的基准系统调查三角基神经渲染,跨越整个管道从本土优化到游戏引擎部署. MeshSplate Bench建立了标准化的评价协议,同时保留了每种方法的本土优化语义,在0.8\%$PSNR偏差范围内再现已发布的结果. 此外,我们引入了一个分级的团结部署协议,涵盖三个渲染层:本地的CUDA渲染器、特定方法的专用发动机遮蔽器、以及标准不透明的网状管,将发动机适应所造成准确的忠贞性损失隔离开来。 最后,我们对重建的地表进行地貌学审计,表明由于普遍存在的非狂犬病结构、零碎部件和边界文物,仅靠明确的连通性和共享索引不足以保证生产准备的资产。 总体而言,MeshSplate Bench表明可光度仅仅是一个原始层面的属性,而图形准备状态则需要代表、地形和引擎相容性的整体一致。 将发布源代码 。

articles.title: Agentic Multimodal Models for Environmental Hyperspectral Unmixing
articles.content: Hyperspectral unmixing is a key task in remote sensing that aims to decompose mixed pixels in hyperspectral images into their constituent material signatures, or endmembers, and their fractional abundances. Conventional modular approaches estimate the scene composition through successive model-order estimation, endmember extraction, and abundance estimation stages, whose errors can lead to redundant or ambiguous candidate components and ultimately affect the recovered decomposition. We introduce an algorithm-agnostic, large vision-language model (LVLM)-driven agentic framework that refines the outputs of such pipelines rather than replacing their underlying numerical algorithms. Starting from an initial decomposition, the agent iteratively gathers complementary spectral and spatial evidence through dedicated tools, including spectral-library retrieval and abundance-map visualization, and modifies the active endmember set through merge and discard operations followed by abundance re-estimation. We apply the same refinement procedure to several modular pipelines combining different model-order, extraction, and abundance-estimation methods, and evaluate it on HYDICE Urban, Jasper Ridge, and Stonewall Playa. Experiments show that the proposed agent consistently improves endmember cardinality and generally improves the recovered spectral signatures and abundance maps across heterogeneous modular pipelines, while remaining competitive with integrated end-to-end unmixing methods, including CNN-AE, uDAS, and R-CoNMF. These results highlight the potential of tool-using LVLM agents to combine spectral and spatial evidence for algorithm-agnostic refinement of physically grounded hyperspectral unmixing decompositions. Code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/agentic-hu.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 环境超光谱解密的代理模式
articles.content_zh: 超光谱解密是遥感中的一项关键任务,其目的是将超光谱图像中混合的像素分解成其组成材料签名,或最终成员,分数丰度. 常规模块化方法通过相继的模型-顺序估计,最终成员提取,和丰度估计等阶段来估计场景组成,其错误可能导致冗余或模棱两可的候选成分并会最终影响被恢复的分解. 我们引入了一个算法不可知的大型视觉语言模型(LVLM)驱动的代理框架,它改进了这种管道的输出,而不是取代其基本的数值算法. 从初始分解开始,物剂通过专用工具,包括光谱-图书馆检索和丰度-映射可视化,迭接地收集互补的光谱和空间证据,并通过合并和丢弃操作来修改活性端元组分,再进行丰度再估计. 我们把同样的改进程序应用于几个模块化管道,结合不同的模型顺序,取出,和丰度估计方法,并在HYDICE Urban, Jasper Ridge,和Stonewall Playa上评价. 实验表明,拟议制剂不断改善最终成员的基本性,并普遍改进各种模块化管道所回收的光谱特征和丰度图,同时保持对综合端到端无混合方法的竞争力,包括CNN-AE、uDAS和R-CoNMF。 这些结果凸显出工具使用LVLM剂结合光谱和空间证据的潜力,用于对物理上基的超光谱分解进行算法-可知性改进. 守则可在https://anonymous.4op.science/r/agentic-hu公开查阅。

articles.title: HiLRP: Toward One Trustworthy Explanation for Vision Transformer: Conservation-Valid Attribution via Attention Primitives
articles.content: Vision Transformer (ViT) design has become increasingly diverse, with backbones combining convolutional stems, windowed, linear, or multi-axis attention, patch merging, and spatial reduction in various configurations. This diversity poses challenges for existing attribution methods, whose assumptions often do not hold across ViT variants: Grad-CAM requires a terminal spatial feature map, attention rollout assumes global softmax attention, and layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) requires module-specific rules. To the best of our knowledge, no existing method provides a unified attribution framework across this architectural space. We show that this architectural diversity can be captured by a simpler underlying structure. The attention and resolution-reduction operators in current ViTs can be decomposed into four operation types: linear maps, bilinear mixing, normalization or gating, and reindexing. Each operation admits a relevance rule that satisfies conservation. Based on these rules, HiLRP supports new backbones by construction rather than by architecture-specific derivation, and its attribution maps decompose the prediction rather than relying on heuristic assumptions. We prove conservation and conditional equivariance and verify both to machine precision. Across 14 attribution methods and 10 architectures, we find that no prior method remains reliable across ViT families, while Faithfulness Correlation becomes uninformative for backbones robust to spatial masking. HiLRP alone preserves conservation across windowed, spatial-reduction, multi-axis, and linear-attention models, where naive extensions can produce zero or inflated relevance. It also localizes attribution failures in class activation mapping, achieving 0.97 Pointing compared with 0.55 for competing methods on EfficientViT.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HILRP:实现一个值得信赖的愿景变革者解释:通过关注的原始要素来保护-脆弱归属
articles.content_zh: 视觉变形器(ViT)设计越来越多样化,骨干结合了相生的起伏,入窗,线性,或多轴的注意,补丁合并,以及各种配置的空间缩小. 这种多样性对现有归属方法提出了挑战,这些方法的假设往往不跨越ViT变量: Grad-CAM需要一个终端空间地物图,注意力的展开假设全球软马克斯的注意力,而分层关联传播(LRP)则需要模块特定规则. 据我们所知,没有任何现有方法为整个建筑空间提供一个统一的归属框架。 我们显示,这种建筑多样性可以通过更简单的基础结构来捕捉. 当前ViTs中的注意力和分辨率还原操作符可以被分解为四种操作类型:线性映射,双线相混合,正态或成色,再索引. 每项行动都承认符合养护要求的相关规则。 基于这些规则,HiLRP支持新的骨干通过建筑而不是通过建筑特异性的衍生,它的归属图分解了预测而不是依赖高压假设. 我们证明了保存和有条件的等同性,并核实两者对机器的精确性。 在14个归属方法和10个架构中,我们发现,在ViT家族中,没有一种先前的方法仍然可靠,而信仰关联性则变得对强壮到空间遮盖的骨干来说是无信息可言的。 光是HILRP就保留了跨窗口的保存,空间缩小,多轴和线性注意模型,在这些模型中天真的扩展可以产生零或被夸大的相关性. 它还将类活性映射中的归属失败本地化,实现了0.97指向,而高效ViT上的竞争方法为0.55指向.

articles.title: TimeSteer: Inference-Time Speech Scheduling in Joint Audio-Visual Diffusion Models
articles.content: Although pretrained joint audio-visual diffusion models offer rich control over \emph{what} to generate, they provide no explicit control over \emph{when} an utterance should occur. To address this, we study \emph{inference-time speech scheduling}, a novel task that places coupled speech and visual articulation within user-specified begin--end intervals without finetuning the backbone model. We uncover two intrinsic properties of the denoising process that enable this task. First, a timing-sensitive text-to-audio cross-attention head exposes each utterance's model-implied source span along the latent timeline. Second, the predicted clean latent already organizes coupled speech and visual articulation, allowing their temporal placement to be edited without regenerating the content. Building on these discoveries, we propose \textbf{TimeSteer}, a training-free framework that localizes each utterance's source span through \textbf{Source Span Localization} and transfers the associated audio-visual latent content from the source interval to the specified target interval through \textbf{Region-Aware Latent Remapping}. We further introduce \textbf{SpeechShift}, the first benchmark for interval-level speech scheduling in joint audio-visual generation. Experiments across two representative backbones show that TimeSteer substantially improves interval controllability over training-free baselines while maintaining competitive overall generation quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TimeSteer: 联合视听传播模型中的推论-时间发言时间安排
articles.content_zh: 虽然预先训练的联合视听传播模型对要生成的\emph{什么}提供了丰富的控制,但是它们并没有对\emph{何时发表言论提供明确的控制. 为了解决这个问题,我们研究\emph{ inference-time speech Programme},这个新任务把组合的语音和视觉表达放在用户指定的起始端间隔内,而不微调主干模型. 我们发现了使这项任务得以完成的诽谤过程的两个内在性质。 首先,一个对文本到音频有时间敏感性的交叉注意头,会暴露每个言论的模型所隐含的源头沿潜在时间跨度. 第二,预测的清洁潜伏已经组织在一起的语音和视觉表达,允许在不重现内容的情况下编辑其时间位置。 在这些发现的基础上,我们提出\textbf{TimeSteer},一个无训练框架,通过\textbf{Span localization}将每个语音的源段本地化,并通过\textbf{Region-Aware Latent Remapping}将相关的视听潜在内容从源间隔转移到指定的目标间隔. 我们进一步引入\textbf{SpeechShift},这是联合视听生成中间隔级演讲排行的第一个基准. 跨越两个代表性主干线的实验显示,TimeSteer大大改进了对无培训基线的间隔可控性,同时保持了具有竞争力的整体生成质量.

articles.title: Seeing the World and the Self from Egocentric Video
articles.content: Complete 3D perception from egocentric video requires recovering the surrounding scene and the wearer's full-body motion in a shared metric frame. Existing methods typically address scene reconstruction and motion estimation separately: scene reconstruction methods ignore the wearer, whereas motion estimation methods lack explicit scene geometry and often depend on external trajectories. Joint recovery is challenging because the two tasks exhibit asymmetric visibility and require different prediction paradigms. The largely visible scene supports deterministic geometric regression, whereas the severely occluded body requires generative motion inference. We therefore propose RESELF (REconstructing the Scene and the sELF), a unified framework that couples deterministic metric geometry reconstruction with geometry-conditioned motion generation. RESELF adapts a geometry foundation model pre-trained on large-scale exocentric data to egocentric video using frame-wise scale and relative-pose consistency objectives. The resulting camera trajectory and latent geometric features condition a diffusion model that recovers the wearer's motion. A subsequent closed-loop kinematic feedback stage further refines the camera head while preserving the reconstructed scene geometry. To support training and evaluation, we curate EE4D-JSM from EgoExo4D by aligning egocentric video, sparse metric scene geometry, camera trajectories, and full-body motion annotations. Experiments show that RESELF outperforms state-of-the-art methods designed for the individual tasks across depth estimation, camera tracking, and full-body motion estimation. Code, models, and datasets will be available at https://ka1guan.github.io/RESELF/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从爱高中心视频中看到世界和自我
articles.content_zh: 从以自负为中心视频获得完整的3D感知需要恢复周围的场景和穿戴者在一个共享的度量框中全身运动. 现有方法通常分别处理场景重建与运动估计:场景重建方法忽略了穿戴者,而运动估计方法则缺乏明显的场景几何特征并往往依赖于外出出轨迹. 联合恢复具有挑战性,因为这两项任务显示出不对称的能见度,需要不同的预测范式. 基本可见的场景支持决定性的几何回归,而严重被占用的身体则需要基因运动推论. 因此,我们提议重建Scene和SELF,一个统一的框架,使确定性的计量几何重建与几何条件的运动产生相结合。 RESELF将一个在大规模外向数据上预先训练的几何基础模型,以使用帧相和相对可控一致性目标来适应自负心视频. 由此而来相机轨迹和潜入几何特征,将一个能使穿行者运动恢复的扩散模型作为条件. 随后的闭路动能回馈阶段在保留被重建的场景几何的同时会进一步完善相机头. 为了支持培训和评估,我们通过调整以自我为中心的视频、稀有的场景几何、相机轨迹和全身运动说明,从EgoExo4D对EE4D-JSM进行校正。 实验显示,RESELF超越了为个别任务设计的先进方法,跨越了深度估计,相机跟踪,以及全身运动估计. 代码、模型和数据集可在https://ka1guan.github.io/RESELF/上查阅。

articles.title: MeRoPE: Metric Rotary Position Embedding for Camera-Controlled Video Generation
articles.content: In camera-controlled video generation, geometry-aware positional encodings condition tokens on camera extrinsics and per-token viewing rays. Existing schemes, however, have a scale-dependent failure mode on real-world metric camera trajectories: homogeneous projective encodings cause attention logits and feature norms to grow unbounded with physical translation baselines. We propose MeRoPE (Metric Rotary Position Embedding), a norm-preserving relative camera encoding for attention. MeRoPE encodes relative orientations between calibrated viewing rays with orthogonal rotation blocks, maps raw metric displacements into multi-frequency rotary phases, and adds a disparity-anchored correspondence prior along the epipolar arc. This design strictly preserves feature norms, bounds pre-softmax attention logits regardless of the physical translation scale, and maintains exact invariance to global rigid coordinate changes. Across nuScenes and PanShot, which cover large-baseline trajectories and diverse camera optics, respectively, MeRoPE achieves stronger camera control than prior encodings, with the best consistency between generated camera motion and conditioning poses in both rotation and translation. Code will be made publicly available.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MeROPE:摄像头控制设备嵌入的量子旋转器位置 视频生成
articles.content_zh: 在相机控制的视频生成中,几何感知位置编码在相机外观和每根取景光上的条件符号. 然而,现有方案在现实世界的公制相机轨迹上有一个依赖规模的故障模式:同质的投影编码导致注意力记录和特征规范不受物理翻译基线约束地生长. 我们提议使用MeroPE(Metric Rotary Proposition Embedding),这是一种规范保存相机编码,以备注意. MeROPE将校准的取景射线与正向自转区块之间的相对取向编码,将原始的度量位移映射到多频回转相中,并会增加上下相差悬殊的相克. 这种设计严格保留了特征规范,无论物理翻译尺度如何,都会将预软马克斯注意记录限制在外,并保持了对全局刚性坐标变化的精确的偏差. 在分别覆盖了大底线轨迹和多相相机光学的NuScenes和PanShot上,MeRoPE实现了比前作编码更强大的相机控制,所生成相机运动和调制在旋转和翻译中都具有最佳的一致性. 守则将公布于众。

articles.title: One Prompt Is Enough: Watermark Laundering Through Foundation Image Models
articles.content: Invisible watermarks are typically evaluated against predefined perturbations such as compression, blur, noise, cropping, and denoising. Public foundation image models expose a distinct threat: an attacker can submit a watermarked image with a single reconstruction prompt and obtain a visually faithful output from which the invisible watermark can no longer be decoded reliably. We formalize this failure mode as watermark laundering and evaluate it using a joint payload-fidelity profile that combines bit error rate (BER) with visual and semantic preservation. Across six OpenAI and Google image editing models, three representative watermarking schemes, and 1,800 reconstructed outputs, we identify two complementary laundering regimes: OpenAI models produce the strongest payload disruption across the evaluated schemes, whereas Nano Banana 2 shows that DwtDct remains vulnerable under high-fidelity reconstruction. Prompt ablations show that no single removal-oriented instruction is necessary for payload disruption, indicating that the effect is primarily induced by the reconstruction pathway rather than by explicit attack wording. Comparisons with conventional attacks further show that prompt-conditioned reconstruction constitutes a distinct operational attack interface. These findings motivate foundation-model reconstruction as a missing robustness condition in invisible watermark evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: " 一个快就够了:通过基础图像模型进行水印清洗 "
articles.content_zh: 对隐形水印的评估通常以预先界定的扰动为标准,如压缩、模糊、噪音、收割和去诺等。 公用地基图像模型暴露出一个独特的威胁:攻击者可以提交一个带有水印的图像,一个单一的重建即时,并获得一个视觉上忠实的输出,从中无法再可靠地解码出无形的水印. 我们正式确定这种故障模式为水印清洗,并使用结合比特误差率(BER)与视觉和语义保存的联合载荷-真实性剖面来评价. 通过OpenAI和Google图像编辑模型、三个有代表性的水标记方案以及1 800个重建产出,我们确定了两个互补的洗钱制度: OpenAI模型在经过评价的计划中造成最大有效载荷中断,而Nano Banana 2显示,DwtDct在高纯度重建中仍然脆弱。 快速喷发表明,对有效载荷的干扰不需要单一的取出导向指示,这表明效应主要是由重建路径而不是明确的攻击措辞所引发的。 与常规攻击的比较进一步表明,迅速有条件的重建构成了独特的作战攻击接口. 这些结论激励了基础模型重建,将其作为隐形水印评价中缺失的坚固状态.

articles.title: S$^2$Prune: Spatially Structured Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.content: Visual token pruning reduces the inference overhead of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by retaining only a subset of visual tokens. Existing methods usually select tokens based on importance or redundancy. However, we observe that these criteria produce stable spatial biases across inputs and do not always outperform simple Uniform Grid sampling, highlighting the value of broad spatial coverage. Motivated by this, we propose S$^2$Prune, a training-free pruning method that preserves spatial coverage while adapting token density to local image structure. We first divide the image into regions and assign at least one token to each region to preserve coverage. The remaining token budget is then distributed according to Laplacian variation, giving more tokens to regions with richer structure. We then use Early Representation Change (ERC), computed from the first decoder block, to select representative tokens within each region. We evaluate S$^2$Prune across diverse settings and two MLLM architectures. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, it achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated training-free pruning methods. With only 32 of the original 576 visual tokens, it still retains 79.3% of the full-model performance. Code is available at https://github.com/yuanyuanjia71-spec/S2Prune.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: S$^2 普鲁恩 : 用于多式大型语文模型的空间结构可视化托肯
articles.content_zh: 视觉符号推敲只保留了可视符号的子集,从而减少了多式大型语言模型(MLLM)的推论间接. 现有方法通常根据重要性或冗余性选择符. 然而,我们注意到,这些标准在投入方面产生了稳定的空间偏差,并不总是比简单的统一网格取样好,突出了广泛空间覆盖的价值。 以此为动机,我们提议采用S$^2$Prune,这是一种无培训的穿插方法,既能保持空间覆盖,又能使信使密度适应当地图像结构. 我们首先将图像分成几个区域,并为每个区域至少分配一个标志,以保持覆盖面。 其余的象征性预算随后按照拉普拉西亚的变异进行分配,使结构更丰富的地区获得更多的象征. 然后,我们使用从第一个解码器区块计算的早期代表变化(ERC)在每个区域内选择具有代表性的标志。 我们评价各种环境的S$^2Prune和两种MLLM架构. 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上,它实现了被评价的无培训穿梭方法中最高的平均精度. 原576个视觉道具中只有32个,仍然保留了79.3%的全模性能. 代码见https://github.com/yuanyanjia71-spec/S2Prune.

articles.title: Compressing AI Traffic: Standardized Neural Network Coding of Visual-Token Representations in Split Vision-Language Inference
articles.content: When the visual encoder and the language decoder of a vision-language model (VLM) run on different compute nodes, the intermediate visual-token embeddings become a communicated payload rather than an internal activation. We call such machine-consumed intermediate tensors AI traffic and ask how far they can be compressed with a standardized, training-free codec. We insert ISO/IEC 15938-17 Neural Network Coding (NNC) round trips on the complete visual interface of a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct video question answering pipeline, comprising the main visual-token representation and the DeepStack feature streams, while leaving weights, prompts, and generation untouched, and sweep the quantization parameter (QP) over a wide rate range. Closed-ended Video-MME accuracy remains close to the uncompressed reference up to a 98% reduction of the transmitted BF16 tensor and only then collapses; open-ended MLVU generation shows the same plateau-and-collapse profile under an LLM judge. This robustness is not due to near-lossless reconstruction: the decoded tensor is heavily discretized, carries substantial row-wise relative L2 error, and has a visibly steeper singular-value decay than its source. Downstream reasoning therefore depends on coarse structure and relative geometry rather than exact floating-point values, which argues for rate-task rather than rate-distortion optimization of AI traffic codecs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 压缩AI交通:分化视野-语言推论中视觉-托肯表现的标准化神经网络编码
articles.content_zh: 当一个视觉语言模型(VLM)的视觉编码器和语言解码器运行于不同的计算节点时,中间可视-托克嵌入会变成一个通信有效载荷而不是内部活化. 我们称这种机器消耗的中间收发器为AI流量,并询问用标准化的,无培训的编码器可以压缩到多远. 我们插入 ISO/IEC 15938-17 神经网络编码(NNC) 环行在 Qwen3-VL-8B-指令视频问题回答管道的完整视觉界面上,包括主要视觉脚趾表示和 DepStack 特性流,同时留下重量,提示和生成未被改变,并扫取分数参数(QP)的广速范围. 闭合的Video-MME精度仍然接近未被压缩的参考值,直到传输的BF16收音机减少98%,然后才倒塌;开放的MLVU一代在LLM判断器下显示出相同的高地相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接. 这种稳健性并非由近乎无损失的重建所造成:解码的收音机被大量盘片化,携带着大量的行向相对的L2误差,且其单值衰变明显比其出处更陡峭. 因此下游推理依赖于粗糙的结构和相对几何,而不是精确的浮点值,它主张对AI流量编码器进行率-任务而不是率-扭曲优化.

articles.title: Monocular Depth Estimation from a Single Image: Progress and Opportunities
articles.content: Monocular depth estimation has long stood as a fundamental challenge in computer vision, enabling a wide range of applications including 3D reconstruction, robotics, autonomous driving, and augmented reality. This survey traces the field's evolution from early learning-based methods to the emergence of transformative foundation models. We begin by framing the problem, distinguishing between relative and metric depth estimation, and highlighting the key challenges that have shaped a decade of research. We then present common problem formulations and introduce the most widely used datasets, covering indoor, outdoor, and synthetic data. Following this, we review major advances prior to the foundation model era, distilling core insights from influential methods that contributed to improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and robustness. The survey then turns to the recent surge of foundation-model-based approaches, categorizing them into discriminative and generative paradigms and emphasizing the critical roles of large-scale pretraining (e.g., DINOv3) and synthetic data. We compare representative models using both quantitative benchmarks and qualitative examples, and discuss natural extensions to video-based depth estimation. Further, to illustrate real-world impact, we highlight the integration of depth estimation into applications such as visual SLAM, content generation, and robot perception. Finally, we outline open challenges and promising research directions as the field advances further into the era of foundation models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 单相图的深度估计:进步与机遇
articles.content_zh: 单体深度估计长期以来一直是计算机愿景中的一项根本挑战,它使各种应用得以实现,包括3D重建、机器人、自主驾驶和增强现实。 这项调查追溯了该领域从以早期学习为基础的方法到变革性基础模型的出现的演变. 我们首先阐述这一问题,区分相对深度估计和度量深度估计,并突出研究十年的主要挑战。 然后,我们提出共同的问题配方,引入最广泛使用的数据集,涵盖室内、室外和合成数据。 在此之后,我们回顾在基础模型时代之前的重大进展,从有影响力的方法中提炼出有助于提高准确性、效率和稳健性的核心见解。 然后,调查转向最近以基础模式为基础的方法的激增,将它们分为歧视性和分族性范式,并强调了大规模预先训练(如DINOv3)和合成数据的关键作用。 我们利用定量基准和定性实例比较具有代表性的模型,并讨论以视频为基础的深度估计的自然延伸。 此外,为了说明现实世界的影响,我们强调将深度估计纳入视觉SLAM、内容生成和机器人感知等应用。 最后,当实地进一步进入基础模型时代时,我们概述了公开的挑战和有希望的研究方向。

articles.title: Dotting the Eye: An Intent-Driven Image Retouching Agent for Visual Focus Enhancement
articles.content: Image retouching is commonly formulated as enhancing overall visual quality through color adjustment, but in practice, it also serves to emphasize visual focus by guiding viewers' attention toward a specific subject or region. Achieving such focus-oriented retouching is inherently challenging, as it requires well-coordinated global and local adjustments to manipulate perceptual saliency while maintaining visual naturalness. This intricate process typically demands substantial professional expertise. In this study, we propose EyeControl, a MLLM-driven agent with a diffusion-based retouching executor that enables visual focus enhancement under weak user intent. With only a few clicks or coarse strokes, EyeControl directs visual attention to the intended region, effectively "dotting the eye" of the image. The core idea is to explicitly link the weak user intention with the target editing region and the corresponding tonal adjustment operations during retouching. To achieve this, the system first interprets the intent and image content to infer the visual focus and generate structured intent guidance for the retouching executor. Second, the retouching executor is encouraged to respond more strongly to the target region, explicitly aligning its attention map with a designed pseudo-intent map. We also introduce an operation-consistency constraint to improve coordination between global and local adjustments, achieving more natural and coherent retouching. Additionally, we contribute ControlArt-Bench, a high-quality evaluation dataset for visual focus enhancement. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that EyeControl yields perceptually appealing results with stronger intent alignment. Code can be found in https://github.com/DragonisCV/EyeControl.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Dotting the Eye: 用于视觉焦点增强的内向驱动图像
articles.content_zh: 图像回触通常被表述为通过色彩调整来提高整体视觉质量,但实际上,它也通过引导观众关注特定主题或区域来强调视觉焦点. 实现这种注重重点的重新调整本身就具有挑战性,因为它需要经过妥善协调的全球和地方调整,在保持视觉自然性的同时操纵知觉的显著性。 这一复杂的进程通常需要大量的专业知识。 在这项研究中,我们提出"眼睛控制"(Eye Control),这是一种由MLLM驱动的剂,具有基于扩散的再检修执行器,能够在弱用户意图下增强视觉焦点. 只有几下点击或粗糙的中风后,"眼控"将视觉注意力引导到预定区域,有效地"打倒了"图像"的眼睛. 核心思想是将弱用户意图与目标编辑区和相应的调整调整操作在重修过程中明确联系起来. 为了实现这一点,系统首先解释意图和图像内容,推断出视觉焦点,并生成结构化的意向指南来为重触执行器提供. 第二,鼓励重新调整的执行者对目标区域作出更强烈的反应,明确使其注意地图与设计出的假意图相配合。 我们还实行行动一致性限制,以改善全球和地方调整之间的协调,实现更自然、更一致的调整。 此外,我们还提供ControlArt-Bench,这是一个用于增强视觉焦点的高质量评价数据集。 广泛的评价表明,眼控产生明显具有吸引力的结果,其意图更加一致。 代码可见于https://github.com/DragonisCV/Eye Control.

articles.title: On the Design Fundamentals of Pixel Text Representation Learning
articles.content: Text-rich visual inputs require models that can read, retrieve, and compress language directly in pixel space, yet existing pixel-text encoders struggle with fixed resolution pretraining, visual shortcut learning, weak visual grounding, and multilingual visual text understanding. In this work, we investigate the fundamental design principles required for robust visual text representation learning. Through systematic controlled ablations, we identify four critical components: variable image resolutions and rendered font sizes provide spatial proxies for high-resolution document generalization; natural image-text pairs are indispensable for grounding and prevent text-only collapse; layout-aware rendering helps prevent pixel-level shortcuts; and a two-stage multilingual curriculum enables effective cross-lingual alignment. By integrating these principles into a scalable training recipe, we train Pixel Linguist II, a native-resolution vision encoder trained with on-the-fly rendering, unified contrastive grounding, and a multilingual curriculum over 280M training examples. Pixel Linguist II sets new state-of-the-art results on English, cross-lingual, and multilingual Visual STS and ViDoRe, while also enabling better MLLM downstream evaluation. Notably, Pixel Linguist II remains robust under 80\% visual token compression, showing great promise for optical context compression. Our code and resources are available at https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 关于像素文字表现学习的设计基础
articles.content_zh: 文本丰富的视觉输入需要能够直接以像素空间读取,取回,并压缩语言的模型,而现有的像素文本编码器则与固定的分辨率预训,视觉快捷学习,视觉地面薄弱,以及多语言的视觉文本理解相抗衡. 在这项工作中,我们调查了有力视觉文字表现学习所需的基本设计原则. 通过系统化可控活化,我们确定了四个关键组成部分:可变图像分辨率和使字体大小为高分辨率文档通俗化提供空间代名词;天然图像文本对地平地和防止文本只倒塌不可或缺;布局感知渲染有助于防止像素级快捷键;两阶段多语种课程可以实现有效的跨语言对接. 通过将这些原则纳入可扩展的训练食谱,我们培训了Pixel Linguist II,一个本土分辨率的视觉编码器,经过飞行渲染,统一对比地基的训练,以及一个超过280M训练实例的多语种课程. Pixel Linguist II为英语,跨语言,多语种Visual STS和ViDoRe设定了新的最先进的成绩,同时也使得MLLM更能下游评价. 值得注意的是,Pixel Linguist II在80-Q视觉符号压缩下仍然很强壮,显示出光学上下文压缩的巨大希望. 我们的代码和资源可查阅https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II.

articles.title: StainPresetNet: Stain Preset Network for Fast Multi-to-Multi Stain Normalization
articles.content: Stain normalization reduces color variations caused by variations in staining protocols and imaging conditions, thereby enhancing computer-aided diagnostic system performance. Traditional methods derive mapping relationships from individual or limited reference images through pixel-wise transformation, offering style flexibility but suffering from inaccurate color mapping extraction. While existing deep-learning-based approaches achieve accurate dataset-wide color mapping through complex neural networks, they face challenges including computational inefficiency, artifact generation, and fixed normalization directions requiring model retraining for directional changes. To address these limitations, we propose StainPresetNet - a novel framework that combines structural preservation with dataset-level color mapping while maintaining computational efficiency. Our method implements pixel-wise normalization guided by preset reference images, enabling multi-directional adaptability without retraining. Evaluations on cytopathology and histopathology datasets demonstrate that StainPresetNet achieves superior color mapping accuracy compared to conventional methods, effectively improves classifier generalization in diagnostic tasks, and reduces computational overhead by 90\% versus existing deep learning approaches. The proposed preset-guided mechanism facilitates flexible adjustment of normalization directions through simple reference image replacement, overcoming the directional rigidity of current deep-learning-based solutions.

articles.content_zh: 沉积正常化会减少由污渍协议和成像条件的变化所引发的颜色变化,从而增强计算机辅助的诊断系统性能. 传统方法通过像素相感转换从个人或有限的参考图像中获取出映射关系,提供了风格上的灵活性,但遭受了不准确的色彩映射提取. 虽然现有的以深入学习为基础的方法通过复杂的神经网络实现准确的数据集全色映射,但它们面临各种挑战,包括计算效率低下、人工生成和固定的正常化方向,需要模式再培训以进行方向变化。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议StainPresetNet——一个新颖的框架,将结构保存与数据集水平的色彩映射相结合,同时保持计算效率. 我们的方法在预先设定的参考图像的指导下,执行像素相向正常化,使多方向的适应性不需再培训。 对细胞病理学与组织病理学数据集的评价表明,与传统方法相比,StainPresetNet实现了优异的色彩映射精度,有效地改善了诊断任务中的分类通俗化,相对于现有的深层学习方法,计算间接费用减少了90-Q. 拟议的预设指导机制通过简单的参考图像替换,便利了正常化方向的灵活调整,克服了当前以深入学习为基础的解决方案的方向僵化.

articles.title: Revisiting Face Recognition for Monozygotic Twins: The Celeb Twins Test Set
articles.content: Past literature on face recognition for monozygotic (("identical") twins points to facial marks and mirror asymmetry as possible directions for improved accuracy of twins recognition. The Celeb Twins Test Set (CTTS) contains web-scraped image pairs for 80 sets of celebrity twins. It is the only twins test set with meta-data for twins with distinguishing skin marks and possible mirror asymmetry. CTTS is organized in the manner of face verification test sets such as LFW, CALFW, CPLFW, CFP-FP, and AgeDB-30. Current deep CNN matchers can achieve over 76% accuracy in classifying CTTS same-person / different-person image pairs. We show that current matchers do not make use of skin marks, or asymmetry, and discuss reasons for this. Finally, we discuss the feasibility of using generative AI tools such as Grok, ChatGPT and Gemini to create images of imagined monozygotic twins as a means to increase representation of twins in face recognition training sets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重新审视对单曲的面部识别 双胞胎: Celeb 双胞胎测试集
articles.content_zh: 以往关于单子对双胞胎的面部识别("同")的文献指出面部标记和镜像不对称是提高双胞胎识别精度的可能方向. Celeb双胞胎测试集(CTTS)包含了80组名人双胞胎的被网络拼接的图像对. 这是唯一一套双胞胎测试,对双胞胎进行元数据,并有明显的皮肤痕迹和可能的镜像不对称。 CTTS的组织方式为面相验证测试集,如LFW,CLFW,CPLFW,CFP-FP,和AgeDB-30等. 目前深有线电视新闻网的配对者在对同人/同人图像对进行分类时可以达到超过76%的精度. 我们显示,目前的配对者不使用皮肤标记或不对称,并讨论原因。 最后,我们讨论了使用Grok,ChatGPT和双子座等基因化AI工具,来制作想象中的单子体双胞胎形象的可行性,以此在面对识别培训集中增加双子体的代表性.

articles.title: Different Changes Require Different Reasoning: Change-Type-Specialized Experts for Robust Change Captioning
articles.content: Change captioning is the task of generating natural language descriptions that explain the changes between a pair of images. Although different change types (e.g., color shifts, object additions) exhibit distinct visual cues and require specialized reasoning processes, existing methods often overlook these distinctions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Expert Diagnosis for Image Change (MEDIC), a novel framework that introduces change-type awareness by explicitly modeling change categories. MEDIC employs type-specialized memory experts that dynamically retrieve type-relevant visual patterns conditioned on the input. This design enables each expert to capture diverse variations within its change type while focusing on the most informative visual cues. By softly routing inputs across type-specialized experts and learning dedicated representations for each change category, MEDIC generates more precise and type-aware change descriptions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed MEDIC consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse and challenging datasets. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/MEDIC}{GitHub}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 不同的变化需要不同的 理由: 强力改变说明专家
articles.content_zh: 更改标题是生成解释一对图像之间变化的自然语言描述的任务. 虽然不同的变化类型(例如:色调变化,对象添加)表现出了不同的视觉提示并需要专门的推理过程,但现有的方法往往忽略了这些区别. 为了解决这一局限性,我们提议进行图像变化的多专家诊断(MEDIC),这是一个新颖的框架,通过明确模拟变化类别,引入了变化类型的意识. MEDIC雇用了以输入为条件的动态检索类型相关视觉模式的型号专用内存专家. 这种设计使每位专家能够捕捉其变化类型中的各种变化,同时注重最丰富的视觉提示。 通过轻而易举地跨出类型专业专家的路由输入和学习每个变化类别的专用表述,MEDIC生成更加精确和有类型意识的变化描述. 广泛的实验表明,拟议的MEDIC在各种具有挑战性的数据集方面一直比现有方法好。 该代码可在\href{https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/MEDIC}{GitHub}获得.

articles.title: P-PatchDiff: Progressive Patch Diffusion Models for Low-light Image Enhancement
articles.content: Recent advancements in low-light image enhancement have leveraged diffusion models for their strong ability to generate perceptually realistic, detailed images. Patch diffusion models further offer a promising solution to size-agnostic image restoration while improving efficiency. However, existing methods typically rely on small, fixed patches (e.g., 64$\times$64) that cannot capture image-level brightness context, whereas enlarging the receptive field improves brightness and colour estimation but substantially increases computational cost. Moreover, low-light images often exhibit uneven brightness across regions, making it necessary to ensure that locally enhanced patches remain visually coherent when combined into the full image. To address these limitations, we propose P-PatchDiff, a scalable progressive patch diffusion framework for low-light image enhancement that dynamically adjusts patch size throughout the denoising process, enabling a gradual shift from local to global views. A Multi-Patch Alignment strategy is also introduced to normalise features across varying patch scales using an estimated global brightness proxy. Rather than pursuing pixel-level reconstruction accuracy, P-PatchDiff focuses on scalability and coherent brightness across the whole image, allowing the model to perceive multi-scale information and better enhance regions with varying brightness. We empirically demonstrate that P-PatchDiff effectively enhances images ranging from 400 $\times$ 600 to 4K and is 80$\times$ faster than existing patch diffusion models while using less than 9GB of memory. The code is available at https://github.com/RuoyuGuo/P-PatchDiff.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: P- PatchDiff: 用于低光度图像增强的渐进补丁扩散模型
articles.content_zh: 近期在低光度图像增强方面的进步,利用了传播模型,使其具有强大的能力,能够产生感知现实而详细的图像。 补丁扩散模型进一步为大小不可知图像恢复提供了有希望的解决办法,同时提高效率。 然而,现有方法通常依赖于小而固定的补丁(例如64美元\times64美元),这些补丁不能捕捉到图像水平亮度上下文,而扩大可接受域则能提高亮度和色彩估计,但会大大增加计算成本. 此外,低光度图像往往在各区域显示出不均匀的亮度,因此有必要确保当地增强的补丁在组合成完整图像时保持视觉上的一致性。 为解决这些局限性,我们提出P-PatchDiff,即低光影像增强可扩展的渐进补丁扩散框架,在整个去诺化过程中能动态地调整补丁大小,从而能够从局部视角逐渐转向全球视角. 此外,还采用了多批量对接战略,利用估计的全球亮度代用,使各种补丁尺度的特性正常化。 P-PatchDiff不追求像素级重建精度,而是注重整个图像的可伸缩性和连贯亮度,使模型能够感知多尺度信息并更好地增强具有不同亮度的区域. 我们实证地证明,P-PatchDiff能有效地增强从400美元\times600到4K的图像,并且比现有的补丁扩散模型快80美元\times$,同时使用不到9GB的内存. 该代码可在https://github.com/RuoyuGuo/P-PatchDiff上查阅.

articles.title: When Modality Gap Reduction Fails: Prediction-Level Hubness in CLIP
articles.content: Reducing the modality gap between image and text representations in CLIP is widely expected to improve cross-modal alignment and downstream performance. However, a smaller average image-text gap does not necessarily lead to consistent accuracy gains. We analyze this mismatch from the perspective of the decision structure in zero-shot classification, i.e. selecting the most similar class-text prototype for an input image. Zero-shot accuracy depends not only on average image--text alignment, but also on class-wise decision margins. Using Linear correction as an analytically tractable case, we show that modality gap correction can alter the relative decision structure among classes and cause predictions to concentrate on a small subset of classes. We refer to this output-space failure mode as prediction-level hubness. Furthermore, experiments across multiple datasets show that accuracy degradation under gap correction is consistently associated with increased prediction concentration, both for Linear correction and for learning-based correction methods. This provides a systematic explanation of why modality gap reduction does not consistently improve CLIP zero-shot accuracy from the perspective of downstream decision structure. Our results suggest that gap correction should be evaluated not only by average alignment, but also by its impact on downstream prediction structure.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当减少模式差距失败时:预测CLIP中的水平枢纽
articles.content_zh: 广泛预计,减少CLIP中图像和文字表述之间的模式差距将改善跨模式的对接和下游性能。 然而,一个较小的图像文本平均差距并不一定导致一致的准确性提高。 我们从零发分类中决策结构的角度来分析这种不匹配,即为输入图像选择最相近的类文本原型. 0射入精度不仅取决于平均图像-文本对齐,还取决于分级决定边距. 使用线性修正作为可分析可引导的案例,我们显示模式差距修正可以改变类别之间的相对决定结构,并导致预测集中在一个小的子类上. 我们把这种输出-空间故障模式称为预测级中枢. 此外,跨多套数据集的实验表明,在差分校正下准确度的下降与预测浓度的提高有关,无论是线性校正还是以学习为基础的校正方法。 这从下游决策结构的角度来看,系统地解释了为什么减少模式差距不能持续提高CLIP零发精度。 我们的结果表明,不仅应当通过平均调整,而且应当通过对下游预测结构的影响来评估差距的纠正。

articles.title: IT-TextFusion: Iterative Text-Image Interaction with Text-Guided Residual Refinement for Degradation-Aware Image Fusion
articles.content: Text-guided image fusion has recently emerged as an effective paradigm for integrating multi-modal information while enabling flexible and task-oriented fusion control. However, existing text-guided fusion methods often rely on shallow semantic-visual interaction and limited attention mechanisms, which restrict their ability to robustly handle complex degradations and fully exploit textual guidance. In this paper, we propose an iterative text-guided image fusion framework that incorporates text-conditioned feature interaction across multiple fusion and refinement stages. The proposed method integrates deepest-level Cross-Attention, multi-scale Cross-Gate Fusion, and stage-specific text-conditioned modulation, allowing the global text embedding to condition hierarchical feature fusion and residual refinement. By repeatedly injecting the pooled text embedding across hierarchical decoder and refinement stages, the proposed framework provides degradation-aware global semantic conditioning while preserving complementary information from the visible and infrared modalities. Experiments on several benchmark datasets show that the proposed method improves several information-preservation and perceptual-quality metrics, while exhibiting metric-dependent trade-offs on some datasets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: IT-图解: 与文本指导的残余物的迭代文本图像互动
articles.content_zh: 最近出现了以文字指导的图像组合,作为整合多模式信息的有效范例,同时能够进行灵活和以任务为导向的组合控制。 然而,现有的以文字为导的聚变方法往往依赖于浅浅的语义-视觉相互作用和有限的关注机制,这限制了它们有力处理复杂的降解并充分利用文字指导的能力. 在本文中,我们提出一个迭代的以文字指导的图像融合框架,其中包含多个聚和完善阶段的文字条件特征互动。 拟议方法整合了最深层的交叉连接,多尺度的交叉连接,以及阶段性文本条件化的调制,使得全球文本可以嵌入来作为分级特征聚和和剩余完善的条件. 拟议的框架通过反复插入嵌入分级解码和完善阶段的集合文本,提供了具有降解意识的全球语义条件,同时保留了来自可见和红外模式的补充信息。 几个基准数据集的实验表明,拟议方法改进了几个信息保存和感知质量度量衡,同时在一些数据集上展现出依赖计量的取舍.

articles.title: Let Confidence Change, Not the Prediction: Prediction-Preserving Repair for Post-hoc Calibration
articles.content: Post-hoc calibration corrects reported confidence, yet a multiclass calibrator can also change the associated top-1 prediction. Accuracy captures only the net effect of these changes on correctness, not how often predictions change; the Top-1 Prediction Change Rate (TPCR) instead measures this frequency. We propose Calibrator-Output Repair for Top-1 Decision Preservation (CORD), the first post-fit adapter to impose exact prediction preservation by repairing the full calibrated probability vector. From the original and calibrated outputs alone, CORD determines the mass assigned to the original top-1. The calibrated conditional distribution allocates the remaining mass over the other classes, yielding a repaired vector whose own argmax recovers the original prediction. On the calibration split, CORD coordinates the repaired masses to retain the calibrated outputs' mean mass on original predictions whenever attainable. The adapter alters neither the fitted calibrator nor its direct output, fits no additional supervised map, and requires no user- or validation-tuned hyperparameter. Across CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet-1K, CORD attains zero TPCR by construction and lowers mean ECE, NLL, and Brier relative to the corresponding direct outputs in every dataset; paired gains persist under distribution shift and across calibration-set sizes. CORD thus removes the preservation constraint from calibrator fitting and assigns exact recovery of the original decision to subsequent output repair. Our code is available at https://github.com/labhai/ORCU.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 让信心改变, 非预设:预设-预预留修复后校正
articles.content_zh: 后高分校正纠正了所报的置信度,然而多等分校正器也可以改变相联的上一预测. 准确性只捕捉这些变化对正确性的净影响,而不是预测变化的频率;Top-1预测变化率(TPCR)取而代之地测量这种频率. 我们提议对顶端-1决定保存进行校正-输出修复(CORD),这是第一个通过修复全校正概率矢量来强制进行精确预测保存的后适应器. 仅从原始和校正的输出,CORD确定分配给原始顶一的质量. 被校正的有条件分布将剩余质量分配到其他类,产生一个被修复的矢量,它自己的克马斯恢复了原来的预测. 在校正分解时,CORD协调被修复的质地,以保留校正输出物的平均值,只要可以实现原始预测。 适配器既不能改变装配的算法,也不能改变其直接输出,不适应附加的有监督的地图,而且不需要用户或验证的超参数。 在整个CIFAR-10/100和ImageNet-1K中,CORD通过建造达到零TPCR,相对于每个数据集的相应直接产出而言,CEE、NLL和Brier都是零;配对收益在分配变化和校准设定大小之间持续存在。 因此,CORD消除了在加热器安装上的保存限制,并将原决定的确切恢复分配给随后的产出修复。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/labhai/ORCU上查阅。

articles.title: Lightweight Interpretable RGB-Guided Hyperspectral Super-Resolution under Real Cross-resolution Misalignment
articles.content: Compact snapshot hyperspectral cameras provide rich instantaneous spectral measurements for ground-level machine vision, but at lower spatial resolution than standard RGB cameras. RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution (HSR) addresses this limitation by transferring spatial detail from a high-resolution RGB guide to a low-resolution hyperspectral image (HSI). These dual-camera systems are typically in a horizontal rig geometry, requiring cross-camera image alignment due to different fields of view. However, residual misregistration can inject spurious high-frequency details. Existing learned unaligned-fusion methods are usually trained for a fixed spectral support and spatial scale factors and can be computationally demanding, limiting their flexibility across sensors. We propose a lightweight and interpretable RGB-guided HSR framework combining cross-modal flow alignment with model-based Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization fusion. The method first warps the RGB guide onto the HSI grid, then estimates an energy-based confidence weight map by measuring local alignment reliability. This map is then used both in a weighted least-squares spectral regression and in a gated fusion between the super-resolved estimate and an HSI-preserving estimate. Unlike existing learned methods, the proposed framework has a low computational footprint and supports VIS-NIR spectral supports and scale factors without retraining. Experiments on the Real benchmark show that the proposed method improves reconstruction accuracy over learned fusion baselines while remaining substantially faster. On a 34-frame sequence acquired with our real RGB-HSI dual-camera setup, a reduced-resolution quantitative evaluation validates the method under genuine cross-sensor radiometric, noise, and geometric differences, while native-resolution qualitative results demonstrate deployment on the full 51-band VIS-NIR acquisition.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 轻量级可解释 RGB- Guided 超光谱超分辨率 Real- Crossion 错配
articles.content_zh: 压缩快照高光谱相机为地平面机视提供丰富的瞬时光谱测量,但空间分辨率低于标准的RGB相机. RGB导取高光谱超分辨率(HSR)通过将空间细节从高分辨率RGB导取到低分辨率高光谱成像(HSI)来解决这一限制. 这些双相机系统一般处于水平钻机几何状态,由于视野不同,需要跨相机图像对接. 然而,残余的错误登记可能会注入虚假的高频细节. 现有所学不相通的聚变方法通常为固定的光谱支持和空间尺度因子而得到训练,并且可以计算要求,限制了它们跨传感器的灵活性. 我们建议采用轻量级和可解释的RGB制导HSR框架,将跨模式流与基于模型的Gram-Schmidt正交化聚变相结合。 该方法首先将 RGB 指南向 HSI 网格上扭曲,然后通过测量局部对齐可靠性来估计出以能为基础的置信量重图. 然后,这张地图既用于加权最小平方光谱回归,也用于超解估计和HSI-保留估计之间的入门聚变。 与已学到的方法不同,拟议框架的计算足迹较低,支持VIS-NIR光谱支持和尺度因子不作再培训. 关于Real基准的实验表明,拟议方法比学到的聚变基线提高了重建的准确性,同时保持了相当快的速度。 在通过我们真正的RGB-HSI双相机设置而获得的34个范围序列上,一个分辨率降低的定量评价在真正的跨传感器辐射、噪音和几何差异下验证了该方法,而本土分辨率的定性结果则表明在51个波段的VIS-NIR全集上进行了部署。

articles.title: Dyn-3D: Unveiling and Resolving Ego-Motion Ambiguity in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) tackle dynamic 3D spatial reasoning, ego-motion perception becomes essential to resolve monocular scale ambiguity. However, current models often overfit to smooth trajectory priors rather than genuinely understanding physical motion. Consequently, their spatial reasoning degrades severely under large displacements, a phenomenon we term Kinematic Collapse. This failure stems from spurious visual-motion correlations in natural videos and a lack of explicit physical supervision. To evaluate this, we introduce Dyn-3D, a benchmark using counterfactual 3D rendering to rigorously decouple visual changes from true kinematic properties. Furthermore, we propose the TempoVista framework, featuring the Kinematic-GSPO algorithm. By embedding metric physical ground truth into policy optimization, TempoVista explicitly grounds visual representations in 3D space. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves both motion estimation and robust spatial reasoning by utilizing camera dynamics as an effective geometric calibration signal.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Dyn-3D:在视觉语言模型中解析和解决Ego-Motion 假象
articles.content_zh: 由于Visual-Langage Models(VLMs)解决了动态的3D空间推理,自我-运动感知对于解决单体尺度模糊性变得至关重要. 然而,目前的模型往往过于适合平滑轨道前行,而不是真正理解物理运动。 因此,它们的空间推理在大规模迁移中严重地退化,我们称之为 " Kinematic Collapse " 。 这一失败源于自然视频中虚假的视觉-运动关联和缺乏明确的物理监督. 为了评价这一点,我们引入了Dyn-3D,这个基准使用反事实 3D 渲染来严格地将视觉变化从真正的运动属性中解开. 此外,我们提出了TempoVista框架,其特点是Kinematic-GSPO算法。 TempoVista通过将衡量物理地面的真相纳入政策优化,明确将视觉表现置于3D空间。 实验表明,我们的方法通过利用相机动力学作为有效的几何校正信号,大大改进了运动估计和稳健的空间推理。

articles.title: SAGE: Subpopulation-Aware Generative Enhancement for Mitigating Spurious Correlations
articles.content: Spurious correlations pose a significant challenge to the robustness of modern machine learning. The inherent imbalance in dataset distributions often leads traditional Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) models to rely on majority spurious attributes for classification, resulting in poor performance on minority groups. This problem becomes particularly challenging when the spurious attributes are unavailable. Existing group-label-free methods often upsample minority groups or misclassified real training examples; repeating the same instances can reduce effective diversity and encourage overfitting. To mitigate these spurious correlations from a data-centric perspective in the absence of prior knowledge, we introduce Subpopulation-Aware Generative Enhancement (SAGE), a two-stage generative augmentation framework. Using cluster-derived sub-labels and class labels, we fine-tune a conditional generative model and text encoder, generating targeted synthetic data to fill underrepresented regions in the training set and construct a balanced validation set for last-layer reweighting. We experimentally show that SAGE achieves 89.5%, 85.7%, and 79.1% worst-group accuracy on Waterbirds, CelebA, and MetaShift, respectively, outperforming the best group-label-free baselines by up to 7.7 percentage points.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SAGE: 缓解纯洁关联的亚人口- 智能基因增强
articles.content_zh: 纯粹的关联性对现代机器学习的稳健性提出了重大挑战. 数据集分布的内在不平衡往往导致传统的经验风险最小化模型依赖大多数虚假属性进行分类,导致少数群体表现不佳. 在缺乏虚假属性的情况下,这一问题变得特别具有挑战性。 现有的无团体标签方法往往会增加少数群体的样本或错误地分类真正的培训实例;重复同样的例子会减少有效的多样性,并鼓励过度调整。 为了在缺乏事先知识的情况下从以数据为中心的角度来减轻这些虚假的关联,我们引入了亚人口-智能基因增强(SAGE),即分基因增强的两级框架. 使用集群衍生子标签和类标签,我们微调了有条件的基因模型和文本编码器,生成有针对性的合成数据来填补培训集中代表性不足的区域,并构建了用于上层再加权的平衡验证集. 我们的实验显示,SAGE在水鸟,CelebA和MetaShift上分别实现了89.5%,85.7%和79.1%最差组的精度,分别比最佳组别无标签基线高7.7个百分点.

articles.title: ViTAMINS: An Empirical Study of Training Self-Supervised Vision Transformers with Synthetic Hard Negatives
articles.content: We introduce ViTAMINS, a method that integrates synthetic hard negatives into unsupervised vision transformer pretraining to improve representation quality. Our approach is thoroughly benchmarked on ImageNet and transfer learning, image retrieval, copy detection, and image, video segmentation tasks. Notably, our proposed negatives give rise to emergent properties, where learned representations contain explicit information about the semantic content of an image and serve as excellent classifiers (up to +11.3% over baselines). ViTAMINS achieves these benefits through simple modifications to existing contrastive frameworks and outperforms competing methods while being more resource efficient, e.g., our ViT-B surpasses V-JEPA with ViT-L. Our findings motivate reconsidering contrastive learning as a simpler yet powerful alternative to dominant generative and self-distillation approaches.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ViTAMINS:关于训练自导自演的视野变形器与合成硬负数的实证研究
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了维塔明斯(VitAMINS),这种方法将合成硬底片整合到无监督的视变器预训中来,以提高表达质量. 我们的方法完全以ImageNet和传输学习、图像检索、复制检测以及图像、视频分割任务为基准。 值得注意的是,我们提议的负面反应产生了新出现的属性,在这种属性中,学到的表述包含关于图像的语义内容的明确信息,并充当出色的分类者(比基线增加11.3%)。 VITAMINS通过简单的修改现有对比性框架和超越相竞方法来实现这些好处,同时提高资源效率,例如我们的VIT-B以VIT-L超越了V-JEPA. 我们的调查结果促使人们重新考虑对比性学习,将其作为一种简单而强大的替代方法,来取代占主导地位的基因和自我消化方法。

articles.title: MultiGait: A Multi-Sensor Multi-Perspective Multi-Session Biometric Inference Benchmark and its Dataset
articles.content: A lack of suitable datasets has limited the research into the privacy risks of novel smart city sensors, such as thermal cameras, depth cameras, and lidar. Given the number of unsubstantiated privacy claims and their potential widespread deployment into many people's everyday life, understanding the privacy risks of these sensors -- in isolation and in like-for-like comparisons -- is crucial. With MultiGait, we collected the first multi-sensor, multi-perspective, multi-session gait-focused dataset, for the corresponding, and additional more far-reaching investigations. The dataset, validated with multiple state-of-the-art recognition systems, comprises various walking modes and annotated personal attributes for 199 individuals, to ensure the benefit for advanced studies including cross-sensor recognition and anonymization at the edge. MultiGait represents a foundation for rigorous privacy investigations, demonstrated through an extensive identity inference benchmark across eight sensors, four perspectives, and three recording sessions. Our benchmark incidentally reveals that sensors often assumed to be privacy-friendly do still entail considerable identity inference risks, while the poor cross-session generalization of existing methods underscores an important research gap.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MultiGait:一个多传感器多场多场多场生物计量推论基准及其数据集
articles.content_zh: 缺乏合适的数据集限制了对新型智能城市传感器的隐私风险的研究,如热相机,深度相机,和lidar等. 鉴于未经证实的隐私诉求数量之多,以及它们有可能被广泛应用于许多人的日常生活,了解这些传感器的隐私风险 -- -- 孤立和类似比较 -- -- 至关重要。 我们用MultiGait收集了第一个多传感器、多视角、多会速记的数据集,用于进行相应的调查,并进行更多更深远的调查。 数据集经过多个最先进的识别系统验证,由199名个人的各种行走模式和附加说明的个人属性组成,以确保高级研究的好处,包括在边缘的交叉传感器识别和匿名化. MultiGait是严格的隐私调查的基础,它通过8个传感器、4个视角和3个记录段的广泛身份推断基准加以证明。 我们的基准恰好表明,传感器通常被认为对隐私友好,但仍然会带来相当大的身份推断风险,而对现有方法的跨会通俗化则突出了一个重要的研究差距。

articles.title: Fi-ImageNet-1k: An OOD Benchmark From the Inside of the ImageNet-1k Validation Set
articles.content:
Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection predicts whether a test image belongs to none of the predefined classes. To evaluate this task, benchmarks need images from outside the in-distribution (ID) data; typically, these are defined or collected in an ad hoc fashion. Since no ground truth is perfect, ID-labeled datasets themselves contain a natural source of OOD images. We exploit such annotation errors and present Fi-ImageNet-1k, an OOD dataset built from ImageNet-1k validation images that the recent ReImageNet reannotation effort assigned to no ImageNet-1k class. Each image was examined by expert human annotators supported by evidence from MLLMs, VLMs, and reverse image search, comparing it against all visually similar ID classes. We keep only images that could be assigned a specific class outside the ImageNet-1k label space.
  The resulting Fi-ImageNet-1k, with 655 images from 522 classes, is substantially more challenging than any commonly used OOD dataset. No evaluated combination of classifier and OOD detector achieves a false positive rate below 51% at 95% true positive rate (FPR@95). Compared to the recent NINCO, our dataset is 3.8x more challenging in the FPR@95 metric for state-of-the-art supervised OOD detection methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Fi-图像 Net-1k:从ImageNet-1k验证集内部取出OD基准
articles.content_zh:
分布外(OOD)检测预测测试图像是否属于任何预定义的类. 为了评价这项任务,基准需要从内部分配(ID)数据以外的图像;通常,这些图像是临时界定或收集的。 由于没有地面真实性是完美的,ID标记的数据集本身就包含着OD图像的自然来源. 我们利用这些注释错误, 并呈现Fi-ImageNet-1k, 一个基于ImageNet-1k验证图像的OOD数据集, 每个图像都经过专家人文注释员的检查,辅以来自MLLMs,VLMs的证据,并反向图像搜索,与所有视觉相近的ID类进行比较. 我们只保留在ImageNet-1k标签空间外可以分配到特定类的图像.
由此产生的Fi-ImageNet-1k有522个类的655个图像,比任何常用的OOD数据集更具挑战性。 没有经过评估的分类器和OOD检测器的组合,以95%的真实正率达到51%以下的假正率(FPR@95)。 与最近的NINCO相比,我们的数据集在FPR@95 度量衡中对于最先进的受监督的OD检测方法来说更具挑战性.

articles.title: PyDoseRT Proton: A GPU Pencil-Beam Engine with a Convolutional Residual-Correction Network for Fast Proton Dose Calculation
articles.content: Architecture category. Hybrid method: a physics-based analytical pencil-beam (PB) dose engine followed by a 3-D convolutional residual-correction network (RepVGG-U-Net). We addressed the DoseRAD2026 proton dose-prediction task with PyDoseRT Proton, a GPU-accelerated engine implemented in PyTorch and augmented by a learned residual toward Monte Carlo (MC) accuracy. A double-Gaussian PB kernel was calibrated to GATE/Geant4 integrated depth doses in water in two stages: a classical per-energy curve fit, then a gradient-based fit of the full 3-D dose through the PyTorch physics engine as it retains a differentiable execution path for gradient-based optimization of dose-dependent objectives. The engine computes each beamlet on a beam's-eye-view (BEV) lattice with variance-preserving Gaussian splitting, an analytic nuclear halo, and a Fermi-Eyges heterogeneity term, then rotates the result into the patient frame. Additionally, a compact residual U-Net predicts an additive correction in BEV space. It is conditioned on voxelwise material-label embeddings, a discrete energy embedding and spot size. The same model was used for all anatomical sites (thoracic and abdominal). It was trained with a patient-space L1 objective emphasizing the scored high-dose region and multi-scale BEV deep supervision. The submitted CT configuration obtained preliminary-test beamlet MAE 0.0066, image-z IDD distance 0.0025, plan MAE 0.0049, 98.30\% gamma pass rate (1\%/1 mm), and DVH error 0.460.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PyDoseRT 软件 质子:一个GPU Pencil-Beam引擎,并设有快速质子剂量计算回旋残余-校正网络
articles.content_zh: 建筑类. 混合法:一种以物理为基础的分析铅笔束(PB)剂量引擎,并接通了3-D分级的剩余-校正网络(RepVGG-U-Net). 我们与PyTorch公司执行的GPU加速引擎PyDoseRT Proton公司完成了DoseRAD2026质子剂量预测任务,并得到了Monte Carlo(MC)精确度的学习后剩余部分的补充。 双高斯PB内核在水中被分出两个阶段校正为GATE/Geant4综合深度剂量:古典的每能曲线相合,再通过PyTorch物理引擎对全三维剂量进行梯度相接,因为它保留了以梯度为基础优化剂量依赖目标的不同执行路径. 发动机在梁眼-视线(BEV)上计算出每个束子上有差异-保留高斯分裂,分析核光环,并有费米-艾格斯异质词,再将结果旋转入病人的框架. 此外,一个紧凑的剩余U-Net预测BEV空间会出现添加剂修正. 它以阴道物质标签嵌入、离散能量嵌入和点出大小为条件。 所有解剖地点(胸腔和腹腔)都采用了同样的模型. 培训对象为病人-空间L1目标,强调得分高剂量区域和多规模BEV深度监督。 提交的CT配置获得了初步测试束MAE 0.0066,影像-z IDD距离0.0025,计划MAE 0.0049,98.30\%伽玛通过率(1\%/1mm)和DVH出错0.460.

articles.title: Low-Quality Face Recognition using Center Aligned Representations and Local Margin Constraints
articles.content: Low-quality face recognition (LQFR) remains challenging due to the difficulty of matching degraded query (probe) images against low-quality (LQ) enrollment (gallery) imagery and the scarcity of training data for large-scale models. While recent face recognition (FR) models perform well on high-quality (HQ) imagery, their accuracy drops significantly on LQ images with extremely low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Moreover, fine-tuning HQ-pretrained models on LQ data often improves LQ recognition at the expense of HQ generalization. This trade-off becomes more pronounced in modern evaluation settings spanning multiple datasets with varying image quality levels. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework that combines three main components: (1) Local Probability Margin (LPM), which estimates per-sample difficulty directly from the model's discriminative landscape; (2) Nested Attention Module (NAM), a new low-rank adapter module that embeds a self-attention mechanism within selected transformer layers; and (3) Quality Gating Protocol (QGP), where an off-the-shelf image quality estimator modulates the adapter contribution at test time, enabling a single model to handle the full quality spectrum without sacrificing HQ performance. Experiments on surveillance (TinyFace, SurvFace) and standard (IJB-B, IJB-C) face recognition benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in both identification and verification. Code and models will be released at github.com/candllq/nam.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 利用中心协调代表和地方边际限制进行低质量面相识别
articles.content_zh: 低质面部识别(LQFR)仍然具有挑战性,因为难以将已退化的查询(probe)图像与低质(LQ)入场(gallery)图像相匹配,以及大型模型缺乏培训数据. 虽然最近的面相识别(FR)模型在高品质(HQ)图像上表现良好,但其精度在信号-噪声比(SNR)极低的LQ图像上大幅下降. 此外,在LQ数据上微调总部预选的模型,往往能改善LQ的识别,而牺牲了HQ的通化. 这种权衡在跨越多个数据集、图像质量水平不同的现代评价环境中变得更加明显。 为解决这些局限性,我们提出一个统一框架,将三个主要组成部分结合起来:(1)局部概率边距(LPM),直接从模型的差别地貌中估计出每个样本的困难;(2) Nested Content Module(NAM),一个新的低等适配器模块,将自留机制嵌入到选定的变压器层;(3) 质地测量协议(QGP),一个现成的图像质量估计器在测试时会调节适配器的贡献,使单一的模型能够在不牺牲总部性能的情况下处理全部质量频谱. 关于监测(TinyFace, SurvFace)和标准(IJB-B,IJB-C)的实验表明,在识别和核查两方面都取得了持续的进展. 代码和模型将在github.com/candllq/nam发布.

articles.title: SinkPruner: Sink-Free Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.content:
Despite their strong multimodal understanding ability, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial computational overhead when processing long visual token sequences. To reduce inference costs, recent studies have explored visual token pruning through vision-centric or text-guided strategies. However, these methods often overlook high-norm outlier tokens, i.e., tokens with abnormally large feature norms, leading to suboptimal pruning decisions. In this work, we show that such high-norm outlier tokens are highly redundant in both feature and spatial dimensions, yet are often mistakenly preserved as informative cues by existing methods.
  Motivated by this observation, we propose SinkPruner, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient MLLM inference.
