SinkPruner follows a coarse-to-fine design with two key modules: a visual sanitizer that filters high-norm redundancies and alleviates attention sink and attention dispersion, and a text-guided pruner that further retains tokens semantically aligned with the text query.
  Extensive experiments on twelve image-language and four video-language benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and generalizability of our framework. Notably, SinkPruner preserves 96.5% (91.8%) of the original performance of LLaVA-1.5 (Qwen2.5-VL) under an 89% token reduction. Experiments further indicate that our visual sanitizer exhibits promising transferability in enhancing the performance of existing pruning methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/LaVi-Lab/SinkPruner.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 辛克普鲁纳 : 用于多式大型语言模型的Sink-Free Visual Token Pruning
articles.content_zh:
尽管多式联运理解能力很强,但多式联运大型语言模型在处理长视符号序列时需要大量的计算费。 为了降低推论成本,最近的研究探索了通过以视觉为中心或以文字为指南的战略来取景。 然而,这些方法往往忽略了高规范的外标,即带有异常大特征规范的外标,导致非最佳的挤压决定. 在这项工作中,我们表明,这种高标准外标在地物和空间方面都是非常多余的,但往往被错误地保留为现有方法的信息提示。
基于这一观察,我们提议采用SinkPruner,这是一个无培训的视觉符号推导框架,用于高效的MLLM推论。 SinkPruner遵循粗糙到精细的设计,有两个关键模块:一是可视化的消毒器,可以过滤出高规范冗余并缓解注意力的沉入和注意力的分散;一是文字导出器,可以进一步保留与文本查询一致的符号.
关于12个图像语言基准和4个视频语言基准的广泛试验表明我们的框架的有效性、效率和普遍性。 值得注意的是,SinkPruner将LLaVA-1.5(Quen2.5-VL)的原始性能保留了96.5%(91.8%),降幅为89%。 实验进一步显示,我们的视觉消毒器在提高现有收发方法的性能方面显示出有希望的可转移性。 我们的代码可见于https://github.com/LaVi-Lab/SinkPruner.

articles.title: Does This Moment Justify the Recommendation? Counterfactual Behavior-Grounded Evidence Retrieval for Personalized Video Recommendation
articles.content: Personalized video recommendation predicts user preference at the video level, while temporal video grounding localizes query-relevant moments. However, strong localization does not establish whether the retrieved moment constitutes valid evidence for recommending the video to a particular user. We study counterfactual behavior-grounded evidence retrieval, which separates where personalized evidence occurs from whether such evidence exists and evaluates whether model predictions respond consistently when that evidence is replaced. We introduce CBGER-10K, containing 5,000 controlled factual--counterfactual pairs for 3,026 users, where each pair replaces only the focal behavior-supported segment while preserving the user, temporal position, and hard distractors. We further propose CBGER, a compact framework that decouples segment-level localization from video-level evidence estimation and learns both through structured counterfactual supervision. CBGER achieves $0.4432$ MRR, $0.6977$ Pair Accuracy, and $0.6987$ Intervention Consistency across five adapted personalized-highlight and temporal-grounding baselines. Notably, compared with QD-DETR, its MRR improvement is not statistically significant, while Pair Accuracy improves by $11.03$ points. These results show that accurate temporal localization does not necessarily imply reliable personalized evidence existence, motivating explicit evaluation of Whether alongside Where.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 这一时刻是否说明建议的合理性? 针对个人化视频建议获取反事实行为证据
articles.content_zh: 个性化的视频推荐预言视频层面的用户偏好,而时间视频定位则将查询相关瞬间定位. 然而,强烈的本地化并不能确定取回的瞬间是否构成向特定用户推荐视频的有效证据. 我们研究反事实行为证据检索,将发生个性化证据的地方与是否存在此类证据区分开来,并评价模型预测在证据被替换时是否一致回应. 我们引入了CBGER-10K,包含5000个可控的事实-反事实对,供3,026个用户使用,每对只替换焦行为支持的片段,同时保留用户,时间位置,和硬分光器. 我们进一步提出CBGER,这是一个紧密的框架,将片段一级本地化与视频一级的证据估计脱钩,并通过结构化的反事实监督来学习。 CBGER在五个经过调整的个性化高清和基于时间的基线中,达到0.4432美元MR、0.6977美元对等精确度和0.6987美元干预一致性。 值得注意的是,与QD-DETR相比,MRR的改进在统计学上并不显著,而Pair精确度则提高了11.03分. 这些结果表明,准确的时间定位并不一定意味着可靠的个性化证据的存在,从而促使人们明确评价 " 是否与何地平行 " 。

articles.title: CQF-HMR: Continuous Quaternion Flows for Probabilistic 3D Human Mesh Recovery from a Single Image
articles.content: Recovering 3D digital humans from a single 2D image is an ill-posed computer vision problem due to the loss of depth information. Probabilistic 3D human pose estimation compensates for this by estimating a set of 3D hypotheses from a prior distribution via generative models. However, most prior work focuses only on 3D keypoints, which often leads to implausible poses that are difficult to apply to downstream tasks, e.g. animation or digital humans. SMPL-based methods are more scalable thanks to the explicit body priors, but it requires more complex modeling of the generation process due to the non-additive nature of the joint rotations. In this work, we propose a novel approach for probabilistic 3D humans using quaternion-constrained continuous normalizing flows conditioned on 2D pose estimations. Our proposed quaternion flows show significant advantages over approaches using other rotation representations. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art results of our method on Human3.6M, particularly in ambiguous settings, and comparable pose estimation accuracy on challenging 3DPW and EMDB benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CQF-HMR:从单一图像中取出概率3D人类网格的连续质变流
articles.content_zh: 从一幅2D图像中取回3D数字人,由于深度信息丢失,这是一个不易被置入的计算机视觉问题. 通过通过基因模型对先前的分布得出的一套三维假说进行估计,可以弥补这种可能性。 然而,大多数前作只注重3D键点,这往往导致难以被应用到下游任务的不可信外观,如动画或数码人. 以 SMPL 为主的方法由于有明显的正体前身而更加可扩展,但由于联合自转的非附加性质,它需要更复杂的生成过程模型. 在这项工作中,我们提出一种新颖的方法,即使用以2D为条件的四分位受约束的连续常态化流动对概率立体人类进行估计。 我们提议的四分法流动比使用其他轮换办法有重大优势。 实验展示了我们方法在Human3.6M方面的最新结果,特别是在模棱两可的环境中,可比结果对挑战的3DPW和EMDB基准提出了精确的估计。

articles.title: EvoGS: Modeling Deformation Evolution for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Recent extensions of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enable real-time novel view synthesis in dynamic scenes by learning time-conditioned Gaussian deformations. However, existing MLP-based methods typically estimate deformations independently at each timestamp, making them less robust to large or abrupt motions. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{EvoGS}, a 3DGS-based dynamic reconstruction framework that models Gaussian deformation as a temporal evolution process. EvoGS maintains persistent deformation states for each Gaussian, extrapolates future states from historical deformation states, and corrects the predictions with MLP-derived observations. The correction is adaptively weighted using a temporal residual memory and evolution statistics such as deformation velocity and trajectory deviation. To further improve reconstruction quality, EvoGS introduces deformation-aware densification. Clone and split operations are performed along corrected deformation directions, while an uncertainty-aware strategy suppresses densification for Gaussians with unstable deformation histories. Experiments show that EvoGS improves dynamic novel view synthesis quality and achieves competitive performance across benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EvoGS:动态高斯电镀的变形模型化演变
articles.content_zh: 最近3D高斯平板电脑(3DGS)的扩展,通过学习有时间条件的高斯平板电脑变形,可以在动态场景中进行实时小说取景合成. 然而,现有的基于 MLP 的方法通常会独立估计每个时间戳的变形,使其对大或出乎意料的动作不太有力. 为了解决这个问题,我们建议\textbf{EvoGS},一个基于3DGS的动态重建框架,将高斯变形作为时间演化过程的模式. EvoGS为每个高斯人保持持续变形状态,从历史变形状态推断出未来状态,并用MLP派生的观测结果来校正预测. 校正采用时间残存和演化统计如变形速度和轨迹偏差进行适应性加权. 为了进一步提高重建质量,EvoGS引入了变形-认知密度. 克隆和分化操作按照修正的变形方向进行,而不确定性意识战略则会抑制变形史不稳定的高斯人密度. 实验显示,EvoGS改进了动态新颖取景合成质量并实现了跨基准的竞争性表现.

articles.title: Semi-Supervised Virtual Staining via Morphology Preservation and Histopathological Realism Constraints
articles.content: Virtual staining aims to computationally generate target-stained histopathological images while reducing the cost and time associated with conventional staining procedures. However, existing methods rely predominantly on strictly paired and accurately registered training data, which are difficult and expensive to obtain in routine practice. To reduce this dependence, we propose a stable semi-supervised virtual staining framework that jointly exploits both limited paired data and abundant unpaired source images. Directly incorporating unpaired images is challenging because their generated results lack corresponding targets for supervision, potentially leading to unrealistic staining, morphological degradation, or even training collapse. To obtain reliable supervision from these images, Hessian-derived morphology preservation extracts structural cues from each source image and constrains the generated output to retain tissue morphology. Histopathological realism constraints further guide the output toward plausible target-stain characteristics, preventing the source-derived structural supervision from degenerating into contour enhancement or simple color transformation. Together, the two components suppress structural and appearance drift, stabilize semi-supervised stain translation, and promote the preservation of diagnostically relevant information. Extensive experiments on H&E-to-IHC translation for Ki67 and HER2, as well as FFPE-to-H&E translation, demonstrate consistent improvements in image quality, morphology preservation, robustness, and downstream diagnostic performance. Code will be available.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 半监督 通过保存肿瘤学和历史病理学现实主义限制造成的虚拟污染
articles.content_zh: 虚拟污渍旨在计算生成目标覆盖的病理学图像,同时降低与传统污渍程序相关的成本和时间. 然而,现有方法主要依靠严格对接和准确注册的培训数据,这些数据在例行实践中很难和昂贵地获得。 为了减少这种依赖性,我们提出一个稳定的半监督的虚拟污渍框架,共同利用有限的对等数据和丰富的未发源图像。 直接收录未受污染的图像具有挑战性,因为所产生的结果缺乏相应的监督目标,可能导致不切实际的污渍、形态退化甚至培训崩溃。 为了从这些图像中获取可靠的监督,黑森派生的形态学保存从每个源图像中提取出结构提示并限制所生成的输出来保留组织形态学. 历史病理学现实主义的制约因素进一步引导输出朝向可能存在的目标特征,防止源头结构监督退化成轮廓增强或简单的色彩转化. 两者共同抑制了结构和外观漂移,稳定了半被监督的污渍翻译,促进了诊断相关信息的保存. 对Ki67和HER2的H&E到IHC翻译以及FFPE到H&E翻译进行了广泛的实验,显示出图像质量、形态保存、稳健性和下游诊断性能的不断改善。 代码会提供。

articles.title: Prior-Guided Implicit Neural Representations for Single-Subject Diffusion MRI Super-Resolution
articles.content: Resolving complex fiber geometries in brain white matter requires high-resolution diffusion MRI at the cost of long acquisition times. This leads many clinical protocols to opt for low-resolution scans, making downstream microstructure estimation and tractography challenging. Implicit neural representations (INRs) can model the diffusion signal continuously, enabling native single-subject super-resolution by querying the network at arbitrary spatial coordinates, yet existing methods often suffer from long training times and lack a mechanism to incorporate anatomical priors to regularize super-resolution by constraining the space of plausible reconstructions. To address these limitations, we propose a novel transfer-learning framework that pre-trains an INR on a high-resolution template and then adapts it to subject-specific scans via registration and fine-tuning. For $4\times$ through-plane super-resolution from 5 mm to 1.25 mm on Human Connectome Project (HCP) data, our method reduces NRMSE by 36-49% and increases FSIM by 24-43% over a recent baseline with $6\times$ faster training, outperforming competing INR-based methods across both image quality and domain-specific metrics. Code is available on the project page at https://abdulkaderghandoura.github.io/research/msc-thesis/ .
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 单子扩散核磁共振超解析前导隐形神经表达
articles.content_zh: 在脑白色物质中溶解复杂的纤维几何体需要高分辨率扩散核磁共振,成本为长期获取时间. 这导致许多临床协议选择了低分辨率扫描,使得下游的微观结构估计和道道学具有挑战性. 隐性神经表达式(INRs)可以连续地模拟扩散信号,通过任意空间坐标查询网络,使本土单主体超解,然而现有方法往往受到长时间的训练并缺乏一种机制来将解剖前科纳入,通过限制可信重建的空间来规范超解. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立一个新的转移学习框架,在高分辨模板上预先插入一个INR,然后通过注册和微调使其适应特定主题的扫描。 就人类连接体项目数据而言,通过飞机超分辨率从5毫米到1.25毫米的4美元而言,我们的方法将NRMSE减少36-49%,将FSIM比最近的基线增加24-43%,培训速度为6美元,在图像质量和特定领域指标上都比基于INR的相互竞争的方法要快。 代码见项目网页:https://abdulkaderghandoura.github.io/research/msc-thesis/。 。 。 。 。

articles.title: Beyond Scores: Understanding LLM-as-a-Judge Mechanisms in Summarization Evaluation
articles.content: LLM-based evaluators of natural language generation (NLG) quality are widely deployed as scoring tools and as automated training signals, yet the internal procedure by which they assign a rating remains poorly understood. We investigate this procedure mechanistically through an eight-attack perturbation taxonomy across the Readability and Adequacy dimensions of NLG quality, a generation pipeline that produces paired clean and corrupt summaries with controlled error intensity and explicit token-level modification maps, and a four-experiment battery of causal tracing, logit-lens vocabulary projection, and attention-head knockout applied to Themis (Llama-3-8B) and Prometheus (Mistral-7B). Both evaluators implement a structured, coherent evaluation pipeline operating in two stages: below layer 15, attention performs local error comparison and routes the result to the final input position; above it, the MLP cascade integrates the signal and writes the rating, with the decision crystallizing in the residual stream at a sharp late layer (L = 26 on Themis, L = 25 on Prometheus). Furthermore, a base-model control at the same scale (Llama-3-8B) reproduces the routing architecture and crystallization but not the stage separation, isolating the two mechanisms that fine-tuning specifically installs, suppression of below-L15 MLP contribution at the last position and a two-layer advance of the crystallization depth, indicating that fine-tuning sculpts an existing substrate rather than building the pipeline from scratch. We release the source code and data at https://github.com/himil-v/judge-mech
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越分数:了解总结评价中的LLM-as-a-Judge机制
articles.content_zh: 以LLM为基础的自然语言生成质量评价员被广泛部署,作为评分工具和自动化培训信号,然而,他们分配评级的内部程序仍然不甚了解。 我们通过对NLG质量的可读性和充分性进行8个攻击扰动分类,对这个程序进行机械化调查,这一代管道产生有可控误差强度和明确符号级修改图的对接干净和腐败摘要,以及用于Themis(Llama-3-8B)和Prometheus(Mistral-7B)的由因果追踪、登录-Lens词汇投影和注意力头击出的四个实验电池。 两名评价人员分两个阶段实施有条理、连贯的评价管道:第15层以下,注意进行局部误差比较,并将结果通向最后输入位置;在上方,MLP级联将信号集成并写出评分,决定以尖锐的后层在剩余流中结晶(L=26 在Themis上;L=25 在Prometheus上)。 此外,同规模(Llama-3-8B)的基模控制复制了路由架构和结晶化,而不是相相分离,隔离了具体安装微调的两个机制,在上个位置压制下-L15 MLP的贡献并推进了结晶深度的两层,表明微调后雕刻出现有的底板,而不是从零开始建造管道. 我们在https://github.com/himil-v/judge-mech发布源代码和数据

articles.title: Efficient SWE Agent Benchmarking via Trajectory-Aware Evaluation
articles.content: Evaluating software engineering agents on realistic benchmarks is costly, since each task may require multi-step code exploration, modification, and test execution. Existing efficient evaluation methods select representative subsets to estimate full-benchmark performance, but are largely result-only: they fit historical pass/fail response matrices or static task semantics, discarding how agents solve problems. We propose PTA-IRT, a Privileged Trajectory-Aware Item Response Theory framework that fuses process and outcome signals. Historical execution trajectories supply process-level evidence beyond pass/fail, such as explored context, attempted edits, and solving paths, which PTA-IRT uses as privileged information for calibration subset selection and ability estimation. Under low calibration budgets, PTA-IRT consistently outperforms prior IRT baselines on score and ranking recovery across four SWE benchmarks. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/PTA-IRT.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 高效瑞典 通过轨迹评估确定代理基准
articles.content_zh: 根据现实的基准评估软件工程代理人的费用很高,因为每项任务可能需要多步骤的代码探索、修改和测试执行。 现有的高效评价方法选取代表性子集来估计全基准性能,但基本上只有结果:它们符合历史传入/故障响应矩阵或静态任务语义,抛弃了代理如何解决问题. 我们提议PTA-IRT, 一个保密的轨迹 - 智能项目响应 使过程和结果信号相互融合的理论框架。 历史执行轨迹 提供超出通过/失败的流程级证据,如探索上下文,尝试编辑,并解析路径,PTA-IRT使用这些路径作为校正子集选择和能力估计的特权信息. 在低校准预算下,PTA-IRT在分数上一贯优于以往IRT基线,并在瑞典的4个基准中排名恢复。 代码和数据可在https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/PTA-IRT上公开查阅.

articles.title: Adaptive Critical Token-Aware Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Generation
articles.content: The repository-level code generation task requires synthesizing code that satisfies task requirements while remaining consistent with the target repository context. Since real-world repositories often exceed the input length limits of LLMs, existing approaches commonly adopt retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to provide repository-specific context. Despite improving repository-context retrieval, existing methods typically provide context as task-level support, without explicitly identifying the critical tokens that require fine-grained repository context during generation. During the autoregressive generation process of LLMs, errors often concentrate at a small number of decisive positions: once such tokens are generated incorrectly, subsequent code may follow an incorrect semantic path and eventually lead to functional failure. We refer to these positions as "critical tokens". In this paper, we propose ACToR, an adaptive critical token-aware retrieval framework for repository-level code generation. ACToR identifies critical tokens during generation and triggers targeted retrieval on demand to provide repository context at these decisive positions. In addition, we design a position-aware weighting method for dense retrievers to prioritize context that is more informative for generation. We evaluate ACToR on two representative repository-level benchmarks, RepoExec and CoderEval. Experimental results show that ACToR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving relative improvements of 8.4% on RepoExec and 15.4% on CoderEval. Beyond performance gains, we systematically quantify the impact of critical tokens, revealing their central role in major generation failures and highlighting the necessity of targeted retrieval strategies. We provide the code and data at https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/ACToR.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于 Repository- Level 代码生成的适应性关键调试软件
articles.content_zh: 寄存器级代码生成任务需要合成符合任务要求的代码,同时与目标寄存器上下文保持一致. 由于现实世界寄存器常常会超过LLMS的输入长度限制,因此现有方法通常采用取回-增强生成(RAG)来提供寄存器的特定上下文. 尽管改进了存储库-文本检索,但现有方法通常作为任务级支持提供上下文,但没有明确指明在生成过程中需要精细配置的存储库上下文的关键符号. 在LLMs的自递生成过程中,出错往往集中在少数决定性位置上:一旦这种符号生成不正确,后续代码可能遵循不正确的语义路径并最终导致功能故障. 我们把这些立场称为"关键象征". 在本文中,我们提出ACToR,即一个适应性的关键符号感知检索框架,用于寄存器级代码生成. ACToR在生成过程中识别出关键符号,并根据需求触发定向检索,以在这些决定性位置提供存储环境. 此外,我们设计了一种能识别位置的加权方法,供密集取回器优先排列背景,为一代人提供信息。 我们对ACToR的评价是两个具有代表性的存储级基准,RepoExec和CoderEval。 实验结果显示,ACToR的成绩始终高于最先进的方法,RepoExec的相对改进率为8.4%,而CoderEval的相对改进率为15.4%。 除了提高业绩外,我们还系统地量化重要标志的影响,揭示它们在重大一代失败中的核心作用,并强调有必要制定有针对性的检索战略。 我们在https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/ACTOR上提供代码和数据。

articles.title: CordisBench: Can Language Models Reason About Component Lifecycles in Dynamic Agent Harnesses?
articles.content: Dynamic agent harnesses let language models change the software that shapes their own execution. This flexibility brings a new reasoning burden: a local plugin change can propagate through dependencies and cleanup. We introduce CordisBench, a 1,200-question benchmark of this lifecycle reasoning. It combines a controlled formal setting with programs executed against Cordis, a runtime that manages component dependencies and cleanup, and asks models to identify affected components, predict state after a specified teardown order, determine which conditions hold under all or some orders, and choose reconfigurations that succeed when executed. Across these tasks, we evaluate three efficiency-oriented models at low reasoning effort with 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, or 32 relevant interactions, using deterministic task-specific scoring. Models usually handle small systems well but grow less reliable as more interactions become relevant, especially when predicting final state and when reasoning across teardown orders. Additional inference effort recovers marked gains for some models. The cost is nontrivial: on our 16-interaction subset, GPT-5.6 Luna uses nearly 3,000 reasoning tokens per question at medium effort. For these controlled instances, that cost is avoidable: an independent finite reference semantics agrees with Cordis execution on every observation and action outcome used for scoring across all 528 executable questions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Cordis Bench:关于动态代理哈内斯中组件生命周期的语言模型是否合理?
articles.content_zh: 动态代理机会让语言模型改变塑造自己执行的软件. 这种灵活性带来了新的推理负担:本地插件更改可以通过依赖和清理来推广. 我们介绍Cordis Bench 这个生命周期推理的 1200个问题基准 它将一个可控的正式设置与针对 Cordis 执行的程序相结合,这是管理组件依赖性和清理的运行时间,并要求模型识别受影响的组件,在指定拆分命令后预测状态,确定所有或某些命令下的条件,并选择执行时成功的重组. 在这些任务中,我们用2,4,8,16,24或32个相关互动,利用特定任务的确定性评分,在低推理努力中评价了三个注重效率的模式. 模型通常能很好地处理小型系统,但随着互动的加强而变得不那么可靠,特别是在预测最终状态和跨越拆解命令的推理时. 额外的推论努力恢复了一些模型的显著收益. 成本是非三角性的:在我们16个互动子集上,GPT-5.6 Luna在中度努力下每个问题使用近3000个推理符. 对于这些被控制的情况,这种费用是可以避免的:一个独立的有限参考语义学家同意Cordis执行用于对所有528个可执行问题的评分的每一项观察和行动结果。

articles.title: The Rise of Verbal Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Natural language is emerging as a primary feedback channel for improving language agents, capable of conveying intent, preferences, and causal structure in forms interpretable by both humans and modern language models. We call this paradigm Verbal Reinforcement Learning (VRL) and offer the first unified account of it. We organize the field around a single axis, \textit{when} verbal feedback takes effect in an agent's lifecycle and \textit{what} it modifies, yielding three pillars: (1) \textbf{Language as Grounding Signal}, where language defines the task itself by specifying goals, states, and reward structures; (2) \textbf{Language as Deliberative Feedback}, where natural language guides reasoning at test time without the need to update model parameters; (3) \textbf{Language as Learning Signal}, where language-based feedback shapes model parameters through training. Within each pillar, we synthesize representative work, distinguish key subcategories of approaches, and outline the distinct role language plays in shaping agent behavior. Together, this taxonomy shows how verbal reinforcement is reshaping agent development, while also defining the challenges and opportunities for building more capable and aligned agents.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 口头强化学习的兴起
articles.content_zh: 自然语言正在成为改进语言代理的主要反馈渠道,能够以人类和现代语言模型都能解释的形式表达意向,偏好和因果结构. 我们称这个范式为Verbal加强学习(VRL),并对此提供第一个统一的说法. 我们围绕一个轴来组织字段,\textit{ when} 口头反馈在代理商的生命周期中生效,\textit{什么}它修改,产生出三个支柱:(1)\textbf{Language as Grounding Signal},语言通过指定目标、状态和奖励结构来定义任务本身;(2)\textbf{Language as Deliberative S反馈},自然语言在测试时指导推理,而不需要更新模型参数;(3)\textbf{Language as Learning Signal},语言反馈通过培训来塑造模型参数. 在每个支柱中,我们综合代表性的工作,区分方法的关键子类,并概述语言在塑造代理行为中的独特作用. 这种分类法共同显示,口头强化正在如何重新塑造代理发展,同时也界定了建立更有能力、更一致代理的挑战和机遇。

articles.title: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
articles.content: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. Student simulators can provide this signal as a proxy, yet existing approaches are limited: state-tracking models fit student behavior but struggle to process explanations or corrections, while LLM role-play follows guidance fluently but does not reliably match the competence of the student being imitated. We present StudentSim, a training framework that turns sparse per-student data into individualized simulators through pooled training followed by per-student specialization. The resulting simulators both mirror a student's own responses and update them under tutor guidance. We also introduce StudentSimEval, a standardized protocol covering 60 students across chess, second-language English writing, and mathematics, using public learner datasets with de-identified records shared for research. StudentSimEval measures behavioral fidelity (F), or how well a simulator matches a student's responses, and guidance responsiveness (R), or how readily it updates under tutor guidance, with all methods fit and evaluated on the same records. Across all three domains, StudentSim outperforms GPT-5.4 on both metrics. In chess, StudentSim reaches F=0.51 and R=0.91, compared with 0.23 and 0.72 for GPT-5.4 and 0.45 and 0.27 for Maia2. As a proof of concept, using StudentSim as a reward model for tutor reinforcement learning produces a chess tutor that expert humans rate as more accurate, better-guided, and more personalized than a no-RL baseline and a tutor trained against a GPT-5.4 simulator reward. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/StudentSim.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学生Sim:基于LLM的培训学生模拟器
articles.content_zh: AI导师在适应每个学生的长处,弱点和偏好指导时最有用,但对于哪些指导有用的证据,学生很少,学习缓慢,从真正的学习者那里收集费用高昂. 学生模拟器可以提供这个信号作为代用,但现有的方法有限: 状态跟踪模型适合学生的行为,但努力处理解释或矫正,而LLM角色扮演游戏则顺畅地遵循了指导,但并不可靠地匹配被模仿的学生的能力. 我们向学生介绍一个培训框架,通过集合培训,然后通过每个学生的专业化,将每个学生的稀少数据转化为个性化模拟器。 由此产生的模拟器既反映了学生自己的反应,又在辅导员的指导下更新. 我们还引入了学生SimEval(英语:SudentSimEval),这是一个标准化的规程,涵盖60名跨国际象棋的学生,第二语言英语写作,以及数学,使用公共学习者数据集与共享的去识别记录用于研究. 学生SimEval衡量行为忠诚度(F),或者模拟器如何匹配学生的回答,以及指导响应度(R),或者在辅导指导下如何容易地更新,所有方法都适合并评价在同一记录上. 在所有三个领域,SudentSim在两个指标上都超过了GPT-5.4。 在国际象棋中,SudentSim达到F=0.51和R=0.91,而GPT-5.4和Maia2分别为0.23和0.72. 作为概念的证明,将SudentSim作为辅导员强化学习的奖励模式,生成出一款比无RL基线更准确,更好的指导,更个性化的围棋导师,以及一个接受过GPT-5.4模拟奖励训练的导师. 代码见https://github.com/microsoft/StuentSim.

articles.title: Designing Proactive Thought Partners for Writing
articles.content: Writing involves diverse cognitive activities, from ideation to revision, and writers' needs vary across individuals and moments. Proactive AI promises to provide the right support at the right time, yet existing proactive tools largely focus on generic textual assistance, such as autocomplete. This paper studies the design space of proactive thought partners: AI agents that proactively offer customizable, higher-level cognitive support during writing. We instantiated this concept in a technology probe and deployed it with 16 participants for one week. The probe allows users to create partners by configuring their roles and proactivity. As users write, relevant partners take the initiative at appropriate moments to offer suggestions. Our findings show that participants configured proactive support through prospective planning, used suggestions for both idea generation and self-monitoring, and valued lightweight visual representations alongside non-directive rhetorical framing for non-intrusive interventions. We derive implications for designing proactive writing assistants around customization, timing, engagement, and representation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 设计写作的积极主动的思想伙伴
articles.content_zh: 写作涉及不同的认知活动,从思想到修正,作家的需求因个人和时刻而异. 主动的AI承诺在适当的时候提供正确的支持,然而现有的主动工具主要侧重于通用的文本协助,例如自动完成. 本文件研究了主动积极的思想伙伴的设计空间: AI代理在写作期间主动提供可定制,更高级的认知支持. 我们在技术探测器中将这个概念进行了即兴分析,并部署了16名参与者,为期一周。 探测器允许用户通过配置角色和主动性来创建合作伙伴. 在用户写信时,有关伙伴在适当时候主动提出建议。 我们的调查结果表明,与会者通过未来的规划安排了积极主动的支持,利用建议来产生想法和自我监测,并重视轻量级的视觉表现以及非侵扰性干预的非直接言辞框架。 在设计主动的书写助手时,我们涉及定制、时间安排、参与和代表性。

articles.title: The Structure of Quantization Damage in LLMs: Why the Next Bit Should Be Spent Globally
articles.content: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to reduce the cost of serving large language models (LLMs), but its accuracy cost is uneven and is often tuned per model. We study where quantization damage occurs and how to allocate a small additional precision budget. Using causal mixed-precision intervention as ground truth (raise each layer to 8-bit in turn and measure the accuracy it recovers) across 9 open-weight models in 4 architecture families, we test 3 intuitive hypotheses: that quantization damage lives in task circuits, where the model computes, or in weight statistics. None of them predicts which layers benefit from restored precision. Recovery is instead diffuse: for 8 of 9 models, recovering 75% of the gap takes roughly half the layers; the lone exception, Qwen3-8B, is sharply concentrated. At a matched precision budget, spending it globally on finer quantization granularity beats locally repairing the most recoverable layers for all 8 group-128-compatible models (all but OpenLLaMA, whose width rules out group-128), by 21-52 points, including the concentrated Qwen3-8B. We report 2 secondary findings: the residual is budget-limited (8-bit is near-lossless in our evaluation across RTN, GPTQ, and AWQ), and the location of peak recovery correlates with architecture within a family, though not across families. Within this budget setting, global granularity is a better default than selectively protecting critical layers. More broadly, cheap signals that correlate with quantization damage do not necessarily identify where restoring precision improves accuracy; this must be tested with causal intervention.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLMs中量化损害的结构:为什么全球应该用下一点
articles.content_zh: 训练后量化(PTQ)被广泛用于降低服务于大型语言模型(LLMs)的成本,但其精度成本不均匀并经常被调取每个模型. 我们研究在哪些地方发生量化损害以及如何分配少量的额外精确预算。 使用因果混合精度干预作为地面真理(依次将每层提升到8位并测量它恢复的精度),在4个建筑家族的9个开口量模型中,我们测试了3个直观假设:即量子化会破坏任务回路,模型在那里计算,或者重量统计. 没有一个预测哪层从恢复的精度中受益。 相反,恢复是分散的:对于9个模型中的8个模型来说,恢复75%的缺口大约需要一半的分层;唯一的例外是Qune3-8B,它非常集中。 在匹配的精确预算中,全球用于更精细的量子化颗粒性比当地修复所有8个组-128相兼容型号(除了OpenLLaMA,其宽度排除了组-128)最可回收的地层要多出21-52分,包括集中的Qune3-8B. 我们报告2个二级调查结果:剩余部分是有限的预算(在我们对RTN、GPTQ和AWQ的评价中,8位部分几乎是无损失的),峰值恢复的地点与家庭内部的建筑有关,尽管不是家庭之间的建筑。 在这个预算范围内,全球颗粒性比有选择地保护关键层要好。 更广泛地说,与量化损害有关的廉价信号不一定能够确定恢复精度能提高准确性的地方;必须用因果干预来检验这一点。

articles.title: Closing Cost-Quality Gap in Document VLMs: Difficulty-Aware Data Curation and Quality-Adjusted Deployment Economics
articles.content: Extracting structured fields from hundreds of millions of documents annually remains costly in regulated industries: bespoke OCR cascades cover only a fraction of workflows, privacy rules preclude external models, and existing open-source VLMs that clear quality thresholds cost more to serve than human annotation. We present a deployed document-understanding system built on a Mixture-of-Experts VLM (35B total, 3B active), fine-tuned on in-house production data mixed with open-domain documents curated by a Difficulty-Aware pipeline for layout diversity, fact-extractability, and cross-model consistency. Fitting on a single H100 and serving heterogeneous workflows via prompting, the model leads all deployable (non-reasoning) baselines up to an order of magnitude larger. A quality-adjusted cost analysis, with confirmation and correction costs calibrated from production telemetry, shows it reduces expected costs by over 80% against the human baseline and by more than 50% against the best competing open-source model, while larger baselines remain economically unviable.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 缩小文件VLM的成本-质量差距:困难-智能数据校验和质量-调整部署经济学
articles.content_zh: 每年从数以亿计的文件中提取结构化的字段,在受管制的行业中仍然是代价高昂的:标定的OCR级联只涵盖一小部分工作流程,隐私规则排除了外部模型,现有的开源的VLM,其明确的质量阈值成本比人类注释要高。 我们提出一个已部署的文件理解系统,该系统以专家的VLM(35B共计,3B活动)混合的、内部生产数据进行微调,并配有由布局多样性、事实可取性和跨模式一致性的开放域文件管道。 该模型利用单一的H100,通过提示提供不同工作流程,引导所有可部署(非合理)基线,其规模可达较大。 经过质量调整的成本分析,对生产遥测的确认和校正成本进行了校正,结果显示,与人类基线相比,预期成本减少了80%以上,与最佳竞争的开源模型相比,预期成本减少了50%以上,而更大的基线在经济上仍然不可行。

articles.title: Scaling Near-Optimal SFT-RL Annotation Budget Allocation from Small to Large LLMs
articles.content: How to divide a fixed annotation budget between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) during LLM post-training remains an open problem. Existing work characterizes only broad trends (e.g., SFT dominates in low-data regimes), lacks a principled allocation framework, and does not examine whether the optimal ratio transfers across model sizes. We frame this problem in terms of near-optimality: rather than seeking a single optimal SFT-RL ratio, we characterize the near-optimal region, the set of allocations within a specified tolerance of peak performance. Empirically, this region is wide even for small tolerances (2-10%), widens with model scale, and transfers reliably from small proxy models to large target models. This yields a practical strategy: small proxy-model experiments suffice to identify a transferable near-optimal region, eliminating the need for exhaustive large-scale search. Our results hold consistently across tasks, model families, and both preference-based off-policy and reward-supervision on-policy RL methods. We further analyze how the asymmetry in annotation costs between SFT and RL data shifts the near-optimal region.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从小型到大型有限责任公司的预算分配
articles.content_zh: 在LLM培训后,如何将固定的注解预算在有监督的微调(SFT)和强化学习(RL)之间划分,仍然是一个尚未解决的问题. 现有工作只是大趋势的特征(例如,SFT在低数据制度中占主导地位),缺乏原则性的分配框架,没有审查模型大小之间的最佳比例转移。 我们从近乎最佳的角度来看待这个问题:我们不是寻求单一的最佳SFT-RL比,而是将近乎最佳的区域描述为在对峰值表现的特定容忍范围内的一组分配。 从经验上看,这个区域即使对小的耐受性(2-10%)也是广阔的,随着模型尺度的扩大,并且从小的代理模型可靠地转移到了大的目标模型. 这产生了一种实用的战略:小规模的代用模型实验足以确定一个可转移的近乎最佳的区域,从而不再需要进行彻底的大规模搜索。 我们的成果始终贯穿于各种任务、模范家庭以及基于优惠的政策外和奖励监督政策RL方法。 我们进一步分析SFT和RL数据之间注释成本的不对称如何改变接近最佳的区域。

articles.title: From Production Traffic to Post-Training: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers the Corporate Request Mix
articles.content: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool. We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution. Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to production traffic and scored by deterministic verifiers or calibrated LLM judges. Rather than optimising all objectives jointly, which introduces cross-domain reward interference, we train a separate GRPO expert per axis and merge them via two-stage SLERP. Each expert's reward exposes a distinct failure mode, namely semantic collapse, over-calling, and verbosity hacking, each requiring a domain-specific fix. In non-reasoning mode the recipe surpasses a ${\sim}7\times$ larger by total parameters baseline on the in-house Arena with 69.6 to 65.8, instruction following with 0.85 to 0.83, and function-calling with 0.79 to 0.77, while lifting general dialogue benchmarks. The model absorbs 50% of platform traffic, 116M requests per month, at a fraction of the serving cost.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从生产交通到培训后:建立自居LLM 包含公司请求的混合
articles.content_zh: 数据存续性限制迫使企业自行托管LLMS,但是在不退役的情况下不断采用更新型的模型会扩大服务机队,使有限的GPU池被打碎. 我们将200多个内部应用程序的流量整合到一个单一的模型中,方法是按照三个轴线缩小通过生产出错分析发现的质量差距:以下指示、功能调用和内部任务分配。 质量通过离线基准按生产流量进行分级跟踪,并由确定性核查员或校准的LLM评分员评分. 我们不是联合优化所有目标,即引入跨域奖励干预,而是每轴培训一个单独的GPRO专家,并通过两个阶段的SLERP合并. 每个专家的奖励都暴露出一个明显的失败模式,即语义崩溃,过度调用,和动词黑客化,每一个都需要一个特定域的固定. 在非合理模式下,配方比内部竞技场总参数基线多出7美元,69.6至65.8分,指令随0.85至0.83分,功能调用为0.79至0.77分,同时取消一般对话基准。 该模型吸收了50%的平台流量,每月116M请求,占服务成本的一小部分.

articles.title: Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy: Learning Autonomous Policies from Imperfect VLM Teachers
articles.content: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide useful priors for interactive decision-making, but using them directly as policies is expensive and brittle: they must be queried at every step, do not improve from environment interaction, and can repeat systematic errors. We study how to learn a cheap autonomous policy from an online, expensive, and imperfect but informative VLM teacher. We propose SAGE (Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy), a framework that queries a VLM only when the learner is uncertain, executes the suggested action during training, and distills guidance into a lightweight Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy. Because VLM advice is not always reliable, SAGE can weight teacher-action distillation using environment-derived advantages rather than treating all suggestions as equally useful. Across sparse-reward visual reasoning and navigation tasks, SAGE learns policies that act without VLM guidance at evaluation time and improves over unguided RL in several environments, including settings where the learned policy exceeds its VLM teacher. The results show that selective guidance is most beneficial when the VLM can help the agent discover high-reward trajectories, and less useful when unguided exploration already succeeds or teacher actions do not lead to informative experience. SAGE also reduces VLM usage by prompting the teacher only on a fraction of training steps and requiring no VLM calls at deployment. Overall, our results suggest that VLMs don't need to be used as fixed policies to be useful; they can instead act as temporary, imperfect sources of guidance whose value is tested and internalized through interaction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过 Entropy 进行选择性代理指导:从不完美 VLM 学习自主政策 教师
articles.content_zh: 远景-语言模型(VLMs)为互动决策提供了有用的前科,但直接将其作为政策来使用是昂贵而简洁的:必须逐步询问它们,不从环境互动中改进,并且可以重复系统的错误. 我们研究如何从一个在线、昂贵、不完善但信息丰富的VLM教师那里学习廉价的自主政策。 我们提出SAGE(通过 Entropy 选择代理指导),这个框架只有在学习者不确定时才会询问VLM,在培训期间执行建议的行动,并将指导提炼成轻量级强化学习(RL)政策. 由于VLM建议并不总是可靠的,SAGE可以利用环境衍生的优势对教师动作分解进行加权,而不是将所有建议视为同样有用. SAGE在评价时学习了在无VLM指导的情况下采取行动的政策,并且在若干环境中,包括在所学政策超过VLM教师的情况下,改进了无指导的RL。 结果显示,当VLM能帮助剂发现高回报轨迹时,选择性指导最为有益,而当非被引导的探索已经成功或师资行动没有导致信息化经验时,则用处较小. SAGE还减少VLM的用法,只提醒教师采取一小部分培训步骤,要求部署时不使用VLM呼叫. 总体而言,我们的结果表明,VLM不需要作为固定政策来使用,而有用;相反,它们可以作为临时的,不完善的指导来源,其价值通过互动来测试和内化.

articles.title: From Confusion to Clarity: Confusion-Aware Retrieval and Knowledge Injection for Text Classification
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) struggle to classify text into taxonomies with many semantically similar labels, as the distinctions are domain-specific and not captured by pre-training. To handle large label spaces, a common approach retrieves top-$K$ candidate labels by embedding similarity and prompt the LLM to choose among them. However, top-$K$ retrieval reduces the number of candidates but does not help the model tell similar ones apart. When two similar labels both appear as candidates, the model lacks the signal to choose correctly between them. We propose a framework that (1) identifies which label pairs the model struggles to distinguish, (2) expands the candidate set to include confusable labels, and (3) generates targeted rules to differentiate between similar candidates. The framework requires no fine-tuning, and the generated rules transfer to smaller, cheaper models. On three benchmarks (WOS, Flipkart, LEDGAR), our approach improves Macro F1 by up to 10.0pp over retrieval baselines, with smaller models (2B--20B) gaining up to 11.5pp via cross-model transfer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从混淆到清晰:对文字分类的困惑-软件检索和知识注入
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)拼命地将文本分类为分类学,许多分类学上相似的标签,因为区分是域特异性的,没有被预训所捕捉. 为了处理大的标签空格,一个通用的方法通过嵌入相似性来取回上-美元候选标签并促使LLM在其中选择. 然而,高额的K$检索减少了考生人数,但无助于模型区分出类似的考生. 当两个相类似的标签都作为候选人出现时,模型缺乏信号,无法在它们之间正确选择. 我们提出了一个框架,即(1) 确定哪些标签与模型难以区分,(2) 扩大一组候选人,以包括可信任的标签,(3) 产生目标明确的规则,以区分类似的候选人。 该框架不需要微调,生成的规则也转移到更小更便宜的模型上。 在三个基准(WOS, Flipkart, LEDGAR)上,我们的方法改进了Macro F1,比取取取基线最多可达10.0pp,较小的模型(2B--20B)通过跨型号传输可达到11.5pp.

articles.title: A systematic Approach to constructing a Chance-and-Risk Matrix for Semiconductor Supply Chains
articles.content: Semiconductor supply chains face escalating risks from geopolitical tensions, geographic concentration, and rapid technological shifts, yet no scalable system continuously extracts, structures, and prioritizes risk intelligence from public corporate disclosures. We present an end-to-end pipeline that retrieves corporate documents for semiconductor companies and uses large language models (LLMs) to extract the risks and opportunities they describe. It organizes these into a knowledge graph linking each item to its category, sources, and related events, then merges duplicates and ranks them with a three-layer mechanism combining an algorithmic formula, an LLM relevance adjustment, and expert validation. Applied to five companies across the value chain, the pipeline produces 76,207 scored items, of which an independent check finds 92.6% valid. The automated rankings match expert judgment at an average Spearman correlation of 0.55 for risks and 0.72 for opportunities, and the resulting matrices identify trade restrictions as the dominant cross-company risk.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 建立半导体供应链机会和风险矩阵的系统办法
articles.content_zh: 半导体供应链面临着地缘政治紧张、地域集中和技术迅速变化等不断升级的风险,但没有任何可扩展的系统持续提取公共公司披露的风险情报、结构和优先排序。 我们提出了一个端到端管道,为半导体公司检索公司文件,并使用大型语言模型来提取它们描述的风险和机会。 它将这些项目组织成一个知识图,将每个项目与其类别、来源和相关事件联系起来,然后将重复合并,并用一个三层机制排列,将算法公式、LLM相关性调整和专家验证结合起来。 该管道适用于整个价值链的五个公司,生产了76 207个打分的项目,其中92.6%是有效的。 自动排名与专家的判断相符,Spearman对风险的平均关联度为0.55,对机会的关联度为0.72,由此产生的矩阵将贸易限制确定为主要的跨公司风险。

articles.title: SDARE-Bench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Conversational Stigma Detection and Response in Dyadic and Group Dialogue
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in advice seeking and decision making that may affect social judgements. Despite stigma's profound effects on people and communities, benchmarks remain scarce. Existing general-domain evaluations typically rely on static prompts and fixed-format tasks, overlooking conversational contexts and audience effects in everyday communication. To address these gaps, we introduce SDARE-Bench, the first scenario-based benchmark evaluating both stigma detection and open-ended response generation in LLMs, comprising 1,138 dyadic queries and 1,388 group dialogue. Empirical results across 8 LLMs consistently demonstrate poor identification of stigma components, especially in group dialogues. In open-ended response generation, stigma expression was substantially higher in group settings than in dyadic, with weaker resistance to stigma and more unrealistic advice. Responses were evaluated using a classifier trained on 1,392 human annotated responses. In constructed group pressure settings, stigma expression rates further increased to a striking average of 97.5%. Our findings identify stigma response as a recurring LLM safety vulnerability, especially in socially complex conversational contexts.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SDARE-Bench:评价大语言模型在Dyadic和Group对话中的争议性羞辱检测和反应
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)越来越多地用于寻求可能影响社会判断的咨询和决策. 尽管污名化对人民和社区产生深远影响,但基准仍然很少。 现有的一般领域评价一般依靠静态提示和固定格式的任务,忽视对话背景和日常交流中的受众效应. 为了弥补这些差距,我们采用了SDARE-Bench,这是第一个基于情景的基准,评价LLMs的耻辱感检测和无限制反应生成,包括1,138个督导查询和1,388个集体对话。 8个有限责任妇女的经验性结果始终表明,特别是在群体对话中,对污名因素的识别不足。 在无限制的应对措施中,在群体环境中,污名化的表达远远高于dyadic,对污名化的抵抗力更弱,建议更不切实际。 利用接受过1 392个附加说明的人类答复培训的分类员对答复进行了评估。 在已建群体压力环境下,污名化表达率进一步上升到惊人的平均水平97.5%. 我们的调查结果认为,耻辱感反应是一种反复出现的LLM安全脆弱性,特别是在社会复杂的对话背景下。

articles.title: Knowledge Distillation During Mid-Training Favors Reasoning over Factual Recall
articles.content: Logit-based knowledge distillation (KD) is used to train smaller language models (LMs) via supervision from stronger teachers, but whether its benefits are consistent across training stages remains unclear. Through controlled experiments, we find that forward Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation--the standard KD formulation--with post-trained teachers behaves fundamentally differently during mid-training, an intermediate phase of self-supervised learning on curated corpora. Surprisingly, while forward KD simultaneously improves reasoning and factual recall during pre-training relative to standard next-token prediction (NTP), it instead slows factual recall acquisition during mid-training despite continued reasoning gains. We trace this stage dependence to an asymmetry in teacher confidence across data domains and the student's evolving knowledge state: teachers are more confident on procedural than knowledge-intensive data, while students acquire low-entropy factual knowledge earlier in training. To mitigate this imbalance, we propose Switch Distillation, a simple mid-training objective that distills on tokens where the teacher is confident, using teacher predictive entropy as a lightweight routing signal, and otherwise falls back to cross-entropy. Switch Distillation consistently outperforms existing distillation objectives across teacher sizes. Relative to standard NTP, it achieves 1.61-1.71x the reasoning performance and 1.13-1.19x the knowledge and commonsense performance while preserving 96.7-96.8% of factual recall. Crucially, these benefits persist after post-training: Switch Distillation closes the factual recall gap while maintaining 1.25-1.32x and 1.13-1.20x gains in reasoning and knowledge and commonsense, respectively.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在中培训阶段的知识沉滞 事实回忆的理性
articles.content_zh: 基于逻辑的知识蒸馏法(KD)用于通过更强的教师的监督来培训较小的语言模型(LM),但其好处在培训阶段是否一致仍不清楚. 通过有控制的实验,我们发现,前方的Kullback-Leibler(KL)蒸馏器(KL)——标准KD配方——与接受过培训后教师在中训期间的行为根本不同,这是自我监督学习的中间阶段。 令人惊讶的是,虽然在前期培训期间,与标准次子预测(NTP)相比,前期KD同时改进了推理和事实召回,但在中期培训期间却放慢了实际召回的速度,尽管推理不断提高。 我们追踪到这一阶段的依赖程度,是跨数据领域教师信心的不对称和学生不断演变的知识状态:教师对程序数据比知识密集型数据更有信心,而学生在早期的训练中则获得较低的实际知识. 为了缓解这种不平衡,我们提出Switch Distillation, 一个简单的中期训练目标, 在老师自信的标志上蒸馏, 用老师的预测式 en作为轻量级的路由信号, 否则会回到交叉内线。 切换蒸馏持续超过现有师资规模的蒸馏目标。 相对于标准NTP,它实现了1.61-1.71x推理性能和1.13-1.19x知识和常识性能,同时保留了96.7-96.8%的事实召回. 关键是,这些好处在培训后依然存在:Switch Distillation缩小了事实上的召回差距,同时在推理、知识和常识方面分别保持1.25-1.32x和1.13-1.20x的收益。

articles.title: GlossoGen: Emergent Language in Complex Multi-Agent LLM Interactions
articles.content: The growing rate at which LLM agents interact with one another raises key questions about language evolution in multi-LLM-agent settings, with implications for safety and monitorability as well as for linguistic accounts of LLMs. To address these questions, we introduce GlossoGen, a novel platform for studying multi-agent language evolution in complex scenarios. Within GlossoGen, we build the SaveVeyru scenario, which requires agents with partial information to communicate under pressure. We find that language evolution does occur between LLM agents, that the resulting languages are compositional and morphologically productive, and that they deviate from the LLMs' English prior in ways that render them incomprehensible to humans. Moreover, we identify several qualities essential to this evolution: pressure towards efficiency; the strength of the models backing the agents; and access to a "postmortem" stage in which agents can agree on linguistic conventions. Importantly, we observe that different conditions govern the transmission of language to new agents. Specifically, we find that agents learn new languages from usage alone, take an active role in this learning, and that while stronger models are required for novel language emergence, weaker models can learn an existing language once it has emerged. Taken together, our results indicate that current LLMs have the potential for cumulative cultural evolution -- previously attested only in humans -- with mixed populations of agents developing capacities that go beyond their lowest common denominator.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GlossoGen:复杂多代理 LLM 中的新兴语言 互动
articles.content_zh: LLM剂相互间相互作用的速度日益加快,对多种LLM剂环境中的语言演化提出了关键问题,对LLM的安全和可监测性以及语言描述都有影响。 为了解决这些问题,我们引入了GlossoGen,这是研究复杂情景中的多代理语言演化的一个新平台. 在GlossoGen内部,我们构建了SaveVeyru情景,这需要具有部分信息的特工在压力下进行交流. 我们发现语言进化确实发生在LLM剂之间,由此产生的语言是组成性的和形态性的,它们偏离了LLMs的英语之前的方式,使得人类无法理解. 此外,我们确定了这一演变所必不可少的若干品质:对效率的压力;支持物剂的模型的力量;以及进入“死后”阶段,物剂可以就语言公约达成协议。 重要的是,我们认为,向新代理人传递语言的条件不同。 具体地说,我们发现代理人单独从使用中学习新语言,在这种学习中发挥积极作用,虽然新语言的出现需要更强大的模型,但较弱的模型一旦出现,就可以学习现有的语言. 综上所述,我们的结果表明,目前的法学硕士学位具有累积文化演变的潜力 -- -- 以前只在人类中得到证明 -- -- 由各种代理人组成的混合群体正在发展能力,超越其最低的共同标准。

articles.title: AutoConcept: Training-Free Concept-Guided Reranking for Metadata-Available Composed Image Retrieval
articles.content: Composed image retrieval (CIR) retrieves a target image from a reference image and a text modification. This paper studies metadata-available CIR reranking, where a fixed CIR model first returns a candidate pool and gallery metadata is then used for second-stage concept-guided scoring. We introduce AutoConcept, a training-free reranker that converts concept evidence into an interpretable memory. AutoConcept filters noisy concepts, activates query-relevant positive constraints with an auxiliary negative penalty, and combines base retrieval scores with metadata-based concept-candidate alignment through inference-time calibration. On FashionIQ, AutoConcept yields significant early-rank improvements over WeiMoCIR and consistent plug-in gains on LinCIR candidate pools. Metadata-aware controls show that structured concept memory adds signal beyond direct query-text and extracted-attribute matching, while a query-only variant further supports the effectiveness of concept-level reranking. A supplementary real-human concept-label study indicates that the same memory interface can consume participant-provided evidence. These results position AutoConcept as an interpretable concept-memory reranker for product-style CIR galleries with available metadata.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AutoConcept: 培训-无概念- 引导重排元数据编译图像检索
articles.content_zh: 编成的图像检索(CIR)从参考图像和文本修改中检索到目标图像. 本文研究了可用的元数据 CIR 重新排序,其中固定的 CIR 模型首先返回一个候选集合,然后用于第二阶段的概念引导评分. 我们引入了AutoConcept,一种免费训练的重新排名器,将概念证据转换成可解释的内存. AutoConcept过滤吵闹的概念,用辅助负罚激活与查询相关的正约束,并通过推断-时间校准,将基础检索分数与基于元数据的概念-candidate校正相结合. 在FashionIQ上,AutoConcept比WeiMOCIR取得了显著的早期改进,并且对LinCIR候选池的插入收益也是一致的. 元数据感知控制显示结构化的概念内存会添加超越直接查询-文本和提取-属性匹配的信号,而仅查询的变体则进一步支持概念级重新排序的有效性. 一项补充的真人概念标签研究表明,同样的内存接口可以消耗参与者提供的证据. 这些结果将AutoConcept定位为具有可用元数据的产品风格CIR画廊的可解释概念-记忆重排器.

articles.title: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?
articles.content: As agents move from research prototypes to deployed tools, their capability increasingly depends on model-external execution infrastructure, commonly termed the agent harness. Changing this harness while holding model weights fixed can substantially alter task performance. Current agent evaluations typically report downstream performance under a chosen harness, leaving a model's ability to develop the harness itself comparatively underexplored. We introduce HarnessDev, a benchmark that shifts the unit of evaluation from task outputs to runnable infrastructure. HarnessDev covers two stages. In Creation, the agent starts from a minimal seed and a small number of cases, then builds a complete execution system. In Evolution, it starts from its own created harness and iteratively revises it using downstream execution feedback, with the goal of improving benchmark performance. We then evaluate each constructed harness on capability (task success on held-out benchmarks) and efficiency (execution-token cost). The reported Creation results cover six creator LLMs, four domains, and five downstream benchmarks totaling 2,207 unique downstream instances, with hidden evaluation tasks withheld from development. We find that generated harnesses remain substantially behind mature human-engineered references on code and on search and research, while matching or exceeding the selected references on writing and machine-learning experimentation, with large variation in execution cost. Evolution produces some performance gains, but they are unstable and transfer only partially to held-out tasks. Experiments with a fixed runtime model further show that the gains depend strongly on the model executing the harness, indicating limited transfer across models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HarnessDev:LLMS能创建并发展他们自己的特工Harness吗?
articles.content_zh: 随着代理商从研究原型转向部署工具,其能力越来越依赖于模式-外部执行基础设施,通常称为代理机。 在掌握固定模型重量的同时改变这种牵引力,可以大大改变任务性能. 目前的毒剂评价通常报告在选定的利用下下游的业绩,使模型开发利用自身的能力相对不足。 我们引入了HarnessDev,这一基准将评价单位从任务产出转向可运行的基础设施。 调和 Dev涵盖两个阶段. 在创建中,代理从最小的种子和少量的病例开始,然后建立一个完整的执行系统. 在Evolution中,它从自己创造的杠杆开始,并使用下游执行反馈反复修改,目的是提高基准性能. 然后,我们根据能力(在搁置基准上的任务成功)和效率(执行成本)来评价所构建的每一种利用。 报告的创建成果涵盖六个创建者有限责任管理单元、四个领域和五个下游基准,共计2 207个独特的下游实例,其中隐藏的评价任务不用于开发。 我们发现,所生成的绳索仍然远远落后于人类设计的关于代码和搜索与研究的成熟参考文献,同时匹配或超过关于书写和机器学习实验的选定参考文献,在执行成本方面差异很大。 进化产生一些绩效收益,但它们不稳定,只部分转移到被搁置的任务. 使用固定运行时间模型的实验进一步表明,收益在很大程度上取决于执行控制带的模型,表明模型之间的转移有限。

articles.title: Citing Less Critically: LLMs Reshape the Rhetoric and Reach of Scientific Citation
articles.content: Scientific citations carry rhetorical intent. Scholars may cite prior work positively (supporting), negatively (contrasting), or neutrally (mentioning). As large language models (LLMs) increasingly assist scientific writing, whether they reproduce citations with the same rhetorical intent as humans remains unclear. We introduce a masked-citation task to compare human and LLM-generated citation behavior. For each citation context, an LLM generates a replacement citation sentence, producing a counterfactual corpus directly comparable to human citation. We analyze what, whom, and how models cite, using an LLM-as-a-judge to classify citation intent and a 20-million-edge coauthorship network to measure social distance between cited authors. Across six popular LLMs and 1,746 top NLP conference papers (63k+ contexts, 132k+ citations), three patterns emerge: (1) Compared with human citation, LLMs cite significantly less critically; (2) LLMs over-cite popular and older papers, a tendency amplified for contrasting citations where human writing more often draws on recent, niche work; (3) Whereas humans often cite within their close social network, especially for supporting citations, LLMs tend to draw on more socially distant authors. Together, these differences are double-edged: LLM citation reaches beyond a scholar's close collaborators while being less critical and amplifying visibility bias, reshaping the rhetoric and reach of scientific citation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 较不严谨的引用: LLMs 重塑 Rhetoric and Reach of Scientific 引文
articles.content_zh: 科学引用带有修辞意图。 学者可以正面(支持)、负面(质疑)或中立(提醒)地引用先前的工作。 由于大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越有助于科学写作,它们是否复制引用时带有与人类相同的修辞意图,仍然不清楚. 我们提出一个蒙面引用任务来比较人类和LLM产生的引用行为. 对于每一个引用语境,一个LLM生成一个替代引用句,生成一个与人类引用直接相当的反事实体. 我们分析什么,谁,以及模型如何引用,使用LLM-as-a-judge对引用意图进行分类,以及一个2000万的前沿合作网络来测量被引用作者之间的社会距离. 在六个受欢迎的法学硕士和1 746份NLP会议论文(63k+背景,132k+引用)中,出现了三种模式: (1) 与人的引用相比,LLMs引用的批判性要小得多;(2) LLMs过多地发表流行和较古老的论文,这种倾向因比较引证而扩大,因为人类的著作更经常地借鉴近期的特色作品;(3) 人类往往在其密切的社会网络中引用,特别是为了支持引用,LLMs则倾向于借鉴社会上较远的作者。 这些差异加在一起是双重的: LLM引文超越了学者的亲密合作者,同时较少批评和扩大可见度偏差,重塑了科学引文的修辞和覆盖范围.

articles.title: From Rollouts to Recipes: Self-Contained Post-Training for LLMs
articles.content: Post-training large language models usually applies a single training recipe to all samples, even though the model's own rollouts reveal different sample-level learning states. We propose Self-Routing, a behavior-conditioned post-training framework that uses rollout correctness and confidence to decide how each sample should be optimized. Depending on its behavior state, a sample is routed to GRPO, on-policy self-distillation, regularization, or skipping, allowing training to adapt without external teachers, extra annotations, or additional sampling. Experiments on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 backbones show that Self-Routing consistently improves over uniform GRPO, uniform OPSD, fixed mixtures, and simpler routing baselines. Further analyses show that the routing distribution changes over training and reduces unnecessary updates on low-signal or already stable samples.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从推出到食谱: 法学硕士自学后培训
articles.content_zh: 训练后大型语言模型通常对所有样本采用单一的训练食谱,尽管模型自己的推出揭示了不同的样本级学习状态. 我们提出自我运行,一个行为有条件的训练后框架,使用推出的正确性和信心来决定如何优化每个样本. 根据其行为状态,一个样本被引导到GRPO,在政策上自我消化,规范化,或跳过,允许培训在没有外部教师,附加说明,或附加样本的情况下适应. 跨Quen3和Quen3.5主干线的数学推理实验显示,自旋比统一的GRPO,统一的OPSD,固定的混合物,更简单的路由基线不断改进. 进一步的分析表明,路线分布在培训之后有所改变,减少了低信号或已经稳定的样本的不必要的更新。

articles.title: EdiTikZ: Scientific Figure Editing from Revision Trajectories
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance in generating scientific figures from text or images. However, producing publication-ready figures requires iterative refinement, making scientific figure editing an important yet largely unexplored task. Existing approaches rely on costly proprietary agentic systems, focus primarily on evaluation, or construct training supervision from synthetically generated edits. Instead, we leverage naturally occurring scientific revision and development trajectories as a scalable source of supervision. To this end, we introduce DaEdiTikZ, the first large-scale dataset of revision-derived scientific figure edits, constructed by mining 391K plausible TikZ edit pairs from arXiv, GitHub, and TeX SE and inferring 781K directed edit instructions with a VLM conditioned on rendered figures and TikZ code. We further introduce DaEdiTikZ-Bench, a human-refined benchmark with 790 instances, and train two compact Qwen3.5-based EdiTikZ models (4B and 9B) by jointly learning reconstruction and editing, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) with complementary rewards for rendered fidelity and edit application. Automatic evaluation places our 9B model above all tested baselines, while human evaluation with 9 annotators and 4,320 ratings places it above GPT-5.6-Sol and on par with Gemini-3.1-Pro. Under severe out-of-distribution shifts, it remains competitive with GPT-5.6-Sol near its 2K training sequence-length regime. Models and datasets will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EdiTikZ: 订正轨迹的科学图编辑
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在从文本或图像中生成科学数字方面表现出了强大的表现. 然而,制作已准备好的出版物数字需要反复完善,使科学人物编辑成为一项重要但基本上未经探讨的任务。 现有办法依靠昂贵的专有代理系统,主要侧重于评价,或通过合成编辑建立培训监督。 相反,我们利用自然出现的科学修正和发展轨迹作为可扩展的监督来源。 为此,我们引入了DaEdiTikZ,这是第一套由修订衍生的科学人物编辑组成的大型数据集,由挖掘391K 可信的TikZ编辑对从arXiv, GitHub, 和TeX SE 构造,并推断781K 直接编辑指令,其中以生成的数字和TikZ代码为条件的VLM。 我们进一步引入了DaEdiTikZ-Bench,这是人类精炼的基准,有790个实例,并通过联合学习重建和编辑,培训两个基于Qune3.5的EdiTikZ型号(4B和9B),然后是强化学习(RL),对忠贞化和编辑应用给予补充奖励。 自动评价将我们的9B模型置于所有测试基线之上,而人类评价有9个注释员和4,320个评级将其置于GPT-5.6-Sol之上,与双子座3.1-Pro相当。 在分配外的严重转移下,它仍然与GPT-5.6-Sol在接近其2K训练序列长度的制度上竞争. 将发布模型和数据集。

articles.title: When Tokenization is Secretly Output Supervision
articles.content: Tokenization in language models is treated by default as an input preprocessing decision. We argue that this framing is incomplete: in autoregressive models, tokenizer granularity determines what the model must resolve in a single forward pass, and therefore the supervision signal it receives. This affects both the difficulty of the learning problem and the representations that emerge inside the model. We test this in a controlled experiment on numeric reasoning with a novel decoupling of input and output tokenization. As the output supervision view predicts, differences in task performance, training dynamics, and model internals are induced by output tokenization and largely invariant to input tokenization. This may matter in practice, because models with different tokenization strategies differ not only in input representation but in the task they were trained on. Comparisons between models may thus partly reflect task definition rather than ability. A survey of 120 recent *CL papers on numeric reasoning confirms that this is rarely acknowledged: only about 10% report the numeric tokenization of the models they evaluate, while 69% compare across tokenization, and thus supervision, regimes without reporting it. While prior work documents that tokenization consistently affects model performance, there is no principled account of why. We argue that framing tokenization as output supervision provides that account.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当托肯化是秘密输出监督
articles.content_zh: 语言模型中的tokenization默认作为输入预处理决定处理. 我们认为这种框架是不完整的:在自递性模型中,标定剂颗粒性决定了模型在单个前传中必须解决什么问题,从而决定它收到的监督信号. 这既影响到学习问题的困难,也影响到模型内出现的表述. 我们用输入和输出符号化的新型脱钩法 来进行数字推理的 控制实验 正如产出监督观点所预测的那样,任务性能,训练动力学,以及模型内部的差别,都是由产出符号化诱导的,基本上对输入符号化不具有变化性. 这在实践中可能很重要,因为具有不同标志化战略的模型不仅在投入表述方面不同,而且在接受过培训的任务方面也不同。 因此,模型之间的比较可能部分反映任务定义而不是能力。 对最近120份*CL关于数字推理的论文的调查证实,这一点很少被承认:只有大约10%的人报告了他们所评价的模型的数值符号化,而69%的人比较了各种符号化,从而比较了监督制度而不报告。 虽然以往的工作文件总是对示范业绩产生影响,但没有原则性地说明原因。 我们主张,将象征性化作为产出监督提供这一账户。

articles.title: InSight: A Benchmark for Agentic Claim Verification in Interactive Visualizations
articles.content: Vision Language Models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in interpreting static visual artifacts, but modern data analysis is inherently dynamic, requiring the active interrogation of interactive environments. Existing benchmarks are predominantly constrained to static imagery and one-shot question answering and fail to capture the epistemic demands of this domain, where evidence is frequently occluded, distributed across linked views, or conditionally revealed through user agency. In this paper, we introduce InSight, a benchmark for agentic claim verification over interactive visualizations. The dataset consists of 21,349 claims derived from human-authored analytical narratives and grounded in fully interactive web-based environments. Agents must navigate these environments to determine whether a natural language claim is supported, refuted or not verifiable given the available evidence. Unlike traditional evaluations, InSight treats interaction traces as intrinsic proxies for reasoning, enabling a rigorous audit of how models seek and synthesize visual evidence. We evaluate state-of-the-art models, revealing that interactive verification remains a non-trivial challenge. We release InSight at https://github.com/maevehutch/insight.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: InSight:互动可视化中代理索赔核查基准
articles.content_zh: Vision Language Models在诠释静态视觉文物方面表现出了出众的熟练度,但现代数据分析本质上是动态的,需要积极询问交互环境. 现有基准主要限于静态图像和一弹一弹的问题回答,无法捕捉到该领域的感知性需求,因为在这个领域,证据经常被占用、在链接的观点中传播,或通过用户机构有条件地披露。 在本文中,我们引入了InSight,这是相对于交互式可视化的代理索赔核查的基准. 数据集由21,349个来自由人类授权的分析叙述,基于完全互动的网络环境的诉求组成. 代理人必须在这些环境中航行,以确定根据现有证据,自然语言主张是否得到支持、反驳或无法核实。 与传统评价不同,"InSight"将相互作用痕迹视为推理的内在代名词,使得能够对模型如何寻求并合成视觉证据进行严格的审计. 我们评价最新模式,揭示互动核查仍然是非三角挑战。 在https://github.com/maevehutch/insight上,

articles.title: Polish ModernBERT: The Long and Short of Polish Language Understanding
articles.content: Encoder-only Transformers remain effective for discriminative and representation-learning tasks, yet Polish encoders still largely rely on BERT/RoBERTa-style architectures. We introduce \textbf{Polish ModernBERT}, a family of four Polish encoders available at Base and Large scales, each with 512-token and 8K context variants. We adapt the ModernBERT pretraining recipe through staged selection experiments and release a long-context benchmark covering legal topic classification, ideological decision-direction prediction, factual-consistency assessment over literary plot summaries, and human-rights violation assessment. Across 30 tasks, Polish ModernBERT achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated Polish encoders, reaching 83.99 and 85.11 for the Base-8K and Large-8K models, respectively. On long-context tasks, the 8K variants improve over matched Polish RoBERTa-8K baselines from 67.47 to 77.15 and from 75.88 to 78.49 at the Base and Large scales, respectively. The Base-8K model achieves this gain with 22\% fewer parameters (149M vs.\ 190M). Efficiency measurements in representative inference setups show lower peak memory usage and latency than matched Polish RoBERTa baselines in both 512-token and 8K settings. Polish ModernBERT-8K-Base additionally achieves the best result on a Polish retrieval benchmark among the evaluated encoders below 300M parameters.

articles.title_zh: 波兰现代伯特:波兰语言理解的长短
articles.content_zh: 只有编码器的变形器仍然能有效完成歧视性和表现式学习任务,然而波兰的编码器仍然在很大程度上依赖于BERT/ROBERTa风格的建筑. 我们介绍\textbf{波兰现代BERT},一个由四个波兰编码器组成的家族,在Base and Largescale上可以使用,每个编码器都有512Token和8K上下文变体. 我们通过分阶段的挑选试验来调整现代BERT的预训方法,并发布一个长文基准,涵盖法律主题分类、意识形态决策指导预测、对文学情节摘要的事实一致性评估和侵犯人权情况评估。 在30项任务中,波兰现代电视台在被评价的波兰编码器中取得了最佳的总体业绩,Base-8K和Lige-8K模型分别达到83.99和85.11。 在长篇任务方面,8K变体在基座和大尺度上分别改进了与波兰的RoBERTa-8K基线相匹配的基线,分别从67.47到77.15和75.88到78.49。 Base-8K模型以22××(149M vs. 代表性推论设置的效率测量显示,在512-token和8K两种设置中,峰值内存使用率和耐久性都低于匹配的波兰RoBERTa基线。 波兰现代 此外,BERT-8K-Base在300M参数以下的评价编码器中,在波兰检索基准方面取得了最佳结果。

articles.title: IntroConformal: Conformal Factuality Guarantees for Large Vision-Language Models via Introspective Signals
articles.content: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved strong multimodal performance, yet ensuring the factual correctness of generated content remains challenging. Existing methods that provide statistical guarantees on factuality typically rely on external verifiers or generation-time confidence signals, which introduce auxiliary dependencies or often fail for confident but incorrect outputs. We argue that reliable factuality control can instead be achieved through introspective signals derived from the model itself. We introduce IntroConformal, a training-free Conformal Risk Control (CRC) framework that provides finite-sample, distribution-free factuality guarantees. We first instantiate it with layer-wise semantic stability, a conformity score derived from hidden-state representations, and then propose verification probability, a stronger score capturing the model's self-administered judgment on claim factuality. Across multiple LVLM architectures, IntroConformal satisfies the conformal risk guarantee while substantially reducing abstention and achieving competitive or superior claim-level discrimination relative to external verifier-based baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 非正式: 通过透视信号实现大视野-语言模型的正规实际保障
articles.content_zh: 大型Vision-Langage Models(LVLMs)已经取得了很强的多模式性能,然而,确保生成内容的事实正确性仍然是个挑战。 现有方法对事实性提供统计保障,一般依靠外部验证器或生成时间信心信号,这些信号引入了辅助依赖性,或者常常因自信但错误的产出而失败. 我们主张,通过模型本身产生的内向信号,可以实现可靠的事实质量控制。 我们引入了无培训的 " 非正式风险控制 " 框架,该框架提供有限样本、无分配的事实保障。 我们首先用分层的语义稳定性来即时化它,一个从隐藏状态表述中得出的符合性分数,然后提出验证概率,一个更强的分数来捕捉模型自己对声称事实性的判断. 在多个LVLM架构中,IntroConform满足了符合性风险的保证,同时大幅降低了弃权率,实现了与外部核查者基准相比的竞争性或优越的索赔层次歧视。

articles.title: Behaviorally Effective LoRA Writes Are Sparse and Structured
articles.content:
Low-rank adaptation fixes the rank of the update, but it does not identify which parts of a trained
  write actually carry behavior. We study that question directly and show that behaviorally effective
  LoRA writes are sparse, structured, and far more concentrated than the raw low-rank parameterization
  suggests.
  We use Learned-Basis LoRA, a learned-basis continuation recipe, to expose that structure. The recipe
  warms up an unconstrained adapter, converts its learned write columns into a module-wise orthonormal
  basis, freezes that basis, and continues training inside the constrained parameterization. Across 14
  exact switches from unconstrained to constrained form, held-out accuracy is unchanged at the
  conversion step and reconstructed write matrices differ by at most 0.25% relative Frobenius error.
  Same-state continuation then shows that the same trained checkpoint develops differently under
  different write subspaces, establishing write geometry as a causal state variable. A no-retraining
  projection test shows that useful write signal stays inside the learned write space and largely
  disappears from random or frozen-activation PCA controls.
  The concentration pattern is strong at both local and global scales. Across GSM8K, MathQA, and AQuA,
  per-module top-k continuation reaches its optimum at k in {2, 4} in all twelve seed-level cases we
  test. A stricter global ranking test shows that learned top-16 and top-32 subsets outperform matched
  random subsets, especially on GSM8K/Qwen and MathQA/Qwen. Single-direction ablations further reveal a
  sparse set of late q_proj, o_proj, and down_proj components with outsized behavioral impact.

articles.title: How Correct Is Your Answer? A Semantic Correctness Framework for Open QA Evaluation
articles.content: Reliable evaluation of open-ended question answering remains a bottleneck for measuring answer correctness of modern LLMs. Unlike multiple-choice tasks, free-form answers may be correct in many surface forms and may fail in qualitatively different ways, including incompleteness, contradiction, overgeneration, and endorsement of false premises. Existing judgment-based and similarity-based metrics often collapse these distinctions. We address this gap with three reusable contributions. First, we introduce a semantic correctness taxonomy that assigns open-ended answers to eight ordered classes, separating verbose-but-correct answers from those contaminated by hallucinated content. Second, we release CAP-Correctness, an 8.8k-example benchmark spanning widely used QA datasets, and CAP-Statements, an 11k-example dataset for converting question-answer pairs into declarative statements for natural language inference (NLI) training and statement-based evaluation. Third, we introduce CAP (Context-Aware Precision), a reference-based metric that scores question-conditioned statements using bidirectional NLI. Under a monotonicity protocol testing whether metrics respect the taxonomy's intended ordering, CAP outperforms established baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 你的答案是怎样正确的? 开放式质量评估的语义正确性框架
articles.content_zh: 可靠地评价开放式问题答案仍然是衡量现代法学硕士的正确答案的一个瓶颈。 与多选择任务不同的是,自由形式答案可能在许多表面形式上正确,并可能以不同质量的方式失败,包括不完整,矛盾,多生成,以及背书假前提. 现有的基于判断和类似性的衡量标准往往使这些区别崩溃。 我们通过三份可重复使用的捐款来弥补这一差距。 首先,我们引入一个语义正确性分类法,将无限制的答案分配到8个指令类,将动词但正确答案与被幻觉内容污染的答案区分开来. 第二,我们发布CAP-Correctness,一个涵盖广泛使用的QA数据集的8.8k-实例基准,以及CAP-statements,一个11k-实例数据集,用于将问答对子转换成声明语,用于自然语言推论(NLI)培训和基于语句的评价. 第三,我们采用CAP(Context-Aware Precision),这是一个基于参考的衡量标准,使用双向NLI对问题有条件的语句进行评分. 在一个单调性协议下,测试度量是否尊重分类法的预定定单,CAP的性能超过了既定的基线.

articles.title: Investigating Linear Probe Robustness to Linguistic Register, Medical Specialty, and Corpus Shifts in Medical QA
articles.content: Linear classifiers trained on hidden states of a large language model (LLM), linear probes, can flag factual errors from a single forward pass. Geometrically, that implies that true and false statements separate along a stable direction in hidden state space, i.e., the truth direction. Prior work disagrees on whether this generalises across input shifts, but the disagreement is hard to interpret because cross-dataset probe transfer experiments confound several kinds of input change at once. We isolate three such variables in medical question-answering (QA): writing style (register), domain (medical specialty), and corpus (dataset). We build a benchmark using 500 MedQA entries, each rewritten into four styles (textbook, patient, clinical note, colloquial), annotated with clinical specialty, and grouped with two other exam corpora, MedMCQA and MMLU-medical, for cross-dataset evaluation. Probing four open-weight LLMs (2--8B), we find that the truth direction is largely robust to writing style (mean $Δ_\text{register} \approx 0.10$ AUROC on held-out facts) and to medical specialty ($Δ_\text{specialty} \approx 0.03$), but degrades unevenly across corpora: by $0.12$ AUROC on MMLU-medical and by $0.21$ on MedMCQA, roughly twice the register gap. The register result replicates with a second generator and carries over to human-written patient questions. The truth direction is therefore largely stable within the medical domain but breaks under some corpus shifts, and question format does not explain the break, which suggests that the signal a linear probe recovers is partly bound to dataset structure rather than to medical knowledge alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 调查线性勘探到语言登记、医学专业和医学质量评估中的体格变化
articles.content_zh: 在大型语言模型(LLM)的隐藏状态上受过训练的线性分类器,线性探测器,可以标出单个前传的事实错误. 从几何角度来说,这意味着真实和虚假的陈述沿着隐藏状态空间的稳定方向,即真相方向,分开. 先前的工作对于这种概括是否跨越输入移位存在分歧,但分歧很难解释,因为交叉数据集探测器传输实验同时混淆了几种输入变化. 在医疗问答(QA)中,我们分离出三个这样的变量:写作风格(注册),域(医学专业),和本体(数据集). 我们使用500个 MedQA 条目构建一个基准,每个条目重写成四种样式(教科书、病人、临床笔记、口碑),并附有临床特长的注释,并与另外两个考试公司(MedMCQA和MMLU-医疗)组合,进行跨数据集评价。 探究四个开放量级的LLM(2-8B),我们发现,真理方向大体上是稳健的:写作风格(平均$Δ_\text{register}\约0.10美元AUROC关于被搁置的事实)和医疗专业(QΔ_\text{specialty}\约0.03美元),但公司内部的降解不均:MMLU-医疗的AUROC为0.12美元,MedMCQA为0.21美元,大约是注册缺口的两倍。 登记结果用第二发电机复制,然后转到人写的病人问题。 因此,真实方向在医学领域基本稳定,但在某些实体转移中断裂,问题格式并不能解释断裂,这表明线性探测器恢复的信号部分与数据集结构有关,而不是仅与医学知识有关.

articles.title: Separating Syntax from Language: A Mechanistic Account of Translation in Multilingual LLMs
articles.content: Multilingual large language models (mLLMs) achieve strong performance in machine translation, yet our understanding of the mechanisms by which they transform representations from one language to another remains incomplete. Prior work suggests that translation decomposes into separable processes within an mLLM, where conceptual content is first represented independently, followed by a production into language-specific form. In this work, we show that translation is even more modular than previously assumed and that the output language production in translation processes is actually further separable into a syntax and a surface language process. We construct controlled multilingual datasets that isolate cross-linguistic differences in word-order and use causal interventions and probing to track how representations are transformed during translation. We find that models first construct target-side word-order before realizing the target language surface form. We identify individual attention heads that are selectively sensitive to syntactic transformations while remaining largely invariant to language identity. These results establish the commitment to a syntactic structure as an independent stage in translation, extending prior decompositions and showing how translation is implemented by functionally different components within mLLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从语言中分离语法:多种语言LLMs翻译的机械化账户
articles.content_zh: 多语言的大型语言模型(mLLMs)在机器翻译中取得了强效的性能,然而我们对它们将表达方式从一种语言转变为另一种语言的机制的理解仍然不完整. 以前的工作建议翻译在mLLM中分解成可分离的过程,其中概念内容首先独立表示,然后制作成语言特有的形式. 在这部作品中,我们显示翻译的模块化程度甚至比之前的假设还要高,翻译过程中的输出语言制作实际上进一步分离为语法和表层语言过程. 我们构建了控制下的多语种数据集,这些数据集隔离了词序的跨语言差异,并使用了因果干预和探究,以跟踪在翻译过程中表达方式的转变. 我们发现模型首先构建目标侧词序,然后才实现目标语言表面形态. 我们找出了个别的注意头,这些注意头有选择地对合成转变敏感,而对于语言特性却基本上不具有多样性。 这些结果确立了对作为翻译独立阶段的合成结构的承诺,扩展了先解分解,并显示了mLLMs中功能上不同的组件是如何执行翻译的.

articles.title: Where the Verifier Fails: A Category-Level Audit of Reward Signals in RLVR
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and standard benchmark evaluation both rely on an automatic verifier that turns a free text answer into a binary reward. Prior work reports that one evaluation harness accepts only about 94% of its own ground truth answers, blaming LaTeX parsing. That is an aggregate: it does not say which answer forms consume the error budget. We supply the decomposition. We apply metamorphic testing to the verifier rather than the model, generating certified equivalent answer variants, that is, rewrites that preserve mathematical meaning by construction, so that any rejection is a provable false negative needing no human adjudication. We then measure rejection per answer category across four widely used verifiers over 307,420 verdicts. We find three things. (1) Self validation ranges from 53.8% to 95.2% on identical inputs, a spread of 41.3 points. The published figure describes one implementation, not the task; two configurations of the same library disagree on 49.9% of pairs. (2) The residual is not spread across parsing categories but concentrated in whitespace and punctuation, which account for 93.0% of in contract failures for the default LaTeX configuration. A trailing period or newline dominates the budget. (3) Separating rejection from execution failure shows that verifiers with similar aggregate error fail for opposite reasons, and that a reference numeric cascade accepts off by one wrong answers as a step function of magnitude, from 0% below 10^4 to 100% at or above, because its relative tolerance is scale invariant.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 验证失败者:对RLVR中奖励信号的类别级审计
articles.content_zh: 以可核查的奖励(RLVR)和标准基准评价加强学习,两者都依赖于将自由文本答案转化为二进制奖励的自动验证器. 先前的工作报告,一个评估工具只接受大约94%的自身基本真相答案,指责LaTeX解析. 这是一个汇总:它没有说哪个答案表会消耗错误的预算。 我们提供分解。 我们把变形测试应用于验证者而不是模型,生成认证的等效答案变体,即重写通过构造来保持数学意义,这样任何拒绝都是一种可以证明的虚假否定,不需要人类的判断. 然后,我们在4个被广泛使用的核查人中衡量每个答复类别的拒绝,超过307 420项判决。 我们发现三件事。 (1)在相同的输入上,自我验证介于53.8%至95.2%之间,分布41.3分. 公布的数字描述了一个执行,而不是任务;同一库的两个配置对49.9%的对子有异议. (2)剩余部分不分布在解析类别之间,而集中在白空间和圆点,占默认的LaTeX配置合同失败的93.0%. 预算以后期或新线为主。 (3) 将拒绝与执行失败区分开来表明,具有类似总误差的核查者由于相反原因而失败,一个参考数字级联接受一个错误的答案,作为数量级函数,从10^4以下的0%到或以上时的100%,因为其相对可容忍度是无变化的。

articles.title: CHARM: Character Hallucination for Multicultural Role Play Benchmark
articles.content: Role-playing large language models (LLMs) are expected to adopt a character's style while also respecting that character's knowledge boundaries. Prior evaluations detect character hallucination but rarely distinguish whether errors arise from failure to recognize a boundary or from failure to comply despite recognition. We introduce CHARM, a multicultural benchmark of 40 real and fictional characters drawn from five cultural-linguistic regions, and validated by native reviewers. It probes two boundary types, Temporal (historical vs. modern) and Cross-Universe (entities outside a character's narrative or historical universe), using abstention-enabled multiple-choice questions. We propose a two-stage evaluation that separates Boundary-Awareness (explicit recognition that a query is out of scope) from Boundary-Compliance (abstention when answering concrete questions). Evaluations across six LLMs show that hallucination is driven predominantly by compliance failures. Models frequently acknowledge that a query lies outside the character's knowledge yet still provide factual, out-of-character answers. By re-posing the same questions to the target character, we confirm that a large fraction of these cases are verified parametric overrides; the model stores the relevant fact but fails to suppress it. We also observe systematic cultural variation in these failures, consistent with imbalances in how characters from different regions are represented in model knowledge.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CHARM:多种文化的人物幻觉 角色扮演基准
articles.content_zh: 角色扮演大语言模型(LLMs)预计将采用角色的风格,同时也尊重角色的知识界限. 以前的评价发现人物幻觉,但很少区分错误是因不承认边界而产生,还是因无视承认而未能遵守。 我们提出一个由来自五个文化语言地区的40个真实和虚构人物组成的多文化基准, 它探索两种边界类型,Temperal(历史对现代)和Cross-University(人物叙事或历史宇宙以外的实体),使用弃权的多选择问题. 我们提议分两个阶段进行评价,将边界意识(明确承认询问范围外)与遵守边界(回答具体问题时放弃)区分开来。 6个有限责任管理课程的评价显示,幻觉主要是由合规失败造成的。 模型经常承认,查询是在人物所知之外,但仍然提供事实性的、非特征的答案。 通过对目标字符重新提出同样的问题,我们确认这些病例的很大一部分是经过核实的参数覆盖;模型存储了相关事实,但未能压制它. 我们还观察到这些失败中系统性的文化差异,这与不同区域人物在模型知识中的代表性不平衡是一致的。

articles.title: Probing Factual Knowledge Transfer with Training Data Interventions
articles.content: Do multilingual language models transfer factual knowledge across languages during continued pretraining, or do they mostly recall facts learned directly from the target-language data? To answer this question more reliably, we propose an intervention-based framework: starting from an English-pretrained model, we continue pretraining on Persian data from which specific facts have been systematically removed at varying levels of granularity. We construct SIFT, a resource of 500 triples across 20 relations, stratified by the cultural origin of each fact's subject into general (globally prominent) and Persian-related entities, designed for both systematic fact removal from training data and evaluation, with natively written Persian cloze templates. Our results show that fact transfer is very limited: under the strictest removal condition, a large majority of English-acquired facts fail to transfer into Persian. We further show that sentence-level co-occurrence removal is insufficient to eliminate fact signal, and that easier (randomly selected) negative candidate sets substantially inflate apparent transfer by rewarding shallow associative heuristics, while performance on a harder candidate set that allows for less reliance on heuristics is much lower. Finally, we show that source-language entity frequency has a large influence, with Persian-related facts, which are orders of magnitude rarer in the English corpus, hardly transferring.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 利用培训数据干预,探索事实知识转让
articles.content_zh: 多语种语言模型在继续预训期间是否将事实知识传承到不同语言之间,或者它们大多是回顾直接从目标语言数据中学到的事实? 为了更可靠地回答这个问题,我们提出了一个基于干预的框架:从一个英语预先训练的模型开始,我们继续就波斯数据进行预先训练,在不同的颗粒度层次上,从中系统地消除了具体的事实。 我们构建了由500个三重元素组成的SIFT, 跨越20个关系, 我们的结果显示,事实转移非常有限:在最严格的清除条件下,绝大多数英国获得的事实未能转移到波斯. 我们进一步表明,消除判刑级的共犯不足以消除事实信号,而较容易(草率选择的)负面候选人通过奖励浅层的关联性休眠症而大幅提高明显转移率,而采用较硬的一套可以减少对休眠症依赖的候选人的成绩则要低得多。 最后,我们表明源语实体频率具有很大的影响,与波斯语有关的事实,在英语的体例中是数量级较罕见的,几乎没有转移.

articles.title: VerTox: Verifiable Reward-Guided Corpus Poisoning Against Neural Ranking Models
articles.content: Neural ranking models have become core components of modern information retrieval systems and important building blocks of AI systems such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. However, their robustness remains insufficiently understood in the presence of large language models (LLMs), which can generate fluent and deceptive content at scale. This work investigates the vulnerability of neural ranking models to corpus poisoning attacks, in which an adversary injects a small number of maliciously crafted documents into the corpus to distort ranking behavior. We propose VerTox, the first framework to formulate corpus poisoning as a verifiable reward-guided reinforcement learning (RLVR) problem. By explicitly coupling ranking distortion with factual corruption through specialized reward shaping, we fine-tune compact LLMs into adversarial generators.
