Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves near-perfect attack success rates, producing adversarial documents that frequently rank higher than target documents across major neural ranking architectures, as well as a proprietary commercial embedding model. The generated adversarial documents are fluent and exhibit low perplexity, making them difficult to detect. Furthermore, by explicitly encouraging factual corruption, our adversarial documents significantly degrade the performance of a downstream RAG application.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VerTox:可验证的奖赏-指导性毒害神经定级模型
articles.content_zh: 神经排位模型已成为现代信息检索系统的核心组成部分,以及检索-增强生成(RAG)管道等AI系统的重要构件. 然而,在大型语言模型(LLMs)存在的情况下,它们的强性仍然没有得到足够的理解,这些模型可以产生流利和欺骗性的规模内容. 这部作品调查了神经排位模型对命案中毒攻击的脆弱性,其中对手向命案注入少量恶意编造的文件,以扭曲排名行为. 我们提出VerTox,第一个将人体中毒作为可核查的奖励指导强化学习(RLVR)问题的框架. 通过通过专门奖励塑造来明确将排名扭曲与实际腐败结合起来,我们把紧凑的有限责任公司调整为对抗性发电机。 实验表明,我们的方法实现了近乎完美的攻击成功率,产生了对抗性文件,这些文件在主要神经排列结构中往往比目标文件高,以及一种专有的商业嵌入模型。 生成的对抗性文件流利且不复杂,难以发现。 此外,通过明确鼓励实际腐败,我们的对抗性文件大大降低了下游RAG申请的执行。

articles.title: Exploring Sparse Autoencoders in Text-Based Causal Confounding Adjustment
articles.content: In many settings, studying causal questions based on text data requires adjusting for confounding information within texts. Yet there is a tradeoff in constructing text representations for adjustment: they must be sufficiently large and/or dense to preserve the confounding variables necessary for unbiased effect estimation, but sufficiently small and/or sparse to satisfy finite-sample overlap and yield low-variance estimates. To address this tradeoff, we turn to sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and propose a novel causal adjustment pipeline that iteratively selects a minimal set of SAE features via conditional independence tests. We find that SAE representations achieve better adjustments (lower bias and and higher coverage) than alternative representations in standard semi-synthetic evaluations with binary confounders, and their interpretability offers opportunities for falsification. We also introduce a more realistic semi-synthetic evaluation that uses multi-label data as the unobserved confounders and find off-the-shelf adjustment methods require increased investigation for these more complex settings. Code: https://github.com/mianzg/sae-text-confounder
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 探索基于文本的 Causal 混淆调整中的 Sparse 自动编码器
articles.content_zh: 在许多场合,根据文本数据研究因果关系问题需要进行调整,以混淆文本中的信息. 然而,在构建供调整的文字表述方面有权衡余地:这些表述必须足够大和(或)密集,以保持对不偏倚效应估计所必要的混乱变量,但足够小和(或)稀少,以满足有限的抽样重叠并产生低变量估计。 为了解决这种权衡,我们转而使用稀疏的自动编码器(SAEs),并提议一个新的因果调整管道,通过有条件的独立测试,迭代选择一套最低限度的SAE特性. 我们发现,在标准半合成评价中,SAE的表述比有二进制混音符的替代表述实现更好的调整(更低的偏差和更高的覆盖面),其可解释性为伪造提供了机会. 我们还引入了更现实的半合成评价,使用多标签数据作为无法观察的混沌者,寻找现成的调整方法,需要对这些更为复杂的环境进行更多的调查. 代码:https://github.com/mianzg/sae-text-confonder 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-03-02.

articles.title: Reliability Challenges in Diffusion Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Diffusion-based Large Vision-Language Models (dLVLMs) have recently emerged as a compelling alternative to autoregressive (AR) LVLMs, offering advantages in parallel decoding, bidirectional context, and controllable generation. Despite rapid progress, their reliability properties remain largely uncharacterized. We present the first systematic reliability evaluation of hallucination and bias in dLVLMs, benchmarking six diffusion models against competitive AR baselines across four dimensions. Our key findings are: (1) dLVLMs reverse the yes-bias of AR models in binary visual queries; (2) they achieve competitive hallucination rates yet exhibit degraded linguistic quality; (3) they collapse to near-zero accuracy on underrepresented racial groups with opposite-polarity gender bias; and (4) they exhibit accuracy collapse in multiple-choice settings when the correct option is shorter than its distractors, associated with a length prior that emerges at the first denoising step. Tokens committed at late denoising steps with low confidence further correlate with hallucinated content, pointing to a mechanistic signal unique to diffusion generation. These patterns vary across model families, suggesting reliability is shaped by the generative paradigm together with training data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 传播视野-语言模型中的可靠性挑战
articles.content_zh: 以扩散为基础的大视野语言模型(dLVLMs)最近已成为自相递减(AR)LVLMs的令人信服的替代品,在平行解码、双向环境以及可控生成方面提供了优势。 尽管取得了迅速的进展,但它们的可靠性特性基本上仍未被定性。 我们提出了对dLVLMs的幻觉和偏差的第一次系统可靠性评估,将六个传播模型与具有竞争力的AR基线比对了四个层面。 我们的主要调查结果是:(1) dLVLMs在二进制视觉查询中倒转AR模型的"是"-比斯;(2)它们实现竞争性的幻觉率,但语言质量已退化;(3)它们在代表不足的种族群体上倒塌到接近零的准确度,具有相向极性性别偏差;和(4)在多选择环境中,当正确的选择比它的分心器短时,它们显示出精度倒塌,与第一个去诺步骤出现之前出现的长度有关. 在低信心的晚期解密步骤中承诺的托肯进一步与有幻觉的内容相联,指向扩散生成所特有的机械信号. 这些模式因模范家庭而异,表明可靠性与培训数据一起由基因模式所决定。

articles.title: MIDR: Enrichment-Augmented Indexing for Multimodal Document Retrieval
articles.content: Retrieval over visually rich documents has a representation problem: important content often lives in tables, charts, figures, and layout relations that plain OCR linearizes, corrupts, or omits. ColPali-family visual retrievers address this with patch-level multi-vector indexes and late-interaction scoring, keeping image-derived retrieval on the query-time serving path. We introduce MIDR (Multimodal Indexing for Document Retrieval), a training-free framework for enrichment-augmented indexing that shifts multimodal reasoning to index time. During ingestion, a multimodal LLM converts rendered pages into verified textual fields that are indexed with BM25F and optionally fused with dense retrieval, enabling text-centric serving over multimodally grounded evidence. On ViDoRe V3, MIDR Hybrid achieves 0.6219 average nDCG across five English domains, a 23.0% relative gain over BM25, remaining competitive with ColQwen2.5. On two French-document domains, enrichment bridges English queries and French page text, lifting BM25 from 0.1532 to 0.5448 nDCG and outperforming ColQwen2.5. Across all seven domains, MIDR leads ColQwen2.5 on four while using approximately 9x smaller index memory and approximately 2x lower query latency. These results establish index-time multimodal reasoning as a compelling accuracy-deployment alternative to serving-time visual late interaction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MIDR:多式联运文件检索强化索引
articles.content_zh: 对视觉丰富的文件进行检索存在代表性问题:重要内容往往生活在表格、图表、数字和布局关系之中,这些关系可以使OCR线性化、腐败或省略。 ColPali-family可视取回器用补丁级多向量索引和后互动分数处理,将取自图像取回器保存在查询时间服务路径上. 我们引入了MIDR(文件检索的多式索引),这是浓缩强化索引的无培训框架,将多式推理转换为索引时间。 在摄取过程中,一种多式LLM将页面转换成经核实的文本字段,这些字段以BM25F为索引,可选地与密集的检索相接,从而能够以文本为中心,在基于多式的证据之上服务。 在ViDoRe V3上,MIDR Hybrid在5个英语领域实现平均0.6219nDCG,比BM25相对增益23.0%,与ColQuen2.5保持竞争力. 在两个法文件域上,浓缩连接了英语查询和法语页面文本,将BM25从0.1532升至0.5448 nDCG并优于ColQwen2.5. 在所有7个域中,MIDR带领ColQuen2.5在4个域上,同时使用大约9x更小的索引内存和大约2x更低的查询间隔. 这些结果确立了指数-时间多模式推理,作为取代服务时间视觉晚期互动的令人信服的准确性部署。

articles.title: Explore Before Committing: Hypothesis-Guided Search for Deep Research Agents
articles.content: Deep-research agents answer complex questions by interacting with search and browsing tools, yet they often search along a single evolving trajectory. Our trajectory-level analysis reveals a common failure mode in which the agent may encounter an early search state with several plausible directions, but follow one direction before collecting enough comparative evidence. Once this happens, subsequent tool calls tend to reinforce the same path, increasing the chance of failure when the initial direction is misleading. We further find that successful trajectories reduce this risk through two behaviors: grounding vague exploration in concrete candidates and shifting directions when the current path is weak or incomplete. Based on these findings, we propose HypoSearch, which generates lightweight hypotheses as soft search hints, explores them through bounded independent branches, and compares branch-level evidence before commitment. Across four deep-research benchmarks and three backbone models, HypoSearch consistently outperforms single-trajectory search and standard parallel baselines, improving Qwen3.5-122B from 46.7 to 60.0 on BC-small while using fewer tool calls than five independent trajectories. A pilot supervised fine-tuning study further shows that these behavioral signals can curate compact training trajectories and reduce degradation from unfiltered data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 提交前探索:假想- 指导性搜索深层研究代理
articles.content_zh: 深度研究代理通过与搜索和浏览工具互动来解答复杂的问题,然而他们却经常沿着单一的不断发展的轨道进行搜索. 我们的轨迹水平分析揭示了一个常见的故障模式,即代理商可能遇到具有几个可能方向的早期搜索状态,但在收集足够的比较证据之前遵循一个方向. 一旦发生这种情况,之后的工具调用往往会强化同样的路径,当初始方向误导时会增加失败的机会. 我们进一步发现,成功的轨迹通过两种行为来减少这种风险:在具体候选者中进行模糊的探索,在目前道路薄弱或不完整时改变方向。 基于这些发现,我们提出"伪搜索"(HypoSearch),它产生轻量级假说作为软搜索提示,通过有界限的独立分支对其进行探索,并在承诺前比较分支层面的证据. 在四个深层研究基准和三个主干模型中,HypoSearch始终超越单轨搜索和标准平行基线,将Qwen3.5-122B在BC-Small上从46.7提高到60.0,同时使用的工具调用少于五个独立的轨迹。 一项由飞行员监督的微调研究进一步表明,这些行为信号可以控制紧凑的训练轨迹,并减少未过滤数据的降解.

articles.title: Some Emotions Run Deeper: Layer-wise Probing and Causal Intervention in Large Language Models
articles.content: Emotion is expressed in text along a wide spectrum, from surface lexical cues to inferences entangled with content. Most layer-wise analyses of emotion in LLMs use a single corpus, leaving open whether the depth at which emotion becomes accessible is a property of the model or also of the text source. We investigate this across three datasets spanning different degrees of explicitness and contextualization in emotion expression (Twitter posts, Reddit comments, and autobiographical narratives) and eight 1B--9B open-weight LLMs from the Llama, Qwen, and Granite families. We combine layer-wise probing with offline feature scaling and online forward interventions, transfer analyses, and an early-exit classifier. We find that (i) the best probing layer shifts systematically across corpora, from input-adjacent layers to over half model depth, and this ordering persists after matching label-by-length-bin distributions; (ii) across the evaluated settings, forward-pass interventions on probe-selected bands reduce test accuracy by 5--6 points more than same-width random bands ($q < 0.01$); (iii) selected bands transfer across datasets and emotion categories, suggesting partially shared affective information rather than strictly per-emotion substrates; and (iv) probe-selected early-exit representations outperform full-depth exits by $6.9$ percentage points on average.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一些情感运行更深层:大语言模型中的图层测试和因果干预
articles.content_zh: 从表面词汇提示到与内容纠缠在一起的推论,情感都以文字形式广泛表达. 对LLMs中的情感进行大多数分层分析时都使用单一的本体,对于情感的可访问深度是模型的属性还是文本来源的属性,都留下了空洞. 我们通过三个数据集(Twitter文章、Reddit评论和自传性叙事), 我们把分层探测与离线功能缩放和在线前期干预、转移分析和提前退出分类相结合。 我们发现:(一) 从输入相邻的层层到超过半模型深度的层层之间有系统的最佳检测层层移转,这种测序在匹配标签/长度-周期分布后持续存在;(二) 在经过评价的环境下,对探测器选定波段的前传干预使测试精度比同轴随机波段减少5-6点(q < 0.01美元);(三) 选定波段跨数据集和情感类别移转,建议部分共享影响性信息,而不是严格按每个波段进行;以及(四) 探测器选定早期出场说明平均比完全深度输出6.9个百分点。

articles.title: From Base Rollouts to RL Reasoning: A Budgeted Search Perspective
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but how these gains relate to inference-time decoding and search remains unclear. Does RL create reasoning the base model lacks, or shift the rollout distribution toward trajectories it can already reach but rarely samples? We study this behaviorally with a Unified Decoding Framework (UDF), which expresses token-level sampling, beam-like search, tree search, and sequence-level resampling as executable policies over a shared budgeted operating space, scored post hoc with pass@$k$, self-consistency, best-of-$N$, and first-finish success. Using paired Base/RL checkpoints from SimpleRL-Zoo, we ask whether an RL default-policy curve can be approximated by a structured path of Base operating points. On Math500, AIME, GPQA, and IFEval, the pass@$k$ recovery path follows a Budgeted Operating-Point Transition Rule (BOPTR), $N_{\mathrm{Base}} \approx αN_{\mathrm{RL}}^β$, with benchmark-conditioned exponents. On Qwen2.5-7B, BOPTR gives the lowest transfer error among the non-oracle rules we test, 3.41 pp (95% CI [2.32, 5.53]); a three-seed replication gives 3.07 $\pm$ 0.39 pp. The rule extends to ten models across four families (3.28 to 4.87 pp on checkpoints added after fitting), to four benchmarks it was never fitted on (5.03 pp vs. 4.44 pp in fit), and holds without an RL checkpoint for the target model (4.19 pp) or without RL supervision of any kind (5.08 pp). These results support a qualified internalized-search reading: under the recipe we test, much of the measured RL gain corresponds to a change in sampling efficiency toward operating points the base model can already reach under search. We treat the scaling patterns as descriptive of this recipe and cohort, report where they break down, and use UDF and BOPTR as behavioral diagnostics rather than evidence of parameter-level equivalence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从基地推出到RL 原因:一个预算搜索视角
articles.content_zh: 具有可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR)改进了语言模型推理,但这些收益与推论时间解码和搜索的关系仍然不明朗. RL是创建了基础模型缺乏的推理,还是将推出的分布转向它已经到达但很少采样的轨迹? 我们用一个统一的解码框架来研究这个行为,这个框架表示象征性的级别取样、类似光束的搜索、树搜索和序列级的再模拟,作为可执行的政策,在共享预算的操作空间上,用通行证@$k$、自我一致性、最佳的美元N$和第一成功来评分。 使用来自SimpleRL-Zoo的对垒/RL检查站,我们询问一个RL默认政策曲线是否可以通过一个结构化的Base操作点路径来近似. 在 Math500, AIME, GPQA, 和 IFEval 上, pass@ $k$ 恢复路径遵循了已编入预算的操作点过渡规则(BOPTR), $N_{\mathrm{Base}}\\ 大约 αN_{\mathrm{ RL}}^β$, 并附有基准条件的导师. 在Quen2.5-7B上,BOPTR给出了我们测试的非甲骨文规则中最小的转录错误,3.41pp(95% CI [2.32,5.53]);一个三种子复制得到3.07美元\pm0.39pp. 该规则适用于四个家庭的10种型号(安装后添加的检查站为3.28至4.87页),还有4种基准(5.03页对4.44页),没有目标型号的RL检查站(4.19页)或任何类型的RL监督(5.08页)。 这些结果支持一种合格的内化-搜索读法:在我们测试的食谱下,所测量的RL增益中,大部分都对应了取样效率的变化,转向了在搜索中基本模型已经能够到达的操作点. 我们把缩放模式 当作这个食谱和组的描述, 报告它们分解的地方, 用UDF和BOPTR作为行为诊断, 而不是参数级等效的证据。

articles.title: What Does an Agentic Software Engineering Benchmark Measure? Profiling Task Demands and Agent Behaviour Beyond What Category Labels Reveal
articles.content: Agentic software engineering benchmarks are typically summarized by nominal category labels such as "bug fix" or "feature implementation," yet benchmarks carrying the same label are built through very different curation pipelines. A label thus reveals little about the engineering work a benchmark demands. We introduce the Spread--Novelty--Centrality (SNC) profile, a three-axis characterization of the demands of repository-level coding tasks, grounded in empirical software engineering research. We apply the profile to five widely used benchmarks and 14,922 trajectories of two model families at three scales, and report three findings. (1) A label is an unreliable proxy for task demands, as every pair of benchmarks is statistically separated on at least two SNC axes, and the separations trace back to specific curation decisions. (2) Agent behaviour reveals demands that the human-written gold solution cannot. Agents produce larger solutions than the gold where problem statements withhold hints and smaller ones where curation inflates the gold. How a task is phrased shapes what an agent produces. (3) Task demands correlate with success uniformly, with resolved runs concentrating in the low-SNC region for every family and scale, whereas the behavioural signatures of success are family-specific. Claude succeeds by matching the scope of the gold solution, and its parity share on files rises from $0.17$ at the smallest scale to $0.54$ at the largest. Qwen succeeds by exceeding the gold scope at every scale, and editing too little marks failure for both families.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理软件工程基准衡量标准是什么? 描述任务要求和代理行为超越什么分类标签
articles.content_zh: 代理软件工程基准一般以"bug fix"或"featural experiment"等名义类别标签来概括,然而带有相同标签的基准是通过非常不同的校准管道构建的. 因此,一个标签很少显示工程工作是基准要求。 我们介绍了Space-Novelty-Centrality(SNC)简介,这是基于实证软件工程研究的三轴特性描述寄存器级编码任务的需求. 我们把简介应用于五个广泛使用的基准和两个模范家庭在三个尺度上的14 922个轨迹,并报告三个调查结果。 (1)标签是任务要求的不可靠的代名词,因为每对基准在统计学上在至少两个SNC轴上是分开的,这些分开可以追溯到具体的校准决定. (2)代理行为揭示出人类书面金溶液不能实现的要求. 代理制造比黄金更大的解决方案 问题陈述拒绝暗示 较小的解决方案 管理夸大黄金。 定义任务如何塑造代理产品。 (3) 任务要求与成功一致相关,决心集中力量在SNC低层地区,针对每个家庭和规模,而成功的行为标志则是针对家庭的。 克劳德通过匹配黄金解决方案的范围而成功,其在文件中的平价份额从最小比例的0.17美元上升到最大比例的0.54美元. Quen通过在每个尺度上超越金色范围而成功,编辑对于两个家庭来说都太少的标记失败.

articles.title: Ready to Speak: Aligning LLMs for TTS-Friendly Text Generation
articles.content: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) are primarily optimized for written text, often producing outputs that are grammatically correct and helpful yet poorly suited for spoken delivery via Text-to-Speech (TTS). In this work, we study how to make LLMs natively generate TTS-friendly text, which we frame as a preference alignment problem: instead of relying on downstream rewriting modules, we directly align LLMs to generate text optimized for spoken delivery. We introduce two preference datasets spanning different target domains, CORA and Recipe, which contain paired TTS-friendly and TTS-unfriendly responses. We further propose an evaluation suite combining a pattern-based heuristic metric, a TTS$\to$ASR evaluation pipeline, and a MUSHRA listening study with human judges. Our experiments compare the recently proposed Feature-aware Sampling and Tuning (FaST) framework -- leveraging interpretable features instead of a black-box reward model -- against an array of alignment baselines on the TTS-friendly generation task. Notably, we found that FaST achieves the best overall tradeoff between TTS-friendliness and helpfulness across various settings. We also identified a strong correlation between our different metrics, highlighting the ability to reliably assess TTS-friendliness via an efficient heuristic.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 准备发言: 为 TTS 友好文本生成对齐 LLMS
articles.content_zh: 目前的大语言模型(LLMs)主要被优化用于书面文本,往往产生语法正确和有用但不太适合通过Text to-Speech(TTS)口语发送的产出. 在这项工作中,我们研究如何使LLMS本土生成方便TTS的文本,我们把它作为偏好调整问题的框架:我们不依靠下游重写模块,而是直接对LLMs来生成最优化的文本用于口语发送. 我们引入了两个跨越不同目标域的首选数据集,即CORA和Recipe,它们包含对齐的TTS和TTS不友好的反应. 我们进一步提议一个评价套件,将基于模式的热度计量、TTS$=to$ASR评价管道和MUSHRA与人类法官的倾听研究结合起来。 我们的实验比较了最近提出的地物意识取样和图宁(FaST)框架 -- -- 利用可解释的特性而不是黑盒奖励模型 -- -- 与TTS友好生成任务的一系列一致基线。 值得注意的是,我们发现FaST在各种环境的TTS友好和帮助之间实现了最佳的总体权衡。 我们还确定了我们不同衡量标准之间的密切关联,突出了通过高效的热力学可靠评估TTS方便度的能力。

articles.title: Post-Training Science for Supervised Fine-Tuning
articles.content: Every supervised fine-tuning run forces the same chain of decisions, such as learning rate, batch size, LoRA or full fine-tuning, how many epochs, which optimiser, and what data to feed the model. Each of these is typically rediscovered from scratch for every new model and dataset. Here we measure them under one instrument: a sweep that varies one lever at a time, and spans dense and mixture-of-experts models in two families (Qwen3 and Llama), on four real-world customer SFT datasets, for both LoRA and full fine-tuning. These datasets give a controlled testbed: each task carries an evaluation built with the customer, and its training data is produced by iterative supervised fine-tuning that refines model outputs until they pass that evaluation, so the supervised target is internally consistent and the task judge we report against is the criterion the data was built to satisfy. We ask how the optimal learning rate and batch size move with model scale, family, and data, and whether one selection rule transfers across them; what LoRA trades against full fine-tuning, and how its rank and alpha set what the adapter can learn; whether validation loss (or other metrics, such as loss landscape flatness) faithfully ranks downstream quality; whether post-training gains scale with model size and data volume, on a model ladder extended through mixtures-of-experts to 235B parameters; how many epochs to train before general instruction-following erodes; and whether a geometry-aware optimiser improves on AdamW. Each recommendation is paired with a measure of its uncertainty.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 监督精细化培训后科学
articles.content_zh: 每一个有监督的微调都强制进行相同的决策链,如学习率,批量大小,LORA或全微调,多少个时代,哪个选择,以及哪些数据可以为模型提供素材. 每个模型和数据集通常都会从零开始重新发现。 在这里,我们用一个仪器来测量它们:一个扫描器,一次改变一个杠杆,在两个家庭(Qune3和Llama)的4个真实世界的客户SFT数据集上跨过密集和混合的专家模型,用于LORA和完全微调。 这些数据集给出了一个可控测试台:每个任务都带有与客户共同构建的评价,其培训数据是通过迭代的有监督的微调生成的,这些微调将模型输出精炼到通过评价为止,因此受监督的目标在内部是一致的,我们报告的任务判断器就是数据所构建的满足的标准. 我们询问,最佳学习率和批量规模如何随模型尺度、家族和数据而变化,是否有一条选择规则在它们之间转移;LORA与完全微调进行什么交易,其等级和α如何设定适配器能够学到什么;验证损失(或损失地貌平坦等其他衡量标准)是否忠实地将质量排在下游;培训后在模型规模和数据量上,是否通过专家的混合参数扩展至235B的模型梯度而提高;在一般教学之后的侵蚀之前,有多少培训时间;以及几何-认识选择器是否改善了AdamW。 每项建议都有其不确定性的衡量标准。

articles.title: Towards AI-Assisted Clinical Trial Matching: Practical Considerations, Multicenter Evaluation, and Real-World Deployment
articles.content: Clinical trials are essential for advancing cancer care and drug development, but many fail because of insufficient patient enrollment. While there is growing interest in using AI to support patient recruitment, existing systems largely perform eligibility assessment alone and have rarely been evaluated in real-world oncology workflows. Here we present TrialGPT 2.0, an AI-assisted clinical trial recommendation system designed for real-world deployment. Rather than asking only whether a patient may qualify, the system also assesses which trials warrant further consideration given the patient's current clinical needs and local workflow priorities, and provides structured, inspectable explanations for expert review. Importantly, we evaluated TrialGPT 2.0 retrospectively and prospectively across multiple oncology-focused settings, spanning government, academic cancer-center, patient-advocacy, and NIH referral workflows. In retrospective multicenter cohorts comprising 288 cases, TrialGPT 2.0 retrieved at least one clinician-recommended trial in its top 10 recommendations for approximately 91% of cases while reducing clinician screening time by 55.0%. In a six-month prospective evaluation embedded in an active precision oncology tumor board, TrialGPT 2.0 contributed additional trial opportunities missed by the routine workflow, expanding patient access to clinical trial participation by 90.9%. To support scientific reproducibility, we also introduce NIH-TrialBench, a clinician-authored dataset comprising 126 diverse synthetic patient vignettes and matching scenarios from 11 NIH Institutes and Centers. Together, these results support the value of AI to assist clinical trial matching by improving clinician efficiency and identifying frequently overlooked trial opportunities, ultimately helping to expand and accelerate accrual to cancer trials.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 实现AI-辅助临床试验匹配:实际考虑、多中心评价和现实世界部署
articles.content_zh: 临床试验对于促进癌症护理和药物开发至关重要,但许多试验因病人入学率不足而失败。 虽然人们越来越有兴趣利用AI支持患者的招聘,但现有系统基本上只进行资格评估,很少在现实世界肿瘤学工作流程中进行评价。 我们在此介绍TrialGPT 2.0,一个AI辅助临床试验推荐系统,为现实世界的部署而设计. 该系统不只询问病人是否有资格,还评估了鉴于病人目前的临床需要和当地工作流程的优先次序,哪些试验值得进一步审议,并为专家审查提供了有条理、可检查的解释。 重要的是,我们回顾并展望了多处以肿瘤学为重点的环境,包括政府、学术癌症中心、病人宣传以及NIH转诊工作流程。 在包含288个案例的多中心复诊组中,TrialGPT 2.0在其前10项建议中至少取回了一名临床医生建议的审判,涉及约91%的案例,同时将临床医生的检查时间减少了55.0%。 在活跃的精密肿瘤委员会内嵌的为期六个月的预期评估中,TrialGPT 2.0为常规工作流程错过的更多试验机会做出了贡献,将患者获得临床试验参与率扩大了90.9%。 为了支持科学再生产,我们还引入了NIH-Terrict Bench,这是临床医生撰写的数据集,由126个不同的合成病人卷发和来自11个NIH研究所和中心的匹配情景组成。 这些结果共同支持AI通过提高临床医生的效率以及确定经常被忽视的试验机会来帮助临床试验匹配的价值,最终有助于扩大和加速癌症试验的累积。

articles.title: FinLifeBench: Exhaustive Life-Event History and Financial-State Reconstruction from Longitudinal Banking Dialogue
articles.content: Repeated banking interactions require assistants to maintain complete, current, and traceable customer records as life changes emerge incidentally in routine requests. Existing benchmarks emphasize question answering, bounded episodes, or targeted recall rather than exhaustive longitudinal reconstruction. We introduce FinLifeBench, which evaluates two tasks over the same cumulative dialogue: reconstructing every life-event instance with its first-establishing session and reconstructing a complete 34-path financial state at consecutive checkpoints. The benchmark contains 6,000 eight-turn Korean banking sessions from 20 independent synthetic trajectories, with deterministic, exhaustive gold for 24 event types and 34 state paths and consensus quality assurance. Across eleven LLMs under a full-context condition, event-anchor recall falls from 0.591 at 15 sessions to 0.445 at 300. Errors are driven primarily by omitted events rather than poor anchor localization, while financial-state reconstruction frequently treats superseded or potentially outdated information as current; the best GCA@15 reaches 0.470. Performance on the two reconstruction tasks is only weakly associated. These results show that models can localize evidence for recovered events while still failing to maintain complete and temporally valid longitudinal records.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FinLife Bench:从纵向银行对话开始的充满活力的终身历史和金融-国家重建
articles.content_zh: 重复的银行业务互动需要助理人员在例行请求中偶然出现生命变化时保持完整、最新和可追踪的客户记录。 现有基准强调回答问题、有限度的事件或有针对性的召回,而不是详尽无遗的纵向重建。 我们介绍了FinLife Bench,它通过同样的累积对话评估两项任务:重建每一个生活事件,并举行首次会议,以及在连续的检查站重建一个完整的34条道路的金融国家。 该基准包含来自20个独立合成轨迹的6 000个八轮韩国银行会议,其中24种活动类型有确定性、详尽无遗的黄金,以及34条国道和共识质量保证。 在完整文字条件下,11个法学硕士课程的复课从15届的0.591降至300届的0.445。 产生错误的主要原因是省略了事件,而不是定位不当,而金融国家重建往往将被取代或可能过时的信息视为最新信息;最好的GCA@15达到0.470。 两项重建任务的执行情况只是联系不力。 这些结果表明,模型可以确定已恢复事件的证据所在地,同时仍然无法保持完整和时间上有效的纵向记录。

articles.title: CaRL-EM: Cost-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Entity Matching with LLMs
articles.content: Entity matching (EM) requires fine-grained contextual understanding and domain knowledge. Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can serve as strong matchers across domains, but most methods either make independent pairwise decisions or rely on manually designed composite pipelines, thus lacking flexibility in realistic multi-candidate settings. At the same time, they typically ignore inference cost at scale. We formulate LLM-based EM with candidates as a cost-aware sequential decision problem and propose CaRL-EM, a reinforcement learning controller that manages LLM operations. Given the state of an anchor record, its candidate set, and the cost, CaRL-EM adaptively chooses among different operators (Match/Compare/Select/Decide) and model capacities to maximize a quality-cost objective. The policy interacts with abstract operators, allowing the same controller to be reused with different underlying LLM backends at inference time without retraining. Experiments on 7 benchmarks show that CaRL-EM (i) learns to dynamically plan the usage of inexpensive and expensive operators based on task complexity, (ii) achieves robust zero-shot transfer across diverse datasets and domains, and (iii) consistently achieves a better quality-cost trade-off than strong LLM-based baselines and manually designed pipelines, yielding a lower inference cost at comparable or higher quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CARL-EM: 实体与LLMs相匹配的成本效益强化学习
articles.content_zh: 实体匹配(EM)需要精细的上下文理解和域知识. 最近的工作表明,大型语言模型(LLMS)可以充当跨域的强匹配者,但大多数方法要么独立对偶决定,要么依靠人工设计的复合管道,因此在现实的多扫描设置中缺乏灵活性. 同时,它们通常忽视规模推论成本。 我们制定基于LLM的EM,将候选人作为成本意识连续决策的问题,并提议CaRL-EM,一个管理LLM操作的强化学习控制器. 鉴于主机记录的状况、候选人的设定和成本,CARL-EM在不同的运营商(Match/Compare/Select/Decide)和模型能力中进行适应性选择,以最大限度地实现质量成本目标。 该政策与抽象操作员互动,允许同一控制器在推论时与不同的基础LLM后端重复使用,无需再培训. 对7项基准的实验表明,CaRL-EM (一) 学会根据任务复杂程度动态规划廉价和昂贵运营商的使用情况,(二) 实现不同数据集和领域的强力零射线传输,(三) 与基于LLM的强力基线和人工设计的管道相比,始终实现更好的质量成本权衡,以可比或更高的质量产生较低的推论成本。

articles.title: PersuaRL: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Multi-Expert Selection for Persuasive Dialogue Generation in Insurance
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) are revolutionizing digital communication by powering conversational agents deployed across domains such as customer service, digital sales, and insurance. These agents, built on LLMs, can understand user input, retrieve relevant information, and generate coherent responses. However, while they excel at factual communication, they often lack the ability to engage in truly persuasive, context-sensitive dialogue, especially in domains like insurance, where trust and clarity are critical. Building on this need within the insurance domain, our work focuses on improving the persuasiveness of digital agents, aka LLMs. To support this, we introduce InsureDial, a Persuasive Insurance Dialogue dataset, designed to capture the nuances of persuasive communication specific to motor insurance interactions. We introduce PersuaRL, a reinforcement learning-based framework that equips LLM-driven dialogue agents with the ability to adaptively explore, select, and coordinate strategies across multiple expert modules, guided by the evolving dialogue context, to achieve more effective persuasion. We conduct extensive automatic human and qualitative evaluations on two benchmark persuasion dialogue datasets, including our InsureDial. Our evaluations consistently demonstrate that PersuaRL outperforms baseline, generating contextually appropriate and highly persuasive responses.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PersuaRL:加强学习 -- -- 为保险方面的劝导对话选择多专家
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型公司正在通过为部署在客户服务、数字销售和保险等领域的对话代理提供动力,使数字通信发生革命性的变化。 这些基于LLMs的代理能够理解用户输入,检索相关信息,产生一致的响应. 然而,虽然它们在事实沟通方面表现优异,但他们往往没有能力进行真正有说服力的、对背景敏感的对话,特别是在保险等领域,信任和清晰度至关重要。 基于保险领域的这一需要,我们的工作重点是提高数字代理商的说服力。 为了支持这一点,我们引入了InsureDial, 一种具有说服力的保险对话数据集,旨在捕捉机动保险相互作用特有的说服力沟通的细微差别. 我们介绍了PersuaRL,这是一个强化的学习框架,使LLM驱动的对话代理人有能力在不断演变的对话背景下,在多个专家单元中适应性地探索、选择和协调战略,以便实现更有效的说服。 我们对两个基准说服对话数据集,包括我们的InsureDial,进行广泛的自动人力和质量评价。 我们的评估始终表明,PersuaRL的绩效超过了基线,产生了符合具体情况和高度说服力的对策。

articles.title: LLMPEDIA: Browsing, Verifying, and Comparing the Parametric Encyclopedic Knowledge of LLMs
articles.content: Flagship language models appear saturated on benchmarks like MMLU (Hendrycks et al., 2021), scoring above 90% - yet benchmarks test only what the experimenter thought to ask, the availability bias of fixed question sets. LLMPEDIA makes this bias measurable and browsable. We recursively materialized ~1.3M articles from three model families' parametric memory (GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3.3-70B) without retrieval, then audited a stratified sample of atomic claims against Wikipedia and a curated web stack, coloring every claim supported, refuted, or insufficient (Saeed and Razniewski, 2026). On a uniform random sample the true rate is 68.4% - more than 21 pp below MMLU - with 30.5% of claims insufficient: assertions no benchmark probes and the world's largest encyclopedia cannot adjudicate - long-tail knowledge or plausible hallucination, the evidence cannot tell - extending to free text the coverage gap GPTKB established for triples (Hu et al., 2025). The resulting live, open encyclopedia lets visitors inspect this frontier one claim at a time through five one-click views - link-traversal exploration, claim-level factuality, cross-model and political-persona comparison, and a guided topic drill-down - each page, claim, and verdict at a stable URL. LLMPEDIA is live at https://llmpedia.net
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLMPEDIA:浏览、验证和比较LLMS的参数百科知识
articles.content_zh: 旗舰语言模型似乎在MMLU(Hendrycks等人,2021年)等基准上饱和,评分高于90%,但基准只测试实验者想问的,固定问题集的可用性偏差. LLMPEDIA使得这种偏向可以衡量和浏览. 我们从三个模范家庭的参数记忆(GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3.3-70B)中递归到1 3M的文章,没有检索,然后审计了针对维基百科的分级原子权利主张样本和经整理的网页堆,将支持、反驳或不充分的每一项权利主张涂色(Saeed和Razniewski,2026)。 在统一的随机抽样中,真实率为68.4%----低于MMLU的21页----有30.5%的说法不充分:断言没有基准探测器,世界上最大的百科全书无法裁定----长尾知识或假象,证据无法说明----将为三胞胎设定的覆盖面差距(Hu等人,2025年)。 由此而来的现场开放百科全书让访问者通过五个一击的视角,即链接-逆流探索、权利要求层面的事实性、跨模型和政治-人物比较、以及指导性专题钻探-每个页面、权利要求和在稳定的URL上的判决,一次检查这一前沿。 LLMPEDIA在https://llmpedia.net现场直播.

articles.title: Subword Segmental BabyLMs: Learning to Tokenise for Sample-Efficient Pretraining
articles.content: In the standard LM training pipeline, subword tokenisation is applied as a preprocessing step. Subword segmental language modelling is an alternative paradigm in which tokenisation is learned during training, allowing the model to discover subword units that optimise its training objective. In this paper, we present our submission to the 2026 BabyLM Challenge, for which we develop two new subword segmental LMs: SubSegGPT and SubSegDeBERTa. SubSegGPT is a decoder-only model that learns tokenisation during autoregressive pretraining. SubSegDeBERTa is an encoder-based model that jointly learns to generate and tokenise masked words. We train both for the Strict and Strict-small tracks. Our top submission to Strict is SubSegDeBERTa, which achieves notable gains in zero-shot evaluation. Our top submission to Strict-small is SubSegGPT, which outperforms tokenisation-based baselines. Our results show that learnable subword tokenisation can improve sample-efficiency for BabyLM pretraining. We analyse the subword learning dynamics of our models and find that tokenisation gradually converges on subword units that balance morphological alignment and fine-grained segmentation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 子词段 婴儿LMs:学习样板学前培训
articles.content_zh: 在标准的LM训练管道中,子词符号化作为预处理步骤应用. 子字段语言建模是一种在训练中学习象征性化的替代范式,使模型能够发现优化其训练目标的子字单元. 在本文中,我们向2026年婴儿LM挑战提交我们的文件,我们为此开发了两个新的分词LM:SubSegGPT和SubSegDeBERTa。 subSegGPT是一种只在自旋前训练中学习符号化的解码器模型. SubSeg DeBERTa是一个基于编码器的模型,它共同学习生成和象征蒙面词. 我们为严格轨道和小轨道训练 我们向"严格"的首屈一指的是SubSeg DeBERTa,它在零镜头评价上取得了显著的收获. 我们向严格小公司提交的最高级报告是SubSegGPT,它的表现超过了基于象征性的基线。 我们的结果显示,可学习的子词符号化可以提高婴儿LM预训的样本效率. 我们分析我们模型的子词学习动力学,发现符号化在子词单位上逐渐趋同,这些子词单位平衡了形态的对齐和精细的分化.

articles.title: On the Design Fundamentals of Pixel Text Representation Learning
articles.content: Text-rich visual inputs require models that can read, retrieve, and compress language directly in pixel space, yet existing pixel-text encoders struggle with fixed resolution pretraining, visual shortcut learning, weak visual grounding, and multilingual visual text understanding. In this work, we investigate the fundamental design principles required for robust visual text representation learning. Through systematic controlled ablations, we identify four critical components: variable image resolutions and rendered font sizes provide spatial proxies for high-resolution document generalization; natural image-text pairs are indispensable for grounding and prevent text-only collapse; layout-aware rendering helps prevent pixel-level shortcuts; and a two-stage multilingual curriculum enables effective cross-lingual alignment. By integrating these principles into a scalable training recipe, we train Pixel Linguist II, a native-resolution vision encoder trained with on-the-fly rendering, unified contrastive grounding, and a multilingual curriculum over 280M training examples. Pixel Linguist II sets new state-of-the-art results on English, cross-lingual, and multilingual Visual STS and ViDoRe, while also enabling better MLLM downstream evaluation. Notably, Pixel Linguist II remains robust under 80\% visual token compression, showing great promise for optical context compression. Our code and resources are available at https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 关于像素文字表现学习的设计基础
articles.content_zh: 文本丰富的视觉输入需要能够直接以像素空间读取,取回,并压缩语言的模型,而现有的像素文本编码器则与固定的分辨率预训,视觉快捷学习,视觉地面薄弱,以及多语言的视觉文本理解相抗衡. 在这项工作中,我们调查了有力视觉文字表现学习所需的基本设计原则. 通过系统化可控活化,我们确定了四个关键组成部分:可变图像分辨率和使字体大小为高分辨率文档通俗化提供空间代名词;天然图像文本对地平地和防止文本只倒塌不可或缺;布局感知渲染有助于防止像素级快捷键;两阶段多语种课程可以实现有效的跨语言对接. 通过将这些原则纳入可扩展的训练食谱,我们培训了Pixel Linguist II,一个本土分辨率的视觉编码器,经过飞行渲染,统一对比地基的训练,以及一个超过280M训练实例的多语种课程. Pixel Linguist II为英语,跨语言,多语种Visual STS和ViDoRe设定了新的最先进的成绩,同时也使得MLLM更能下游评价. 值得注意的是,Pixel Linguist II在80-Q视觉符号压缩下仍然很强壮,显示出光学上下文压缩的巨大希望. 我们的代码和资源可查阅https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II.

articles.title: Does task decomposition improve automatic NLG evaluation?
articles.content: The LLM-as-a-judge (LLMaJ) framework has emerged as a promising solution for cheap, reproducible, reference-free Natural Language Generation (NLG) evaluation. Prior work seeks to improve LLMaJ by decomposing evaluation tasks into simpler sub-tasks. In this work, we systematically compare LLMaJ methods with and without decomposition on multiple NLG datasets. We find no evidence that LLMaJ with task decomposition leads to performance gains over a fair baseline that does not use decomposition. Instead, we find that previously reported performance gains in decomposition-based LLMaJ stem from using human labels as training data, and not task decomposition itself. Also, we find that, when human labels are available, LLMaJ without using task decomposition can perform comparably to human annotators.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 任务分解是否改善自动NLG评价?
articles.content_zh: LLM-as-a-judge(LLMaJ)框架已成为廉价、可复制、无参考的自然语言生成(NLG)评价的有希望的解决办法。 先前的工作试图通过将评价任务分解为更简单的子任务来改进LLMaJ. 在这项工作中,我们系统地将LLMaJ方法与多个NLG数据集进行对比,并且不进行分解. 我们没有发现证据表明,负责任务分解的LLMaJ在不使用分解的公平基线上导致业绩增益。 相反,我们发现,以前报告的基于分解的LLMaJ的性能提高来自于使用人类标签作为培训数据,而不是任务分解本身. 而且,我们发现,当人类标签可用,LLMa 不使用任务分解的J可以与人类的注释者进行比较.

articles.title: Overfitting Mitigation via Singular Value Decomposition in Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
articles.content: Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding enables high-quality text generation by selecting the hypothesis that maximizes a utility metric over sampled pseudo-references. However, it is highly susceptible to metric overfitting: it can irregularly inflate the chosen utility metric at the direct expense of other unoptimized evaluation metrics. To mitigate this, we introduce SVD-MBR, which frames the pairwise utility matrix as a noisy information signal. By computing a low-rank approximation via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and retaining only the top-$k$ components, we effectively decouple true consensus from metric noise. Experiments demonstrate that SVD-MBR successfully regularizes decoding, yielding substantial gains across a range of generalized metrics. Furthermore, we reveal that this denoising is metric-dependent: neural metrics encode a robust low-rank consensus ideal for SVD, whereas surface-level metrics struggle to separate signal from metric noise.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在最小贝叶风险解码中通过 Singular 值进行过度适应缓解
articles.content_zh: 最小贝叶斯风险(MBR)解码能够通过选择一个比被抽样的伪参照物最大化的公用度量的假说来生成高质量的文本. 然而,它极易受到量度过高的影响:它可以不规则地增加所选择的公用量度,而直接牺牲其他不优化的评价量度。 为了缓解这种情况,我们引入了SVD-MBR,它将双向的公用矩阵设定为吵闹的信息信号. 通过通过 Singular 值分解(SVD) 计算出一个低等近似值, 并且只保留顶级的美元元元件, 我们有效地将真正的共识 与 公制噪声脱钩。 实验表明,SVD-MBR成功地规范了编解码,在一系列通用度量衡上取得了实质性收益. 此外,我们揭示,这种去诺是依靠度量的:神经分量编码了SVD的强而低的共识理想,而地表分量则挣扎着将信号与度量噪声相分离.

articles.title: Latent Recurrent Thoughts: Recurrent Refinement of Proposed Latents for Reasoning with Frozen LLMs
articles.content: Chain-of-thought reasoning unfolds in discrete token space: each step is committed as text, errors propagate, and eliciting good traces presupposes traces to imitate. Reasoning instead in a model's continuous representation space - where intermediate states are vectors rather than words - sidesteps these constraints, but leaves open how those latent states should be computed. We approach this along two axes. First, we keep a large language model (LLM) frozen and use it for what it is already good at - modeling and decoding sequences - while a small auxiliary network supplies continuous latent thoughts as input. Second, we produce those latents by recurrence: a tiny recurrent reasoner refines them over many steps, decoupling the depth of computation from the size of the model, so that the latents are a product of iterative processing rather than a single forward pass. We instantiate this as Latent Recurrent Thoughts (LRT): a task-dedicated proposer supplies base latents, a recurrent reasoner refines them through bounded residual corrections, and the frozen LLM decodes the answer. On symbolic reasoning with answer supervision but no reasoning traces (Countdown-4, Sudoku) and on natural-language reasoning (HumanEval, MBPP, StrategyQA), LRT substantially outperforms prior frozen-decoder continuous-space reasoning methods under an identical decoder, prompt, data, and training budget, and outperforms non-thinking-mode chain-of-thought prompting on the same backbone at a small fraction of its inference compute.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 经常活动 思想:经常改进用冻结的有限责任公司说明理由的拟议底稿
articles.content_zh: 思维链推理在离散的符号空间中展开:每个步骤都是作为文字而承诺的,错误被传播出来,而得到好的痕迹则预先假定要模仿痕迹. 相反,在一个模型的连续表示空间(中间状态是矢量而不是文字)中,这些限制被忽略了,但对于如何计算这些潜在状态却留有余地。 我们沿着两条轴线前进。 首先,我们保留一个大型语言模型(LLM)被冷冻起来,并用于它已经擅长的——建模和解码序列——而一个小型辅助网络则提供连续潜想作为输入. 第二,我们通过重现来产生这些潜在物:一个微小的反复出现的原因器通过许多步骤来完善它们,使计算深度与模型大小脱钩,从而使潜在物成为迭代处理的产物,而不是单一的前进通道. 我们将此作为Latetnt Creative Thoughts (LRT):一个专为任务而提议者提供基础潜伏物,一个经常性的理性者通过有界限的剩余修正来完善它们,被冻结的LLM解码答案. 关于有答案监督的象征性推理,但没有推理痕迹(Countdown-4, Sudoku)和自然语推理(HumanEval, MBPP, SrategalQA),LRT在相同的解码器,即时,数据和培训预算下,在前被冷冻解码的连续空间推理方法上大大超过前被冷冻解码的推理方法,并且超越了非思维-模式-思维链在其推想计算中以一小部分来刺激同一骨干.

articles.title: EDRAC: Benchmarking Arabic Dialect Reading Comprehension
articles.content: Dialectal Arabic (DA) remains under-resourced compared to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), particularly for machine reading comprehension (MRC) and question answering (QA). Existing Arabic QA benchmarks primarily focus on formal written MSA or multiple-choice QA, with limited coverage of naturally spoken dialects. Here, we aim to bridge this gap. We introduce EDRAC, the first large-scale benchmark for dialectal Arabic machine reading comprehension (MRC) and generative QA, covering five major dialects: Egyptian, Moroccan, Emirati, Syrian, and Saudi Arabic. EDRAC contains 499 passages derived from naturally occurring spoken interactions and 4,977 corresponding QA pairs generated through a human--LLM collaborative pipeline combining iterative generation, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human verification. We benchmark Arabic-centric and multilingual LLMs on EDRAC using lexical and semantic metrics. Our results reveal substantial gaps between semantic answer quality and dialectal fidelity, highlighting the limitations of existing evaluation metrics for dialectal Arabic generation. EDRAC provides a realistic and challenging MRC benchmark for future research on dialectal Arabic NLP.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EDRAC: 阿拉伯糖尿病阅读理解基准
articles.content_zh: 与现代标准阿拉伯语(MSA)相比,糖尿病(DA)仍然资源不足,特别是在机器阅读理解(MRC)和问答(QA)方面。 现有的阿拉伯语质量评估基准主要侧重于正式书面的MSA或多选择质量评估,自然口语方言的覆盖范围有限. 在这方面,我们的目标是弥合这一差距。 我们引入了EDRAC,这是方言阿拉伯机器读取理解(MRC)和基因QA的第一个大规模基准,涵盖五大方言:埃及语、摩洛哥语、埃米拉提语、叙利亚语和沙特阿拉伯语。 EDRAC包含499个出自自然发生的口语互动的段落和4,977个对应的QA对通过人与LLM合作管道生成的,结合了迭代生成,LLM-as-a-judge评价,以及人类验证. 我们使用词汇和语义衡量标准,将以阿拉伯为中心、多语言的法学硕士课程以EDRAC为基准。 我们的结果显示,语义回答质量和方言忠实之间存在巨大差距,突出表明了阿拉伯方言生成的现有评价指标的局限性。 ECDRAC为未来方言阿拉伯语NLP的研究提供了现实而具有挑战性的MRC基准.

articles.title: ClinTraceBench: Source-Verifiable Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning over EHR-Derived Dialogues
articles.content: Clinical LLM assistants must reason over multi-visit patient trajectories, yet whether the compact history representations used to scale them---retrieval, structured timelines, LLM summaries, agentic memory---preserve the longitudinal signal clinical reasoning needs has not been measured. We introduce ClinTraceBench: 385 MIMIC-IV-derived verified dialogues with event-ID provenance, a nine-task taxonomy (T1--T9), and L0--L4 deterministic + L5 human-audit validation (98.92\% agreement). We evaluate eight history representation strategies---a no-context floor, \textit{last-visit-only}, \textit{full-context}, BGE-M3 \textit{dense-retrieval}, two compression schemes, and two agentic-memory systems (\textit{Mem0}, \textit{A-Mem})---across four backbones (DeepSeek-V3, GPT-4o-mini, Haiku~4.5, Sonnet~4.6) on 6{,}271 questions: 32 cells, 200{,}672 predictions. Four findings: (SP4) a controlled T3 injection probe isolates compression-induced \textit{relation} loss---with the attribution sentence present \textit{before} construction, \textit{Mem0}, \textit{A-Mem} and \textit{llm-summary} still recover only 0--5.3\% of the injected positives; (SP1) compressed strategies pay an aggregation tax on multi-visit trends and cross-patient comparisons; (SP2) the blind-to-full gap spans $+29.8$~pp (GPT-4o-mini) to $+62.7$~pp (Haiku); (SP3) abstention scales non-monotonically with context length. On the Pareto frontier Haiku dominates Sonnet under \textit{full-context} (\$25.76 vs.\ \$106.21), inverting the ``biggest backbone wins'' heuristic.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ClinTrace Bench:关于EHR动态对话的可核实来源纵向临床理由
articles.content_zh: 临床LLM助手必须在多访病人的轨迹上说明理由,然而,用于衡量其规模的紧凑历史表现—— 检索、结构化时间表、LLM摘要、代理记忆—— 保存纵向信号临床推理需求是否尚未被测量。 我们介绍ClinTrace Bench:385个MIMIC-IV衍生的经核实的对话与事件ID出处,一个9个任务分类学(T1-T9)和L0-L4确定性+L5人审计验证(98.92\%协议). 我们评价了八个历史代表战略——- a no-context地层,\textit{last-visit- only},\textit{ful-context},BGE-M3\textit{dense-retrival},两个压缩方案,以及两个代理模型系统(\textit{Mem0},\textit{A-Mem})——跨越四个主干线(Deep Seek-V3,GPT-4o-mini,Haiku-4.5,Sonnet~4.6),在6{,}271个问题:32个单元格,200{,}672个预测. 四个发现:(SP4) 受控的T3注射探针隔离了由压缩引起的\textit{ relations}损失- , 归属句是\textit{ before} 构建,\textit{Mem0},\textit{A-Mem} 和\textit{llm-summary} 仍然只回收注射阳性物质的0-5.3\%; (SP1) 压缩策略对多访趋势和跨住院比较支付汇总税; (SP2) 盲-全相间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间间 在Pareto Frontier Haiku在\textit{full-context}(\$25.76 vs.\$106.21)下主宰了Sonnet,颠倒了"最"的骨干取胜' Heuristic.

articles.title: Hints Help But Do They Teach? Evaluating Skills Transfer in Code Generation
articles.content: When a hint turns a failing generated program into a passing one, does it provide missing information or merely steer the model toward a solution it could already produce? We test these hypotheses on HumanEval+ and MBPP+ using executable evaluation. For Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, adaptive relevant hints rescue 36 of 79 selected failures; an unrelated hint rescues 19, while eight unhinted samples solve 46 and recover 31 of the 36 relevant-hint rescues. Phi-3.5-mini shows the same pattern: relevant hints rescue 42 of 101 failures, an unrelated hint rescues 17, and unhinted sampling solves 57, including 36 of the 42 relevant-hint rescues. Because the hint conditions use different attempt budgets, these comparisons do not isolate a purely semantic effect. Mechanistic tests on Qwen identify a stable activation direction shared by relevant and unrelated hints. Persistently adding this direction yields 14 rescues and 18 regressions, with no detectable net accuracy gain; learned low-rank interventions have a positive but imprecise estimated effect. Full textual specifications solve 22 of 24 context-defined problems, versus 5-11 for tested virtual-KV prefixes. Post-generation hidden-state probes transfer across benchmarks, with pooled AUROC 0.806 and 0.780, but their top-one selection advantage over token confidence is statistically unresolved. Overall, relevant hints can rescue failures, but most rescued solutions are already reachable through ordinary sampling, and the internal interventions tested here do not establish task-general capability transfer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 帮助他们,但他们教吗? 在代码生成中评估技能转让
articles.content_zh: 当一个提示将一个失败生成的程序变成一个通过的程序时,它是否提供了缺失的信息或者只是引导模型走向它已经能够产生的解决方案? 我们用可执行的评价在HumanEval+和MBPP+上测试这些假设. 对于Quen2.5-3B-Instruct来说,适应性相关提示救援了79个所选失败中的36个;一个无关的提示救援了19个;而8个未输入的样本解决了46个,并回收了36个相关救援中的31个. Phi-3.5-mini呈现出相同的模式:相关提示救援了101个失败中的42个,一个不相干的提示救援了17个,而无刺取样解决了57个,包括42个相关提示救援中的36个. 由于提示条件使用不同的尝试预算,这些比较并不孤立一种纯粹的语义效应. Quen上的机械测试确定一个稳定的活化方向,由相关和无关的提示所共享. 不断添加这个方向可产生14起救援和18起回归,没有可探测的净准确性收益;所学低级干预具有积极但不准确的估计效果. 完整文字规格解决了24个上下文定义问题的22个,相对于测试的虚拟-KV前缀5-11. 后生成后隐藏状态探测器跨基准转移,集合AUROC 0.806和0.780,但是它们的第一选择优势比象征性信任优势在统计学上尚未解决. 总体而言,相关的提示可以挽救失败,但大多数被拯救的解决方案已经通过普通的采样可以达到,在此测试的内部干预并不能建立任务一般能力转移.

articles.title: When Modality Gap Reduction Fails: Prediction-Level Hubness in CLIP
articles.content: Reducing the modality gap between image and text representations in CLIP is widely expected to improve cross-modal alignment and downstream performance. However, a smaller average image-text gap does not necessarily lead to consistent accuracy gains. We analyze this mismatch from the perspective of the decision structure in zero-shot classification, i.e. selecting the most similar class-text prototype for an input image. Zero-shot accuracy depends not only on average image--text alignment, but also on class-wise decision margins. Using Linear correction as an analytically tractable case, we show that modality gap correction can alter the relative decision structure among classes and cause predictions to concentrate on a small subset of classes. We refer to this output-space failure mode as prediction-level hubness. Furthermore, experiments across multiple datasets show that accuracy degradation under gap correction is consistently associated with increased prediction concentration, both for Linear correction and for learning-based correction methods. This provides a systematic explanation of why modality gap reduction does not consistently improve CLIP zero-shot accuracy from the perspective of downstream decision structure. Our results suggest that gap correction should be evaluated not only by average alignment, but also by its impact on downstream prediction structure.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当减少模式差距失败时:预测CLIP中的水平枢纽
articles.content_zh: 广泛预计,减少CLIP中图像和文字表述之间的模式差距将改善跨模式的对接和下游性能。 然而,一个较小的图像文本平均差距并不一定导致一致的准确性提高。 我们从零发分类中决策结构的角度来分析这种不匹配,即为输入图像选择最相近的类文本原型. 0射入精度不仅取决于平均图像-文本对齐,还取决于分级决定边距. 使用线性修正作为可分析可引导的案例,我们显示模式差距修正可以改变类别之间的相对决定结构,并导致预测集中在一个小的子类上. 我们把这种输出-空间故障模式称为预测级中枢. 此外,跨多套数据集的实验表明,在差分校正下准确度的下降与预测浓度的提高有关,无论是线性校正还是以学习为基础的校正方法。 这从下游决策结构的角度来看,系统地解释了为什么减少模式差距不能持续提高CLIP零发精度。 我们的结果表明,不仅应当通过平均调整,而且应当通过对下游预测结构的影响来评估差距的纠正。

articles.title: Beyond Magnitude: Contrastive Routing for Modular Mixture-of-Experts
articles.content: In current Mixture-of-Experts architectures, routing is performed based on representations dominated by structure shared across all tokens, limiting expert specialization. We show that contrasting each token against an Exponential Moving Average of the layer's hidden states, rather than routing on absolute magnitude, concentrates the routing signal onto a low-dimensional, highly separable subspace. Building on this, we propose the Contrastive Routing Mechanism (CoRM), which scores each expert by the gap between its affinity for the incoming token and its affinity for this shared reference state, interpreted through a distinct per-expert projection. The resulting experts have routing boundaries that align with linguistic structure significantly more than the Top-k baseline. Our experiments show that CoRM improves average zero-shot accuracy by +0.67 to +1.69 points (Top-1) and +1.38 to +1.77 points (Top-2) over standard Top-k MoE baselines on nine zero-shot reasoning benchmarks, at the minimal cost of 2.9% added parameters and 2.6% added FLOPs per token.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超强: 模式混合专家的对照路线
articles.content_zh: 在目前的Mixture-of-Experts架构中,路由基于以所有符号共享的结构为主的表示来进行,限制了专家专业化. 我们显示,将每个符号与层层所隐藏状态的指数移动平均值作对比, 而不是在绝对数量上进行路由, 将路由信号集中到一个低维高度分离的子空间上。 在此基础上,我们提议采用对照运行机制(CORM),按照每位专家对即将到来的标志的亲和度与这种共同参考状态的亲和度之间的相差来评分,通过专家的单独预测加以解释。 由此产生的专家有与语言结构相适应的路由界限,大大高于Top-k基线。 我们的实验表明,CoRM在9个零发推理基准上比标准Top-k MoE基线提高平均零发精度为+0.67至+1.69分(Top-1)和+1.38至+1.77分(Top-2),最低成本为2.9%的新增参数和2.6%的每个令牌添加FLOP.

articles.title: StateSwap: Probing Support-Elimination Hidden States in Multiple-Choice Questions
articles.content: Large language models often answer the same multiple-choice question inconsistently when it is posed under support-oriented and elimination-oriented framings. We investigate whether these discrepancies arise from different internal representations induced by the two framings. We introduce a dual-framing protocol with minimally varied prompts that use either support- or elimination-oriented framing while keeping the evaluation target fixed. To probe the internal computation, we append an untrained special token, [STATE], and treat its residual-stream activation as an intervention interface. Across both models, the two framings induce separable [STATE] activations concentrated in intermediate layers. Swapping these activations between paired prompts systematically changes predictions and improves cross-framing agreement, providing intervention-based evidence that the activations are behaviorally relevant. Beyond instance-level substitution, mean-difference steering directions derived from the dual-framing contrast exhibit more bounded layer-wise responses than matched contrastive activation addition directions under the evaluated protocol.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: StateSwap:在多个选择问题上调查支持-消除隐藏国家
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型在以支持为导向的框架和以消除为导向的框架下,往往不连贯地回答同样的多选择问题。 我们调查这些差异是否源于两个框架引起的不同内部表述。 我们采用了一种双花纹协议,其中的提示最小,使用支持或消除导向框架,同时使评价目标保持不变。 为了探究内部计算,我们附加了一个未经训练的特殊符号[STATE],并将它的残余-流活化作为干预界面. 在两种模型中,两种框架都诱发可分离的[STATE]活化物集中在中间层. 将这些活化在配对之间,催生出系统性地改变预测,并改进交叉花纹协议,提供基于干预的证据,证明活化与行为相关. 除了实例级替代外,从双窗体对比中得出的平均偏差方向比评价协议下对应的对比活性附加方向显示的分层响应要多。

articles.title: Post-hoc Alignment of LLM-judges to Human Judgment Distribution
articles.content: The LLM-as-a-judge (LLMaJ) framework offers a cost-effective and reproducible solution for automatic evaluation. However, current evaluation practices typically compare LLMaJ judgments against aggregated ground-truth labels, overlooking the valuable information contained in Human Label Variation (HLV). Inspired by an increasing line of work that proposes to leverage HLV, we systematically study LLMaJ performance on predicting both a single, aggregated ground truth hard-label and unaggregated soft-labels that represent Human Judgment Distributions (HJD). Our results across five diverse datasets reveal that while LLMs achieve near human-level performance at hard-label prediction on most tasks, they exhibit poor performance when predicting soft-labels. To address this limitation, we propose NAPHA (eNtropy-Aware Post-Hoc Alignment), a simple yet effective lightweight post-hoc alignment method that matches the LLM distribution to the HJD by first assigning an instance to a discrete entropy class and then routing it to specialized, trained alignment models. We find that NAPHA consistently improves soft-labels prediction across base LLM models and datasets, with particularly strong gains on high-entropy instances where capturing diverse human perspectives is most critical. We also show via oracle experiments that improving entropy class prediction can substantially enhance NAPHA's practical effectiveness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 法学硕士后法官与人类判决相一致
articles.content_zh: LLM-as-a judge(LLMaJ)框架为自动评价提供了一个成本效益高和可复制的解决办法。 然而,目前的评价做法通常将法学硕士和法学硕士的判断与汇总的地面真实标签进行比较,忽略了人类标签变化(Human Label Variation)中的宝贵信息。 受越来越多的工作线的启发,我们提议利用HLV,我们系统研究LLMaJ在预测一个单一的,汇总的地面真理硬标签和代表人类判断分布(HJD)的未分解的软标签方面的表现. 我们五个不同数据集的结果表明,虽然LLMs在对大多数任务的硬标签预测中取得了接近人一级的性能,但在对软标签的预测中却表现不佳. 为了解决这一限制,我们提议NAPHA(eNtropy-Aware Post-Hoc对接),这是一种简单而有效的轻量级后Hoc对接方法,它与LLM分布与HJD相匹配,首先将一个实例分配给一个离散的Entropy类,然后将其引向经过专门训练的对接模式. 我们发现,NAPHA不断改进跨基础LLM模型和数据集的软标签预测,在捕捉各种人类视角最为关键的高强度实例上尤其有显著的进展。 我们还通过甲骨文实验表明,改进py类预测可以大大地提高NAPHA的实际效力.

articles.title: OUTLETS: Output-Length Prediction from Speculative Decoding Backbones
articles.content: The heavy-tailed distribution of output lengths in Large Language Model (LLM) serving poses major challenges for resource provisioning and cluster scheduling. Although output-length prediction can mitigate these issues, existing approaches have key drawbacks: external proxy models add substantial latency and often have limited fidelity, whereas internal state-based methods are efficient but rely on shallow probes of current model states. We identify a structural connection between speculative decoding (SD) and length prediction: latent representations produced by the draft decoder in advanced frameworks (e.g., EAGLE-3) encode signals that are predictive of generation length. Building on this insight, we introduce OUTLETS (Output-Length Prediction from Speculative Decoding Backbones), which repurposes the speculative backbone as a trajectory-aware length predictor. When its draft representations are already computed for speculative decoding, OUTLETS adds only a lightweight regression head and achieves lower MAE than the evaluated methods. Under saturated disaggregated serving, OUTLETS predictions enable standard scheduling policies to prioritize shorter requests and distribute requests more evenly across decoding instances, reducing short-request P99 latency by 34.8%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OutLETS: 从分光解码后骨输出- Length 预测
articles.content_zh: 使用大语言模型(LLM)产出长度的重尾分布对资源提供和集群安排构成重大挑战。 虽然产出长度预测可以减轻这些问题,但现有方法有关键缺陷:外部代用模型增加了相当长的耐用性,而且往往具有有限的忠诚度,而基于国家的内部方法是有效的,但依赖于对当前模型状态的浅析探测。 我们找出了投机解码(SD)和长度预测之间的结构联系:高级框架(如EAGLE-3)中由解码器草案产生的潜在表示,可预测生成长度的编码信号. 基于这种洞察力,我们引入了Output-Length Prespect from Speculated Droiding Backbones(英语:Output-Length Prespecture),它重新将投机骨干用作一个能意识到轨迹长度的预测器. 当其陈述草案已经为推测解码计算出来时,OULETS只增加了一个轻量级回归头并实现了低于评估方法的MAE. 在饱和分类服务下,OutLETS预测使得标准调度政策能够优先处理更短的请求,并在解码情况下更平均地分配请求,将短请求P99的延迟度减少34.8%.

articles.title: WorldBench: Culturally Grounded Benchmark for Multilingual Agents
articles.content: Despite the growing use of LLM-powered agents to solve multi-step tasks in complex environments, existing benchmarks rarely test state preservation, performance across languages, and application to realistic, grounded scenarios. To address these concerns, we present WorldBench: a comprehensive, multilingual benchmark of genuine, persona-grounded everyday workflows, where agents can act in a sandbox via structured actions. WorldBench comprises 1,600 tasks across seven languages and eight cultures, filtered and refined through feedback from human annotators with language- and culture-specific expertise. For evaluation, we extend metrics from previous works and introduce Constrained Task Success (CTS), which combines natural language instructions and testbeds to score task completion, minimal modification, and other complementary metrics through deterministic and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations. Our experiments show that frontier models reach only 49.2% CTS, with all models demonstrating large gaps between correctness and environment preservation. We thereby show that current agents remain brittle in multilingual, agentic scenarios, especially for long-horizon tasks and under state-preservation constraints
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 世界奔驰:基于文化的多种语言代理基准
articles.content_zh: 尽管越来越多地使用LLM驱动剂来解决复杂环境下的多步骤任务,但现有的基准很少测试状态保存,跨语言的性能,以及应用到现实的,有根据的情景. 为解决这些关切,我们介绍了World Bench:一个以真实的、以人为基础的日常工作流程为基础的全面、多语种基准,在这个基准中,代理人可以通过结构化的行动在一个沙盒中采取行动。 世界奔驰包含1 600项任务,涉及7种语言和8种文化,通过具有语言和文化专门知识的人类注释者的反馈加以过滤和完善。 关于评价,我们从以往的著作中扩展了衡量标准,并引入了 " 限制任务成功 " (Constructive Task Support (CTS)),它将自然语言指令和测试床结合起来,通过确定性评价和LLM-as-a-Judge评价对任务完成、最小修改和其他补充性衡量标准进行评分。 我们的实验表明,前沿模型只达到49.2%的CTS,所有模型都显示出正确性和环境保护之间的巨大差距. 因此,我们表明,在多语种、代理性的情况下,特别是长期任务和在国家保护的制约下,目前的代理人仍然脆弱。

articles.title: Lagged Coupling: Internal Representations Become Readable Before They Become Causal
articles.content: Across the full Pythia suite (160M-12B, eight checkpoints, four task families), a linear probe can read a target variable from the residual stream as early as step 1,000 at every scale -- yet steering along that same reading direction remains null-equivalent in 43 of 48 model-checkpoint cells. Internal readability systematically outruns causal efficacy, and the lag does not shrink with scale. We call this structure lagged coupling and decompose it into three dissociable tracks: (i) internal readability, saturated (AUROC >= 0.990) from the first checkpoint everywhere; (ii) behavioral readability, which develops gradually and progressively later at larger scales (12B reaches 0.909 only at the final checkpoint); (iii) causal efficacy, almost always null-equivalent, occasionally counterproductive early, with one isolated positive pulse (12B, step 8,000, z = +2.49) our grid cannot resolve. The ordering is dominantly read-before-write (11/11 units, no inversion). Representation headroom along the probe direction grows up to 57x with training and scale while causal write-in stays below 0.11% of headroom -- the variable is increasingly written into the representation and increasingly ignored by the readout. Under a fully pre-registered protocol, both single-onset hypotheses resolve INDETERMINATE (scale slope +0.24, 95% CI [-0.60, +0.87]; time vote 3:3) -- a disciplined negative explained by the three-track decomposition. A pre-registered OLMo-2 replication preserves the direction at attenuated magnitude. Our results caution against inferring steerability from probe accuracy and establish a developmental bottleneck: representation formation reliably outpaces causal readout consolidation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 标记对接:内部代表 在他们成为因果之前可以读取
articles.content_zh: 横跨整个Pythia套间(160M-12B,8个检查站,4个任务家庭),线性探测器早在每个尺度上1 000步就能读出残余流中的目标变量 -- -- 然而,在48个模型检查点的43个单元中,沿着同一读取方向行走仍然无异。 内部可读性系统跑出因果效力,而后差不随尺度而缩小. 我们称这一结构滞后并分解为三个可分离的轨道:(一) 内部可读性,饱和性(AUROC QX 0.990),从各地第一个检查站;(二) 行为可读性,在更大尺度(12B只到最后检查站才达到0.909)上逐步并逐步发展;(三) 因果关系,几乎总是无等同,有时是适得其反的早期,一个孤立的正脉(12B,8000,z=+2.49),我们的电网无法解决. 订单主要为写前读取(11/11个单位,无倒置). 探针方向上的代表头室会长到57x并经过培训和规模,而因果录入则会停留在头室的0.11%以下 -- -- 变数被越来越多的写入代表头室,被读出者所忽略. 在一个完全预先注册的协议下,两个单接假设都解决了INDETERMINATE(比例坡度+0.24,95% CI [-0.60,+0.87;时间投票3:3)——由三轨分解解释的纪律性否定. 预先登记的OLMo-2复制使方向保持在已减弱的地平面上。 我们的成果告诫不要从探测的准确性推断出可引导性,并确立一个发展瓶颈:代表性的形成可靠地快于因果读取整合。

articles.title: PCoMoE: Shifting MoE Inference from Monolithic Expert Selection to Fine-Grained Path Composition
articles.content: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale Large Language Model (LLM) capacity efficiently by activating a sparse subset of experts per token. However, modern MoE inference remains heavily constrained by the rigid, whole-expert abstraction. Existing frameworks manage, schedule, or prune experts as atomic execution units, which fixes the optimization boundary too early and leaves fine-grained intra-expert computational redundancy underexplored. In this work, we present PCoMoE, a path-compositional execution framework that shifts MoE inference from coarse-grained expert selection to fine-grained path composition. PCoMoE incorporates a path-level formulation of expert computation, a compatibility-aware layer-wise pruning strategy to suppress low-value path combinations, and a hardware-friendly execution engine to exploit reusable sub-expert structures under strictly bounded overheads. Experimental results demonstrate that PCoMoE achieves up to a 1.31x end-to-end inference speedup while enhancing model accuracy by 10%. The code is available at https://github.com/gzyyy0/PCoMoE
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PCoMoE: 将 MoE 推论从单石学专家入选到精致路径构成
articles.content_zh: Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)架构通过激活每个符号的稀有子集来高效地放大大语言模型(LLM)容量. 然而,现代的教育部推论仍然受到僵硬的全专家抽象主义的严重制约. 现有的框架作为原子执行单位来管理,调度,或prune专家,它很早就确定了优化边界,使专家内部精细的计算冗余不足。 在这部作品中,我们介绍了PCoMoE,一个路径组合执行框架,将MOE推论从粗糙的受精专家选择转变为精细的受精路径构成. PCoMoE采用了一种路径级的专家计算配方,一种兼容感地层分层穿行策略来压制低值路径组合,以及一种硬件友好执行引擎来利用严格限定的间接费用下的可再利用子专家结构. 实验结果显示,PCoMoE在提升模型精度10%的同时,可以实现最高1.31x端到端的推论速度. 该代码可见于https://github.com/gzyyyy0/PCoMoE.

articles.title: Phrase-Localized Language-Contrastive Guidance: Training-Free Localized Accent Control for Code-Switching Text-to-Speech
articles.content: Current speech synthesis struggles with code-switching, which mixes a foreign language phrase into a primary language utterance, causing the phrase to be spoken with the primary language's accent rather than its native one. We propose Phrase-Localized Language-Contrastive Guidance (LCG), a training-free inference framework that restores a native accent to code-switched phrases in cross-lingual text-to-speech. LCG replaces the single language guidance applied across the whole utterance with a separate guidance for each region, so each part is guided by its own language. To choose where to apply this localized guidance, we propose a self-attention probing technique that finds the phrase boundaries without external alignments. Together, these components generate speech in which each region carries the accent of its own language, requiring no fine-tuning or auxiliary models. Across diverse language pairs, LCG robustly increases the nativeness of the code-switched phrase while suppressing accent leakage, and preserving overall speaker identity and naturalness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言本地化 语言联系 指导:对代码切换文本进行无培训本地化控制
articles.content_zh: 目前的语音合成与代码切换相搏,将一个外语短语混入了主语发音中,导致该短语被用主语口音而不是其原生口音来发音. 我们提出"语言本地化语言交流指导"(Phrase-localized Language-Contrestive Directory,LCG),这是一个无培训的推论框架,将本地口音恢复为跨语言文本到语音的代码交换短语. LCG将整个语句中应用的单一语言指导取而代之的是针对每个区域的单独指导,因此每个部分都以自己的语言来指导. 为了选择如何应用这个本地化的指针,我们提出一种自我注意的验证技术,在没有外部对齐的情况下找到短语的边界. 这些组件一起产生语音,每个区域都带有自己语言的口音,不需要微调或辅助模型. 跨多种语言对接,LCG在抑制口音漏出的同时强力地提高密码开关短语的原生性,并保持总的扬声器特性和自然性.

articles.title: SinkPruner: Sink-Free Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.content:
Despite their strong multimodal understanding ability, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial computational overhead when processing long visual token sequences. To reduce inference costs, recent studies have explored visual token pruning through vision-centric or text-guided strategies. However, these methods often overlook high-norm outlier tokens, i.e., tokens with abnormally large feature norms, leading to suboptimal pruning decisions. In this work, we show that such high-norm outlier tokens are highly redundant in both feature and spatial dimensions, yet are often mistakenly preserved as informative cues by existing methods.
  Motivated by this observation, we propose SinkPruner, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient MLLM inference. SinkPruner follows a coarse-to-fine design with two key modules: a visual sanitizer that filters high-norm redundancies and alleviates attention sink and attention dispersion, and a text-guided pruner that further retains tokens semantically aligned with the text query.
  Extensive experiments on twelve image-language and four video-language benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and generalizability of our framework. Notably, SinkPruner preserves 96.5% (91.8%) of the original performance of LLaVA-1.5 (Qwen2.5-VL) under an 89% token reduction. Experiments further indicate that our visual sanitizer exhibits promising transferability in enhancing the performance of existing pruning methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/LaVi-Lab/SinkPruner.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 辛克普鲁纳 : 用于多式大型语言模型的Sink-Free Visual Token Pruning
articles.content_zh:
尽管多式联运理解能力很强,但多式联运大型语言模型在处理长视符号序列时需要大量的计算费。 为了降低推论成本,最近的研究探索了通过以视觉为中心或以文字为指南的战略来取景。 然而,这些方法往往忽略了高规范的外标,即带有异常大特征规范的外标,导致非最佳的挤压决定. 在这项工作中,我们表明,这种高标准外标在地物和空间方面都是非常多余的,但往往被错误地保留为现有方法的信息提示。
基于这一观察,我们提议采用SinkPruner,这是一个无培训的视觉符号推导框架,用于高效的MLLM推论。 SinkPruner遵循粗糙到精细的设计,有两个关键模块:一是可视化的消毒器,可以过滤出高规范冗余并缓解注意力的沉入和注意力的分散;一是文字导出器,可以进一步保留与文本查询一致的符号.
关于12个图像语言基准和4个视频语言基准的广泛试验表明我们的框架的有效性、效率和普遍性。 值得注意的是,SinkPruner将LLaVA-1.5(Quen2.5-VL)的原始性能保留了96.5%(91.8%),降幅为89%。 实验进一步显示,我们的视觉消毒器在提高现有收发方法的性能方面显示出有希望的可转移性。 我们的代码可见于https://github.com/LaVi-Lab/SinkPruner.

articles.title: Right Frame, Wrong Rule: Cultural Cues Expose the Financial Knowledge Gap They Were Meant to Close
articles.content: When a question has valid answers under different normative frameworks, a language model must decide which framework to use and whether it can answer correctly within it. We call this setting normative pluralism and study it in Islamic finance using a four-choice taxonomy that separates framework selection from within-framework correctness. This separation reveals the stereotype trap: a cultural cue steers a model toward one framework, but the model selects an incorrect answer within that framework. Across twelve models, two languages, and fifty demographic signals, cultural cues change framework selection and reveal substantial differences in accuracy, especially among non-frontier models. Under the strongest signal, large open-weight models select the Islamic framework 97% of the time. A two-choice evaluation would report near-perfect alignment, although 57--66% of those selections are incorrect. These findings motivate, but do not directly test, the competence-conditioned routing hypothesis: models may favor frameworks where they are more accurate, while cultural cues may expose framework-specific competence gaps.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 右框架,错误规则:文化库斯 展示金融知识差距 他们注定要关闭
articles.content_zh: 当一个问题在不同规范框架下有有效的答案时,语言模型必须决定使用哪个框架,以及它是否能够在其中正确回答. 我们称此为规范多元化,并在伊斯兰金融中采用四选择分类法加以研究,将框架选择与框架内的正确性区分开来。 这种分离揭示了陈规定型的陷阱:一种文化提示将一个模型引导到一个框架,但模型在这个框架内选择了一个不正确的答案。 在整个12个模式、两种语言和50个人口信号中,文化提示改变了框架选择,并揭示出特别是在非边境模式中存在很大差异。 在最强信号下,大型开放量级模型选择了伊斯兰框架97%的时间. 双选择评价将报告接近完美一致,尽管其中57%至66%的选择不正确。 这些结论激励但并不直接检验以能力为条件的路由假设:模型可能倾向于更准确的框架,而文化提示则可能暴露出具体框架的能力差距。

articles.title: Inspicio: Open-Vocabulary, LLM-Based Sense Retrieval for Historical Languages
articles.content: Word Sense Disambiguation has advanced rapidly for English and a handful of well-resourced modern languages, but it continues to assume the existence of a sense inventory and a word-to-sense mapping in the source language (Navigli, 2026). These assumptions break down for most historical and low-resource languages, whose dedicated WordNets are either incomplete or still under construction. We present Inspicio, an open-vocabulary retrieval pipeline that links tokens in context to synsets of the Open English WordNet (McCrae et al., 2020) without requiring any source-language inventory or mapping. For each occurrence, an instruction-tuned LLM produces two English translations of the surrounding sentence, a small set of candidate dictionary-style definitions, and a few candidate English lemmas. These outputs drive a hybrid retrieval step that combines dense definition-synset similarity, sparse lemma matching, and Maximal Marginal Relevance re-ranking. We evaluate the pipeline across a 6x6 grid of LLMs and sentence-embedding models on a new bilingual set of manually annotated Latin and Ancient Greek perception verbs, on a subset of PREMOVE dataset (Farina, 2025), and on a diachronic sample of Italian. The best configuration reaches 96% Recall@50 on the perception-verb test set, with each component contributing measurable gains, and remains competitive in the out-of-domain and cross-lingual settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Inspicio:开放词汇,基于LLM的历史语言语境检索
articles.content_zh: Word Sense Disambiguation在英语和少数资源丰富的现代语言方面进展迅速,但它继续假定存在感知盘点和源语言的"对语"映射(Navigli,2026). 这些假设针对大多数历史语言和低资源语言而分解出来,它们的专用WordNet要么不完整,要么仍在构建中. 我们介绍Inspicio,一个开放式的省道检索管道,将符号与Open English WordNet(McCrae等,2020年)的合成联系起来,而不需要任何来源语言的清点或绘图。 对于每次发生,一个指令调制的LLM会生成相邻句子的两个英文译本,一组小的候选词典式定义,以及几个候选英语lemmas. 这些输出驱动了一个混合检索步骤,该步骤结合了密集的定义-同位素相似性,稀有的lemma匹配,和Maximal边际相关性再排行. 我们通过一套人工附加说明的拉丁语和古希腊语感官动词、PREMOVE数据集的子集(FARINA,2025年)和意大利语的二相传样本,对跨6x6网格的LLM和句子嵌入模型的管道进行评估。 最佳配置在感知-动词测试集上达到96%Recall@50,每个组件都贡献出可衡量的收益,在域外和跨语言环境中仍然具有竞争力.

articles.title: Disclosure-Gated User Simulation for Companion-Agent Evaluation
articles.content: Using a large language model to play the user is now standard in scalable evaluation. It has a repeatedly diagnosed failure: the simulated user is excessively cooperative, so a system under test can score by the sheer number of questions it asks rather than by making the user willing to speak. We answer with a disclosure gate conditioning information release on the companion agent's behaviour: its state is a ladder of five ordered gates, merged onto three observable depth layers. We specify, ablate, and audit it, and train a user simulator against that specification. Gating behaviour is learned from the training corpus's synthetic branch, while the real branch supplies how people speak and react; after training, the simulator need not be told at runtime which gate each item sits behind. The gate is a load-bearing component of the environment: on the English corpus of a published companion-agent benchmark (CompanionBench), once training no longer states per example which gate each item sits behind, the largest rank displacement across 12 systems under test exceeds the noise band set by re-running that environment under a new seed, while per-system scores show no detectable change. We state two acceptance criteria: a ranking must be order-preserving, and absolute scores must be scale-stable. Of the candidates we examine, only one passes both -- the simulator we release -- and its leaderboard correlates at 0.993 with the benchmark's original simulator. By contrast, prompting a frontier model as the simulator barely moves the ranking while shifting every score upward -- a shift invisible to anyone checking the ranking alone. The environment we specify is the one that benchmark already used. That publication describes the mechanism in about four hundred words, and we supply what it lacked: specification, ablations, human studies, negative controls, and downstream sensitivity analysis.

articles.title_zh: 附录-代理评价用户模拟
articles.content_zh: 使用大型语言模型来播放用户,现在是可扩展评价的标准. 它一再被诊断出失败:模拟用户过于合作,因此一个正在接受测试的系统可以通过它所问问题的数量来得分,而不是让用户愿意说话. 我们用一个披露门来回答, 设定关于伴侣代理行为的信息发布: 它的状态是五道阶梯 命令门, 合并到三个可观察到的深度层。 我们规定、取消和审计,并根据这一规定培训一个用户模拟器。 从训练馆的合成分会学到了配乐行为,而真正的分会提供人们说话和反应的方式;经过训练后,不需要在跑道上告知模拟器,每件物品都坐落在哪个门后. 大门是环境的负载部分:在已公布的同伴-代理人基准(Companion Bench)的英文目录上,一旦培训不再说明每个物品都坐落在后面的门上每个例子,12个系统在测试中的最大排位转移就超过了通过在新种子下重新运行环境而设定的噪声波段,而每个系统的分数显示没有可察觉的变化。 我们提出两个接受标准:排名必须是维持秩序,绝对分数必须是稳定的。 在我们所考考的候选人中,只有一位通过——我们公布的模拟器,而其领导板则与基准的最初模拟器相接0.993。 相比之下,当模拟器将每个分数向上移动时, 推动一个前沿模型, 因为模拟器几乎不会移动排名, 而对于任何单独检查排名的人来说, 这是无形的转变。 我们具体说明的环境是已经使用的基准环境。 该出版物用大约四百个字描述了这个机制,我们提供了它所缺乏的东西:规格、活化、人类研究、负控制、下游敏感性分析。
